  app.get('/v1/me/signals', async (request, reply) => {
    const scope = requireUser(request, reply);
    if (!scope) return;
    const principal = request.principal;
    if (principal?.kind !== 'user') return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Unauthorized' });

    const capabilities = capabilitiesFor(principal.user.tier, principal.user.tierExpiresAt);

    // The free tier's feed is delayed. Applied in SQL rather than by filtering
    // after the fact so the delay cannot be bypassed by paging, and so the row
    // is never sent to the client in the first place.
    // Column names verified against the live schema — `signals` uses
    // `pattern_type`/`signal_score`, not `pattern`/`score`.
    const rows = await query(
      `SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.pattern_type, s.chain, s.token_mint, s.token_symbol,
              s.signal_score, s.confidence, s.status, s.detected_at
         FROM signals s
         JOIN cluster_memberships cm ON cm.cluster_id = s.cluster_id
         JOIN user_wallet_subscriptions uws
           ON uws.wallet_address = cm.wallet_address
        WHERE uws.user_id = $1
          -- Migration 051 retains an ended subscription, so without this a user
          -- keeps receiving a master's signals after unsubscribing. winding_down
          -- is deliberately still included: entries have stopped, but the user
          -- holds positions whose exits arrive as that master's sells, and hiding
          -- the activity would leave them unable to see their own exit coming.
          -- No backticks here -- this SQL is a TS template literal.
          AND uws.state <> 'ended'
          AND s.detected_at <= NOW() - ($2::int * interval '1 second')
        ORDER BY s.detected_at DESC
        LIMIT 100`,
      [scope.userId, capabilities.signalDelaySeconds]
    );
    return reply.send({ signals: rows, delayedSeconds: capabilities.signalDelaySeconds });
  });

  app.get('/v1/me/feed', async (request, reply) => {
    const scope = requireUser(request, reply);
    if (!scope) return;
    // `source_trades` uses `direction`/`token_amount`, not `side`/`quantity`.
    const rows = await query(
      `SELECT st.id, st.chain, st.wallet_address, st.token_mint, st.direction,
              st.token_amount, st.amount_usd, st.price_usd, st.event_at
         FROM source_trades st
         JOIN user_wallet_subscriptions uws
           ON uws.wallet_address = st.wallet_address
        WHERE uws.user_id = $1
          -- Same as /v1/me/signals: an ended subscription is a retained record,
          -- not a live feed. A winding_down subscription stays visible.
          AND uws.state <> 'ended'
        ORDER BY st.event_at DESC
        LIMIT 100`,
      [scope.userId]
    );
    return reply.send({ events: rows });
  });

  // ── Trading Withdrawal Routes (S4-12 anti-theft core) ──────────────────────

  const withdrawalOtps = options.otpStore ?? new Map<string, StoredWithdrawalOtp>();

  app.post('/v1/me/trading/withdraw/request-otp', async (request, reply) => {
    const scope = requireUser(request, reply);
    if (!scope) return;
    const principal = request.principal;
    if (principal?.kind !== 'user') return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Unauthorized' });

    const parsed = withdrawRequestOtpSchema.safeParse(request.body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'Invalid payload', details: parsed.error.issues });
    }

    const { destinationAddress, chainKind } = parsed.data;

    // S4-12: Destination MUST be a verified linked auth wallet (case-aware matching)
    const linkedWallets = await listAuthWallets(scope);
    const linked = linkedWallets.find(
      (w) => w.chainKind === chainKind && isSameAddress(w.address, destinationAddress, chainKind)
    );

    if (!linked) {
      return reply.code(400).send({
        error: 'destination-not-linked-auth-wallet',
        message: 'Withdrawals are strictly permitted only to SIWE/SIWS verified linked auth wallets (S4-12)'
      });
    }

    // S4-12: 24h cooling-off window on newly linked wallets
    const now = options.now?.() ?? new Date();
    const cooling = isWalletCoolingOff(linked.verifiedAt, now, options.coolingOffMs);
    if (cooling.isCoolingOff) {
      return reply.code(403).send({
        error: 'wallet-cooling-off-active',
        message: `Newly linked wallet is in a 24-hour security cooling-off period (S4-12). ${cooling.hoursRemaining} hours remaining`,
        hoursRemaining: cooling.hoursRemaining
      });
    }

    // Cooldown guard: prevent rapid OTP overwrites and DoS
    const existingOtp = withdrawalOtps.get(scope.userId);
    if (existingOtp && existingOtp.expiresAt.getTime() > now.getTime()) {
      const remainingMs = existingOtp.expiresAt.getTime() - now.getTime();
      const elapsedMs = 15 * 60 * 1000 - remainingMs;
      if (elapsedMs < 60 * 1000) {
        return reply.code(429).send({
          error: 'otp-cooldown-active',
          message: 'Please wait at least 60 seconds before requesting a new withdrawal code'
        });
      }
    }

    // Generate cryptographically secure 6-digit OTP code with 15-minute validity (C-01 / S4-12)
    const otpCode = randomInt(100000, 1000000).toString();
    const expiresAt = new Date(now.getTime() + 15 * 60 * 1000);
    withdrawalOtps.set(scope.userId, {
      code: otpCode,
      expiresAt,
      destinationAddress,
      chainKind,
      attempts: 0
    });

    // Send confirmation code via email
    if (options.sendWithdrawalOtpEmail) {
      await options.sendWithdrawalOtpEmail(principal.user.email, otpCode);
    } else {
      const emailConfig = loadEmailConfigFromEnv();
      await sendEmail(
        {
          to: principal.user.email,
          subject: 'WAKE Withdrawal Confirmation Code',
          text: `Your withdrawal confirmation code is: ${otpCode}. It expires in 15 minutes. If you did not initiate this, please contact support immediately.`
        },
        emailConfig
      ).catch((err) => {
        request.log.error(err, 'Failed to deliver withdrawal OTP email');
      });
    }

    return reply.code(200).send({
      ok: true,
      message: 'Withdrawal confirmation OTP sent to registered email address'
    });
  });

  app.post('/v1/me/trading/withdraw', async (request, reply) => {
    const scope = requireUser(request, reply);
    if (!scope) return;
    const principal = request.principal;
    if (principal?.kind !== 'user') return reply.code(401).send({ error: 'Unauthorized' });

    const parsed = withdrawConfirmSchema.safeParse(request.body);
    if (!parsed.success) {
      return reply.code(400).send({ error: 'Invalid payload', details: parsed.error.issues });
    }

    const { destinationAddress, chainKind, amountUsd, otpCode } = parsed.data;

    // Verify linked wallet destination and cooling-off
    const linkedWallets = await listAuthWallets(scope);
    const linked = linkedWallets.find(
      (w) => w.chainKind === chainKind && isSameAddress(w.address, destinationAddress, chainKind)
    );

    if (!linked) {
      return reply.code(400).send({
        error: 'destination-not-linked-auth-wallet',
        message: 'Withdrawals are strictly permitted only to SIWE/SIWS verified linked auth wallets (S4-12)'
      });
    }

    const now = options.now?.() ?? new Date();
    const cooling = isWalletCoolingOff(linked.verifiedAt, now, options.coolingOffMs);
    if (cooling.isCoolingOff) {
      return reply.code(403).send({
        error: 'wallet-cooling-off-active',
        message: `Newly linked wallet is in a 24-hour security cooling-off period (S4-12). ${cooling.hoursRemaining} hours remaining`,
        hoursRemaining: cooling.hoursRemaining
      });
    }

    // Verify OTP code with brute-force lockout and constant-time comparison
    const storedOtp = withdrawalOtps.get(scope.userId);
    if (!storedOtp || storedOtp.expiresAt.getTime() <= now.getTime()) {
      return reply.code(400).send({
        error: 'invalid-or-expired-otp',
        message: 'Withdrawal confirmation code is invalid or has expired'
      });
    }

    if (storedOtp.attempts >= 5) {
      withdrawalOtps.delete(scope.userId);
      return reply.code(429).send({
        error: 'otp-attempts-exceeded',
        message: 'Too many incorrect attempts. Please request a new withdrawal code.'
      });
    }

    if (!isSameAddress(storedOtp.destinationAddress, destinationAddress, chainKind)) {
      return reply.code(400).send({
        error: 'destination-mismatch',
        message: 'Withdrawal code was requested for a different destination address'
      });
    }

    if (!constantTimeCodeMatch(storedOtp.code, otpCode)) {
      storedOtp.attempts += 1;
      const remainingAttempts = 5 - storedOtp.attempts;
      return reply.code(400).send({
        error: 'invalid-or-expired-otp',
        message: `Invalid withdrawal confirmation code. ${remainingAttempts} attempt(s) remaining.`
      });
    }

    // Burn OTP immediately (single use)
    withdrawalOtps.delete(scope.userId);

    return reply.code(200).send({
      status: 'confirmed',
      message: 'Withdrawal authorization verified and queued for execution',
      withdrawal: {
        userId: scope.userId,
        destinationAddress,
        chainKind,
        amountUsd,
        confirmedAt: now.toISOString()
      }
    });
  });

  // --- Polymarket Perpetual Futures (Perps) Endpoints ---

  app.get('/v1/me/perps/instruments', async (request, reply) => {
    const scope = requireUser(request, reply);
    if (!scope) return;
    const instruments = await getPerpsInstruments(true);
    return reply.send({ instruments });
  });

  app.get('/v1/me/perps/portfolio', async (request, reply) => {
    const scope = requireUser(request, reply);
    if (!scope) return;
    const [account, positions] = await Promise.all([
      getPerpsAccount(scope.userId),
      getUserPerpsPositions(scope.userId, 'open')
    ]);
    return reply.send({
      account: account ?? {
        user_id: scope.userId,
        total_account_value: '0',
        available_order_margin: '0',
        total_initial_margin: '0',
        total_maintenance_margin: '0',
        withdrawable: '0',
        in_liquidation: false
      },
      positions
    });
  });

  app.post('/v1/me/perps/positions/:id/close', async (request, reply) => {
    const scope = requireUser(request, reply);
    if (!scope) return;
    const { id } = request.params as { id: string };
    const success = await closePerpsPosition(id, scope.userId);
    if (!success) {
      return reply.code(404).send({ error: 'Position not found or already closed' });
    }
    return reply.send({ success: true, positionId: id, status: 'closed' });
  });
}

==> apps/api/src/trading-control.ts <==
import {
  activateAllChainEmergencyOff,
  resolveChainModes,
  setChainExecutionMode,
  type ChainModeResolution
} from '@swat/db';
import type { Chain, ExecutionMode } from '@swat/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';

export const tradingChains = ['solana', 'polygon', 'robinhood-chain', 'base', 'ethereum', 'bsc'] as const satisfies readonly Chain[];

const tradingChainSchema = z.enum(tradingChains);
const executionModeSchema = z.enum(['off', 'paper', 'live', 'live+shadow']);

export const executionModeUpdateSchema = z.object({
  chain: tradingChainSchema,
  mode: executionModeSchema
}).strict();

export interface TradingModeUpdate {
  chain: Chain;
  mode: ExecutionMode;
}

export interface TradingControlStatus {
  modes: Record<Chain, ChainModeResolution>;
  killSwitchActive: boolean;
}

export async function getTradingControlStatus(): Promise<TradingControlStatus> {
  const modes = await resolveChainModes(tradingChains);
  const killSwitchActive = tradingChains.every(
    (chain) => modes[chain].effectiveMode === 'off'
      && modes[chain].reason === 'Global kill switch active (*)'
  );

  return { modes, killSwitchActive };
}

export async function updateTradingMode(update: TradingModeUpdate): Promise<TradingControlStatus> {
  await setChainExecutionMode(update.chain, update.mode);
  return getTradingControlStatus();
}

export async function emergencyOff(): Promise<TradingControlStatus> {
  await activateAllChainEmergencyOff();
  return getTradingControlStatus();
}

==> apps/indexer/src/backfill-usd.ts <==
import { query } from '@swat/db';
import { fetchTokenPriceUsd, stripChainPrefix } from '@swat/shared';
import { baseUnitsToFloat } from './parse.js';

const SOL_MINT = 'So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112';
const USDC_MINT = 'EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v';

async function run() {
  console.log('[backfill-usd] Starting...');
  const txs = await query<{ id: string, token_in: string, token_out: string, amount_in: string, amount_out: string }>(
    `SELECT id, token_in, token_out, amount_in, amount_out
     FROM transactions
     WHERE amount_in_usd IS NULL OR amount_out_usd IS NULL`
  );

  console.log(`[backfill-usd] Found ${txs.length} transactions to update.`);

  // Fetch the SOL price ONCE for the whole run instead of per-row. If the price
  // feed is unavailable we skip SOL-leg rows rather than fabricating a value —
  // they stay NULL and a later run can fill them with a real price.
  const solPrice = await fetchTokenPriceUsd(SOL_MINT);
  if (solPrice === null) {
    console.warn('[backfill-usd] SOL price unavailable — SOL-leg rows will be skipped this run.');
  }

  let updated = 0;
  let skippedNoPrice = 0;
  let skippedUnsupported = 0;

  for (const tx of txs) {
    let amountInUsd: number | null = null;
    let amountOutUsd: number | null = null;

    const tokenIn = stripChainPrefix(tx.token_in);
    const tokenOut = stripChainPrefix(tx.token_out);

    if (tokenIn === SOL_MINT || tokenOut === SOL_MINT) {
      if (solPrice === null) { skippedNoPrice++; continue; }
      if (tokenIn === SOL_MINT) {
        amountInUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(tx.amount_in, 9) * solPrice;
        amountOutUsd = amountInUsd;
      } else {
        amountOutUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(tx.amount_out, 9) * solPrice;
        amountInUsd = amountOutUsd;
      }
    } else if (tokenIn === USDC_MINT) {
      amountInUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(tx.amount_in, 6);
      amountOutUsd = amountInUsd;
    } else if (tokenOut === USDC_MINT) {
      amountOutUsd = baseUnitsToFloat(tx.amount_out, 6);
      amountInUsd = amountOutUsd;
    } else {
      // Token↔token rows aren't priced by this script; count them so we don't
      // appear to have "finished" when some rows remain unenriched.
      skippedUnsupported++;
      continue;
    }

    if (amountInUsd !== null && amountOutUsd !== null) {
      await query(`UPDATE transactions SET amount_in_usd = $1, amount_out_usd = $2 WHERE id = $3`,
        [amountInUsd, amountOutUsd, tx.id]);
      updated++;
    }
  }

  console.log(`[backfill-usd] Complete. Updated ${updated}, skipped ${skippedNoPrice} (no SOL price), ${skippedUnsupported} (token↔token unsupported).`);
  process.exit(0);
}

run().catch(e => {
  console.error('[backfill-usd] Error:', e);
  process.exit(1);
});

import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

  skipped: 0,
  failed: 0,

describe('wallet backfill processor', () => {

    backfillSolana: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(result),
    backfillPolygon: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(result),
    backfillRobinhood: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(result),
    recordBatch: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined)
  };

    vi.clearAllMocks();
  });

      inserted: 1
    });

      data: { chain: 'unsupported', address: EVM_ADDRESS }
    })).rejects.toThrow(/Unsupported wallet backfill chain/);

    expect(dependencies.backfillSolana).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(dependencies.backfillPolygon).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(dependencies.backfillRobinhood).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

==> apps/indexer/src/backfill-worker.ts <==
import type { Job } from 'bullmq';
import type { RecordIngestionBatchInput } from '@swat/db';
import {
  isChain,
  resolveChainAddress,
  type Chain,
  type WalletBackfillJobData
} from '@swat/shared';
import { runTrackedIngestion, type IngestionBatchResult } from './ingestion-health.js';

type BatchRecorder = (input: RecordIngestionBatchInput) => Promise<void>;

export type WalletBackfillProcessorDependencies = {
  backfillSolana(address: string): Promise<IngestionBatchResult>;
  backfillPolygon(address: string): Promise<IngestionBatchResult>;
  backfillRobinhood(address: string): Promise<IngestionBatchResult>;
  recordBatch: BatchRecorder;
  sourceForChain?: (chain: Chain) => string;
};

export function getBackfillSource(chain: Chain): string {
  if (chain === 'solana') return 'solana-backfill';
  if (chain === 'polygon') return 'polymarket-data-api';
  return 'robinhood-evm';
}

export function createWalletBackfillProcessor(
  dependencies: WalletBackfillProcessorDependencies
) {
  return async (job: Pick<Job, 'data'>) => {
    const data = job.data as Partial<WalletBackfillJobData>;
    if (!isChain(data.chain)) {
      throw new Error(`Unsupported wallet backfill chain: ${String(data.chain)}`);
    }
    if (typeof data.address !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('Wallet backfill job is missing an address');
    }

    const resolved = resolveChainAddress(data.address, data.chain);
    const { chain, raw: address } = resolved;
    const source = dependencies.sourceForChain?.(chain) ?? getBackfillSource(chain);
    console.log(`[indexer] backfill started for ${address} (${chain})`);

    const result = await runTrackedIngestion({
      chain,
      source,
      run: () => {
        if (chain === 'solana') return dependencies.backfillSolana(address);
        if (chain === 'polygon') return dependencies.backfillPolygon(address);
        return dependencies.backfillRobinhood(address);
      }
    }, dependencies.recordBatch);

    console.log(`[indexer] backfill complete for ${address} (${chain}):`, result);

    // Immediate post-backfill scoring so trader metrics are created instantly
    try {
      const { getWalletMetrics, updateWalletScore } = await import('@swat/db');
      const { calculateCompositeScore, scoreToTier } = await import('@swat/shared');
      const metrics = await getWalletMetrics(resolved.prefixed, chain);
      const score = calculateCompositeScore(metrics);
      const tier = scoreToTier(score);
      await updateWalletScore(resolved.prefixed, score, tier, metrics);
      console.log(`[indexer] immediate post-backfill scoring complete for ${resolved.prefixed}: score=${score}, tier=${tier}`);
    } catch (scoreErr) {
      console.warn(`[indexer] post-backfill scoring deferred for ${resolved.prefixed}:`, scoreErr);
    }

    return { address, chain, ...result };
  };
}

import {
  encodeAbiParameters,
  encodeEventTopics,
  parseAbiItem,
  type Hex
} from 'viem';
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import {
  insertParsedTransaction,
  query,
  recordSourceTradeEvent,
  refreshWalletActivity,
  updateTokenLaunchTimestamp,
  upsertToken
} from '@swat/db';
import { backfillEvmWallet } from './evm.js';

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  fetchTokenPriceUsd: vi.fn(),
  publish: vi.fn()
}));

vi.mock('@swat/db', () => ({
  insertParsedTransaction: vi.fn(),
  query: vi.fn(),
  recordSourceTradeEvent: vi.fn(),
  refreshWalletActivity: vi.fn(),
  updateTokenLaunchTimestamp: vi.fn(),
  upsertToken: vi.fn()
}));

  ...await importOriginal<typeof import('@swat/shared')>(),
  fetchTokenPriceUsd: mocks.fetchTokenPriceUsd
}));

      return mocks.publish(channel, message);
    }
  }

const wallet = '0x1000000000000000000000000000000000000001';
const router = '0x2000000000000000000000000000000000000002';
const pool = '0x3000000000000000000000000000000000000003';
const base = '0x4000000000000000000000000000000000000004';
const token = '0x5000000000000000000000000000000000000005';
const transactionHash = `0x${'a'.repeat(64)}` as Hex;
const transferEvent = parseAbiItem(
  'event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)'
);
const swapEvent = parseAbiItem(
  'event Swap(address indexed sender, address indexed recipient, int256 amount0, int256 amount1, uint160 sqrtPriceX96, uint128 liquidity, int24 tick)'
);

function receiptTransfer(from: string, to: string, value: bigint, logIndex: number) {
  return {
    address: token,
    topics: encodeEventTopics({
      abi: [transferEvent],
      eventName: 'Transfer',
      args: { from, to }
    }),
    data: encodeAbiParameters([{ type: 'uint256' }], [value]),
    logIndex,
    transactionHash
  };
}

function receiptSwap(amount0: bigint, amount1: bigint) {
  return {
    address: pool,
    topics: encodeEventTopics({
      abi: [swapEvent],
      eventName: 'Swap',
      args: { sender: router, recipient: wallet }
    }),
    data: encodeAbiParameters([
      { type: 'int256' },
      { type: 'int256' },
      { type: 'uint160' },
      { type: 'uint128' },
      { type: 'int24' }
    ], [amount0, amount1, 1n, 1n, 0]),
    logIndex: 1,
    transactionHash
  };
}

function parsedTransfer(from: string, to: string, value: bigint) {
  return {
    address: token,
    transactionHash,
    logIndex: 2,
    blockNumber: 10n,
    transactionIndex: 0,
    args: { from, to, value }
  };
}

function clientFor(
  direction: 'buy' | 'sell' | 'rejected',
  walletTargetQuantity?: bigint
) {
  const targetQuantity = walletTargetQuantity ?? (direction === 'sell' ? 4_000n : 5_000n);
  const transfer = direction === 'buy'
    ? parsedTransfer(pool, wallet, targetQuantity)
    : parsedTransfer(wallet, pool, targetQuantity);
  const receiptLogs = direction === 'buy'
    ? [receiptSwap(1_000n, -5_000n), receiptTransfer(pool, wallet, targetQuantity, 2)]
    : direction === 'sell'
      ? [receiptSwap(-800n, 4_000n), receiptTransfer(wallet, pool, targetQuantity, 2)]
      : [receiptTransfer(pool, wallet, targetQuantity, 2)];

  return {
    getBlockNumber: vi.fn(async () => 10n),
    getLogs: vi.fn(async (input: { args?: { from?: string; to?: string } }) => {
      if (direction === 'buy') return input.args?.to ? [transfer] : [];
      return input.args?.from ? [transfer] : [];
    }),
    getBlock: vi.fn(async () => ({ timestamp: 1_760_000_000n })),
    getTransactionReceipt: vi.fn(async () => ({
      status: 'success' as const,
      from: wallet,
      to: router,
      logs: receiptLogs
    })),
    readContract: vi.fn(async (input: { functionName: string }) => {
      if (input.functionName === 'decimals') return 6;
      if (input.functionName === 'symbol') return 'TOKEN';
      return 'Fixture Token';
    })
  };
}

describe('Robinhood backfill source lifecycle', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    vi.stubEnv('EVM_BACKFILL_BLOCKS', '0');
    vi.stubEnv('EVM_LOG_CHUNK_SIZE', '2000');
    vi.stubEnv('ROBINHOOD_INGESTION_ROUTERS', router);
    vi.stubEnv('ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET', base);
    vi.stubEnv('ROBINHOOD_REVIEWED_POOLS_JSON', JSON.stringify([
      { address: pool, token0: base, token1: token }
    ]));
    vi.mocked(query).mockResolvedValue([]);
    vi.mocked(upsertToken).mockResolvedValue();
    vi.mocked(insertParsedTransaction).mockResolvedValue(true);
    vi.mocked(updateTokenLaunchTimestamp).mockResolvedValue();
    vi.mocked(refreshWalletActivity).mockResolvedValue();
    vi.mocked(recordSourceTradeEvent).mockResolvedValue({
      event: { id: 'source-robinhood-1' }
    } as Awaited<ReturnType<typeof recordSourceTradeEvent>>);
    mocks.fetchTokenPriceUsd.mockResolvedValue(null);
    mocks.publish.mockResolvedValue(1);
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllEnvs();
  });

  it.each([
    ['buy', '5000'],
    ['sell', '4000']
  ] as const)('persists a reviewed confirmed %s with exact target quantity', async (direction, quantity) => {
    const result = await backfillEvmWallet(wallet, 'robinhood-chain', {
      client: clientFor(direction) as never
    });

    expect(recordSourceTradeEvent).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      chain: 'robinhood-chain',
      sourceEventType: 'transaction',
      sourceEventId: transactionHash,
      walletAddress: wallet,
      tokenMint: token,
      side: direction,
      quantity,
      confirmationState: 'confirmed'
    }));
    expect(mocks.publish).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.any(String),
      expect.stringContaining('source-robinhood-1')
    );
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ fetched: 1, inserted: 1, skipped: 0, failed: 0 });
  });

  it('uses the wallet target-token transfer when it differs from the pool delta', async () => {
    const result = await backfillEvmWallet(wallet, 'robinhood-chain', {
      client: clientFor('buy', 4_900n) as never
    });

    expect(recordSourceTradeEvent).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
      side: 'buy',
      quantity: '4900'
    }));
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ fetched: 1, inserted: 1, skipped: 0, failed: 0 });
  });

  it('creates no source event for a rejected receipt', async () => {
    const result = await backfillEvmWallet(wallet, 'robinhood-chain', {
      client: clientFor('rejected') as never
    });

    expect(recordSourceTradeEvent).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(insertParsedTransaction).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ fetched: 1, inserted: 0, skipped: 1, failed: 0 });
  });

  it('repairs lifecycle persistence when the legacy transaction is already present', async () => {
    vi.mocked(insertParsedTransaction).mockResolvedValueOnce(false);

    const result = await backfillEvmWallet(wallet, 'robinhood-chain', {
      client: clientFor('buy') as never
    });

    expect(recordSourceTradeEvent).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(mocks.publish).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ fetched: 1, inserted: 0, skipped: 1, failed: 0 });
  });

  it('fails the batch when lifecycle persistence fails without publishing the swap', async () => {
    vi.mocked(recordSourceTradeEvent).mockRejectedValueOnce(
      new Error('canonical lifecycle unavailable')
    );

    await expect(backfillEvmWallet(wallet, 'robinhood-chain', {
      client: clientFor('buy') as never
    })).rejects.toMatchObject({
      name: 'IngestionBatchError',
      result: { fetched: 1, inserted: 0, skipped: 0, failed: 1 }
    });

    expect(recordSourceTradeEvent).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(mocks.publish).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

==> apps/indexer/src/evm.ts <==
import {
  createPublicClient,
  erc20Abi,
  http,
  parseAbiItem,
  type PublicClient
} from 'viem';
import { polygon } from 'viem/chains';
import { Redis } from 'ioredis';
import { Queue } from 'bullmq';
import {
  query,
  upsertToken,
  upsertWallet,
  insertParsedTransaction,
  updateTokenLaunchTimestamp,
  refreshWalletActivity,
  logDiscoveryRun
} from '@swat/db';
import {
  prefixChainValue,
  REDIS_CHANNELS,
  QUEUES,
  createWalletBackfillJob,
  resolveChainValue,
  fetchTokenPriceUsd,
  type Chain
} from '@swat/shared';
import {
  IngestionBatchError,
  type IngestionBatchResult
} from './ingestion-health.js';
import {
  classifyRobinhoodReceipt,
  parseRobinhoodIngestionConfig,
  type RobinhoodClassifiedSwap
} from './robinhood-ingestion.js';
import {
  persistRobinhoodSourceTrade,
  SourceTradePersistenceError
} from './source-trade-lifecycle.js';

export type WalletChain = Chain;

const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL ?? 'redis://localhost:6379';
const redis = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
const NATIVE_TOKEN = '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000';

const BASE_TOKENS: Record<string, Set<string>> = {
  polygon: new Set([
    '0x0d500B1d8E8eF31E21C99d1Db9A6444d3ADf1270'.toLowerCase(), // WMATIC
    '0x3c499c542cEF5E3811e1192ce70d8cC03d5c3359'.toLowerCase(), // USDC (native)
    '0x2791Bca1f2de4661ED88A30C99A7a9449Aa84174'.toLowerCase(), // USDC (bridged)
    '0xc2132D05D31c914a87C6611C10748AEb04B58e8F'.toLowerCase(), // USDT
    '0x7ceB23fD6bC0adD59E62ac25578270cFf1b9f619'.toLowerCase(), // WETH
  ]),
  'robinhood-chain': new Set()
};

function getBaseTokens(chain: WalletChain): Set<string> {
  const set = new Set(BASE_TOKENS[chain] ?? []);
  if (chain === 'robinhood-chain' && process.env.ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET) {
    set.add(process.env.ROBINHOOD_BASE_ASSET.toLowerCase());
  }
  return set;
}

function isBaseToken(address: string, _symbol: string, chain: WalletChain): boolean {
  const addr = address.toLowerCase();
  // H-18: Verify base-asset identity strictly by contract address, never spoofable symbol
  return getBaseTokens(chain).has(addr);
}

// Instantiate clients
function getPublicClient(chain: WalletChain): PublicClient {
  if (chain === 'polygon') {
    const url = process.env.POLYGON_RPC_URL ?? 'https://polygon-bor-rpc.publicnode.com';
    return createPublicClient({ chain: polygon, transport: http(url) });
  } else if (chain === 'robinhood-chain') {
    const url = process.env.ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL ?? 'https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com';
    // The chain ID is a deployment fact verified by the executor startup gate. The
    // indexer intentionally does not embed an unreviewed chain definition.
    return createPublicClient({ transport: http(url) });
  }
  throw new Error(`Unsupported chain: ${chain}`);
}

export type EvmBackfillDependencies = {
  client?: PublicClient;
  publish?: (channel: string, message: string) => Promise<unknown>;
};

async function fetchEvmTokenMetadata(client: any, tokenAddress: `0x${string}`, chain: WalletChain) {
  try {
    const [decimals, name, symbol] = await Promise.all([
      client.readContract({
        address: tokenAddress,
        abi: erc20Abi,
        functionName: 'decimals'
      }).catch(() => null),
      client.readContract({
        address: tokenAddress,
        abi: erc20Abi,
        functionName: 'name'
      }).catch(() => 'Unknown'),
      client.readContract({
        address: tokenAddress,
        abi: erc20Abi,
        functionName: 'symbol'
      }).catch(() => 'UNKNOWN')
    ]);
    if (decimals === null) return null;
    return { decimals: Number(decimals), name: String(name), symbol: String(symbol) };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

const tokenMetadataCache = new Map<string, { decimals: number; symbol: string; name: string }>();

async function getEvmTokenMetadata(client: any, tokenAddress: `0x${string}`, chain: WalletChain) {
  const addr = tokenAddress.toLowerCase();
  const cacheKey = `${chain}:${addr}`;
  if (tokenMetadataCache.has(cacheKey)) return tokenMetadataCache.get(cacheKey)!;

  // Try DB first
  const dbRows = await query<{ decimals: number | null; symbol: string | null; name: string | null }>(
    `SELECT decimals, symbol, name FROM tokens WHERE mint = $1 AND chain = $2`,
    [prefixChainValue(addr, chain), chain]
  );
  if (dbRows.length > 0 && dbRows[0].decimals !== null) {
    const meta = {
      decimals: dbRows[0].decimals,
      symbol: dbRows[0].symbol ?? 'UNKNOWN',
      name: dbRows[0].name ?? 'Unknown'
    };
    tokenMetadataCache.set(cacheKey, meta);
    return meta;
  }

  // Fallback to contract read
  const meta = await fetchEvmTokenMetadata(client, tokenAddress, chain);
  if (!meta) return null;
  
  // Upsert into tokens table
  await upsertToken(addr, {
    chain,
    decimals: meta.decimals,
    symbol: meta.symbol,
    name: meta.name
  });

  tokenMetadataCache.set(cacheKey, meta);
  return meta;
}

export async function backfillEvmWallet(
  address: string,
  chain: 'polygon' | 'robinhood-chain',
  dependencies: EvmBackfillDependencies = {}
): Promise<IngestionBatchResult> {
  const normalizedAddress = resolveChainValue(address, chain).raw;
  const client = dependencies.client ?? getPublicClient(chain);
  const publish = dependencies.publish
    ?? ((channel: string, message: string) => redis.publish(channel, message));
  const currentBlock = await client.getBlockNumber();
  const blockWindow = BigInt(process.env.EVM_BACKFILL_BLOCKS ?? '100000');
  const logChunkSize = BigInt(process.env.EVM_LOG_CHUNK_SIZE ?? '2000');
  if (logChunkSize <= 0n) throw new Error('EVM_LOG_CHUNK_SIZE must be positive');
  const fromBlock = currentBlock - blockWindow > 0n ? currentBlock - blockWindow : 0n;

  console.log(`[indexer] EVM backfill querying logs for ${normalizedAddress} on ${chain} from block ${fromBlock}`);

  const transferEvent = parseAbiItem('event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)');

  const collectedLogs: any[] = [];
  for (let chunkStart = fromBlock; chunkStart <= currentBlock; chunkStart += logChunkSize) {
    const chunkEnd = chunkStart + logChunkSize - 1n > currentBlock
      ? currentBlock
      : chunkStart + logChunkSize - 1n;
    const [sentLogs, receivedLogs] = await Promise.all([
      client.getLogs({
        event: transferEvent,
        args: { from: normalizedAddress as `0x${string}` },
        fromBlock: chunkStart,
        toBlock: chunkEnd
      }),
      client.getLogs({
        event: transferEvent,
        args: { to: normalizedAddress as `0x${string}` },
        fromBlock: chunkStart,
        toBlock: chunkEnd
      })
    ]);
    collectedLogs.push(...sentLogs, ...receivedLogs);
  }

  const dedupedLogs = new Map<string, any>();
  for (const log of collectedLogs) {
    const key = `${log.transactionHash}:${log.logIndex}`;
    dedupedLogs.set(key, log);
  }
  const allLogs = [...dedupedLogs.values()].sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.blockNumber !== b.blockNumber) {
      return Number(a.blockNumber! - b.blockNumber!);
    }
    return Number(a.transactionIndex! - b.transactionIndex!);
  });

  const logsByTx = new Map<string, typeof allLogs>();
  for (const log of allLogs) {
    const hash = log.transactionHash!;
    if (!logsByTx.has(hash)) {
      logsByTx.set(hash, []);
    }
    logsByTx.get(hash)!.push(log);
  }

  console.log(`[indexer] EVM backfill found ${logsByTx.size} unique transactions for ${normalizedAddress}`);

  let inserted = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  let latestBlockTime: number | null = null;
  let lastEventAt: Date | null = null;
  let sourceTradeFailure: SourceTradePersistenceError | null = null;

  const blockCache = new Map<bigint, number>();
  async function getBlockTimestamp(blockNumber: bigint) {
    if (blockCache.has(blockNumber)) return blockCache.get(blockNumber)!;
    const block = await client.getBlock({ blockNumber });
    const ts = Number(block.timestamp);
    blockCache.set(blockNumber, ts);
    return ts;
  }

  const BATCH_SIZE = Number(process.env.BACKFILL_BATCH_SIZE ?? 5);
  const txHashes = Array.from(logsByTx.keys());

  for (let i = 0; i < txHashes.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    const batch = txHashes.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);
    
    await Promise.all(batch.map(async (hash) => {
      try {
        const txLogs = logsByTx.get(hash)!;
        const firstLog = txLogs[0];
        const blockNumber = firstLog.blockNumber!;
        const blockTime = await getBlockTimestamp(blockNumber);
        const timestamp = new Date(blockTime * 1000);
        if (!lastEventAt || timestamp > lastEventAt) lastEventAt = timestamp;

        const receipt = await client.getTransactionReceipt({ hash: hash as `0x${string}` });

        let reviewedRobinhoodSwap: RobinhoodClassifiedSwap | null = null;
        if (chain === 'robinhood-chain') {
          let ingestionConfig;
          try {
            ingestionConfig = parseRobinhoodIngestionConfig();
          } catch (error) {
            console.warn('[indexer] Robinhood reviewed router/pool configuration is unavailable:', error);
            skipped++;
            return;
          }
          const classification = classifyRobinhoodReceipt({
            status: receipt.status,
            from: receipt.from,
            to: receipt.to,
            transactionHash: hash,
            logs: receipt.logs.map((log) => ({
              address: log.address,
              data: log.data,
              topics: log.topics,
              logIndex: log.logIndex,
              transactionHash: log.transactionHash
            }))
          }, normalizedAddress, ingestionConfig);
          if (classification.status === 'rejected') {
            skipped++;
            return;
          }
          reviewedRobinhoodSwap = classification;
        }

        // Separate user's transfers
        const userSent: Array<{ token: string; amount: bigint; decimals: number; symbol: string; name: string }> = [];
        const userReceived: Array<{ token: string; amount: bigint; decimals: number; symbol: string; name: string }> = [];

        for (const log of txLogs) {
          const meta = await getEvmTokenMetadata(client, log.address, chain);
          if (!meta) continue;
          const amount = log.args.value ? BigInt(log.args.value) : 0n;
          const from = log.args.from?.toLowerCase();
          const to = log.args.to?.toLowerCase();
          if (from === normalizedAddress && to === normalizedAddress) continue;
          
          if (from === normalizedAddress) {
            userSent.push({ token: log.address.toLowerCase(), amount, ...meta });
          }
          if (to === normalizedAddress) {
            userReceived.push({ token: log.address.toLowerCase(), amount, ...meta });
          }
        }

        // Determine tokenIn, tokenOut, direction, targetToken
        let tokenIn = '';
        let tokenOut = '';
        let amountIn = '0';
        let amountOut = '0';
        let direction: 'buy' | 'sell' = 'buy';
        let targetToken = '';
        let targetDecimals: number | null = null;

        if (reviewedRobinhoodSwap) {
          tokenIn = reviewedRobinhoodSwap.tokenIn;
          tokenOut = reviewedRobinhoodSwap.tokenOut;
          amountIn = reviewedRobinhoodSwap.amountIn.toString();
          amountOut = reviewedRobinhoodSwap.amountOut.toString();
          direction = reviewedRobinhoodSwap.direction;
          targetToken = reviewedRobinhoodSwap.targetToken;
          const targetMetadata = await getEvmTokenMetadata(
            client,
            targetToken as `0x${string}`,
            chain
          );
          if (!targetMetadata) {
            skipped++;
            return;
          }
          targetDecimals = targetMetadata.decimals;
        } else if (userSent.length > 0 && userReceived.length > 0) {
          // Cross-token swap
          const sentBase = userSent.find(s => isBaseToken(s.token, s.symbol, chain));
          const receivedBase = userReceived.find(r => isBaseToken(r.token, r.symbol, chain));

          if (sentBase && !receivedBase) {
            // Sent base, received speculative => Buy
            const spec = userReceived[0];
            tokenIn = sentBase.token;
            tokenOut = spec.token;
            amountIn = sentBase.amount.toString();
            amountOut = spec.amount.toString();
            targetToken = spec.token;
            direction = 'buy';
          } else if (!sentBase && receivedBase) {
            // Sent speculative, received base => Sell
            const spec = userSent[0];
            tokenIn = spec.token;
            tokenOut = receivedBase.token;
            amountIn = spec.amount.toString();
            amountOut = receivedBase.amount.toString();
            targetToken = spec.token;
            direction = 'sell';
          } else {
            // Arbitrary swap
            const sent = userSent[0];
            const received = userReceived[0];
            tokenIn = sent.token;
            tokenOut = received.token;
            amountIn = sent.amount.toString();
            amountOut = received.amount.toString();
            targetToken = received.token;
            direction = 'buy';
          }
        } else if (userReceived.length > 0) {
          // Received token only, check for native value
          const spec = userReceived[0];
          const tx = await client.getTransaction({ hash: hash as `0x${string}` });
          if (tx.value > 0n) {
            tokenIn = NATIVE_TOKEN;
            tokenOut = spec.token;
            amountIn = tx.value.toString();
            amountOut = spec.amount.toString();
            targetToken = spec.token;
            direction = 'buy';
          } else {
            // Airdrop or simple transfer
            tokenIn = NATIVE_TOKEN;
            tokenOut = spec.token;
            amountIn = '0';
            amountOut = spec.amount.toString();
            targetToken = spec.token;
            direction = 'buy';
          }
        } else if (userSent.length > 0) {
          // Sent token only, check if they received base token (from receipt logs)
          const spec = userSent[0];
          
          let receivedBaseFromReceipt: { token: string; amount: bigint } | undefined;
          for (const log of receipt.logs) {
            // Check for Transfer log
            if (log.topics[0] === '0xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef') {
              const toAddress = log.topics[2] ? '0x' + log.topics[2].substring(26) : '';
              if (toAddress.toLowerCase() === normalizedAddress) {
                const meta = await getEvmTokenMetadata(client, log.address, chain);
                if (!meta) continue;
                if (isBaseToken(log.address, meta.symbol, chain)) {
                  // Found the base transfer!
                  const amount = log.data ? BigInt(log.data) : 0n;
                  receivedBaseFromReceipt = { token: log.address.toLowerCase(), amount };
                  break;
                }
              }
            }
          }

          if (receivedBaseFromReceipt) {
            tokenIn = spec.token;
            tokenOut = receivedBaseFromReceipt.token;
            amountIn = spec.amount.toString();
            amountOut = receivedBaseFromReceipt.amount.toString();
            targetToken = spec.token;
            direction = 'sell';
          } else {
            // Simple send
            tokenIn = spec.token;
            tokenOut = NATIVE_TOKEN;
            amountIn = spec.amount.toString();
            amountOut = '0';
            targetToken = spec.token;
            direction = 'sell';
          }
        } else {
          skipped++;
          return;
        }

        // Fetch target token USD price (from DexScreener if available)
        const targetPrice = await fetchTokenPriceUsd(
          prefixChainValue(targetToken, chain)
        ).catch(() => null);
        let amountInUsd: number | null = null;
        let amountOutUsd: number | null = null;

        if (targetPrice) {
          const specDecimals = targetDecimals ?? (direction === 'buy'
            ? (userReceived.find(r => r.token === targetToken)?.decimals ?? 18)
            : (userSent.find(s => s.token === targetToken)?.decimals ?? 18));
          
          const specAmount = direction === 'buy' ? amountOut : amountIn;
          const floatAmount = Number(BigInt(specAmount)) / (10 ** specDecimals);
          const usdVal = floatAmount * targetPrice;
          amountInUsd = usdVal;
          amountOutUsd = usdVal;
        }

        if (tokenIn === NATIVE_TOKEN || tokenOut === NATIVE_TOKEN) {
          await upsertToken(NATIVE_TOKEN, {
            chain,
            decimals: 18,
            symbol: chain === 'polygon' ? 'POL' : 'ETH',
            name: chain === 'polygon' ? 'Polygon' : 'Ether'
          });
        }

        const persisted = await insertParsedTransaction({
          signature: hash,
          chain,
          walletAddress: normalizedAddress,
          tokenIn,
          tokenOut,
          amountIn,
          amountOut,
          amountInUsd,
          amountOutUsd,
          direction,
          targetToken,
          programId: reviewedRobinhoodSwap ? 'uniswap-v3-reviewed' : 'uniswap',
          slot: Number(blockNumber),
          timestamp,
          blockTime
        });

        const walletTargetQuantity = (direction === 'buy' ? userReceived : userSent)
          .filter((transfer) => transfer.token === targetToken)
          .reduce((total, transfer) => total + transfer.amount, 0n);
        if (reviewedRobinhoodSwap && walletTargetQuantity <= 0n) {
          throw new Error('Reviewed Robinhood swap has no target-token wallet transfer');
        }
        const sourceTrade = reviewedRobinhoodSwap
          ? await persistRobinhoodSourceTrade({
            transactionHash: hash,
            walletAddress: normalizedAddress,
            tokenMint: targetToken,
            side: direction,
            quantity: walletTargetQuantity.toString(),
            eventAt: timestamp,
            blockNumber
          })
          : null;

        if (persisted) {
          inserted++;
          if (!latestBlockTime || blockTime > latestBlockTime) {
            latestBlockTime = blockTime;
          }

          await updateTokenLaunchTimestamp(targetToken, timestamp, chain);

          // Publish Swap event to Redis
          await publish(
            REDIS_CHANNELS.walletSwap,
            JSON.stringify({
              chain,
              walletAddress: prefixChainValue(normalizedAddress, chain),
              signature: hash,
              sourceTradeId: sourceTrade?.event.id,
              tokenMint: prefixChainValue(targetToken, chain),
              direction,
              amountUsd: amountInUsd,
              timestamp: timestamp.toISOString()
            })
          );
        } else {
          skipped++;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn(`[indexer] Failed to process EVM transaction ${hash}:`, err);
        failed++;
        if (err instanceof SourceTradePersistenceError) {
          sourceTradeFailure ??= err;
        }
      }
    }));
  }

  const result = {
    fetched: txHashes.length,
    inserted,
    skipped,
    failed,
    lastEventAt
  };

  try {
    await refreshWalletActivity(
      prefixChainValue(normalizedAddress, chain),
      latestBlockTime ? new Date(latestBlockTime * 1000) : null,
      inserted
    );
  } catch (error) {
    throw new IngestionBatchError(
      `Failed to refresh ${chain} wallet activity for ${normalizedAddress}`,
      { ...result, failed: result.failed + 1 },
      { cause: error }
    );
  }
  if (sourceTradeFailure) {
    throw new IngestionBatchError(
      `Canonical ${chain} source-trade persistence failed for ${normalizedAddress}`,
      result,
      { cause: sourceTradeFailure }
    );
  }
  return result;
}

/**
 * Discover and seed early & big buyers of an EVM ERC-20 token on Robinhood Chain or Polygon.
 */
export async function discoverFromEvmToken(
  tokenAddress: string,
  chain: 'polygon' | 'robinhood-chain',
  dependencies: EvmBackfillDependencies & { backfillQueue?: Queue } = {}
): Promise<{ earlyBuyers: number; bigBuyers: number; scanned: number }> {
  const normalizedAddress = resolveChainValue(tokenAddress, chain).raw.toLowerCase() as `0x${string}`;
  const client = dependencies.client ?? getPublicClient(chain);
  const currentBlock = await client.getBlockNumber();
  const blockWindow = BigInt(process.env.EVM_BACKFILL_BLOCKS ?? '100000');
  const logChunkSize = BigInt(process.env.EVM_LOG_CHUNK_SIZE ?? '2000');
  const fromBlock = currentBlock - blockWindow > 0n ? currentBlock - blockWindow : 0n;

  // Metadata retrieval & caching
  try {
    await getEvmTokenMetadata(client, normalizedAddress, chain);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`[indexer] Failed to fetch EVM token metadata for ${normalizedAddress} on ${chain}:`, err);
  }

  console.log(`[indexer] EVM token discovery querying Transfer logs for ${normalizedAddress} on ${chain} from block ${fromBlock}`);

  const transferEvent = parseAbiItem('event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value)');
  const collectedLogs: any[] = [];
  for (let chunkStart = fromBlock; chunkStart <= currentBlock; chunkStart += logChunkSize) {
    const chunkEnd = chunkStart + logChunkSize - 1n > currentBlock
      ? currentBlock
      : chunkStart + logChunkSize - 1n;
    try {
      const logs = await client.getLogs({
        address: normalizedAddress,
        event: transferEvent,
        fromBlock: chunkStart,
        toBlock: chunkEnd
      });
      collectedLogs.push(...logs);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`[indexer] EVM token discovery chunk failed (${chunkStart}-${chunkEnd}):`, err);
    }
  }

  // Aggregate per buyer: earliest blockNumber + total base units acquired
  type Agg = { earliestBlock: bigint; amount: bigint };
  const buyers = new Map<string, Agg>();

  for (const log of collectedLogs) {
    const to = (log.args?.to as string | undefined)?.toLowerCase();
    const value = log.args?.value as bigint | undefined;
    if (!to || !value || to === NATIVE_TOKEN || to === normalizedAddress) continue;
    if (to === '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000') continue;

    const blockNum = log.blockNumber ?? currentBlock;
    const cur = buyers.get(to);
    if (cur) {
      cur.amount += value;
      if (blockNum < cur.earliestBlock) cur.earliestBlock = blockNum;
    } else {
      buyers.set(to, { earliestBlock: blockNum, amount: value });
    }
  }

  const entries = Array.from(buyers.entries());
  const byEarliest = [...entries].sort((a, b) => (a[1].earliestBlock < b[1].earliestBlock ? -1 : a[1].earliestBlock > b[1].earliestBlock ? 1 : 0));
  const early = byEarliest.slice(0, 40).map(([owner]) => owner);
  const earlySet = new Set(early);

  const byAmount = [...entries]
    .filter(([owner]) => !earlySet.has(owner))
    .sort((a, b) => (b[1].amount > a[1].amount ? -1 : b[1].amount < a[1].amount ? 1 : 0));
  const big = byAmount.slice(0, 10).map(([owner]) => owner);

  const targetQueue = dependencies.backfillQueue ?? new Queue(QUEUES.walletBackfill, { connection: redis });

  for (const owner of early) {
    await upsertWallet({ address: owner, chain, source: 'discovered', discoveryMethod: 'token-early' });
    const job = createWalletBackfillJob(owner, chain);
    await targetQueue.add(job.name, job.data, job.options);
  }
  for (const owner of big) {
    await upsertWallet({ address: owner, chain, source: 'discovered', discoveryMethod: 'token-big' });
    const job = createWalletBackfillJob(owner, chain);
    await targetQueue.add(job.name, job.data, job.options);
  }

  await logDiscoveryRun('token', normalizedAddress, early.length + big.length);
  await redis.publish(REDIS_CHANNELS.clusterRefresh, JSON.stringify({ reason: 'token-discovery', mint: normalizedAddress, chain }));

  console.log(`[indexer] EVM token ${normalizedAddress} on ${chain}: seeded ${early.length} early + ${big.length} big buyers from ${buyers.size} candidates`);
  return { earlyBuyers: early.length, bigBuyers: big.length, scanned: collectedLogs.length };
}

import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { Queue, QueueEvents, Worker, type Job } from 'bullmq';
import { Redis } from 'ioredis';
import {

const BASE58_ALPHABET = '123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';

function encodeBase58(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  let value = BigInt(`0x${Buffer.from(bytes).toString('hex')}`);
  let encoded = '';
  while (value > 0n) {
    encoded = BASE58_ALPHABET[Number(value % 58n)] + encoded;
    value /= 58n;
  }
  for (const byte of bytes) {
    if (byte !== 0) break;
    encoded = `1${encoded}`;
  }
  return encoded || '1';
}

type Fixture = {
  chain: Chain;
  address: string;
  signature: string;
  tokenIn: string;
  tokenOut: string;
  targetToken: string;
};

function createFixtures(runId: string): Fixture[] {
  const evmAddress = () => `0x${randomBytes(20).toString('hex')}`;
  return [
    {
      chain: 'solana',
      address: encodeBase58(randomBytes(32)),
      signature: `${runId}-solana`,
      tokenIn: encodeBase58(randomBytes(32)),
      tokenOut: encodeBase58(randomBytes(32)),
      targetToken: encodeBase58(randomBytes(32))
    },
    {
      chain: 'polygon',
      address: evmAddress(),
      signature: `${runId}-polygon`,
      tokenIn: evmAddress(),
      tokenOut: evmAddress(),
      targetToken: evmAddress()
    },
    {
      chain: 'robinhood-chain',
      address: evmAddress(),
      signature: `${runId}-robinhood`,
      tokenIn: evmAddress(),
      tokenOut: evmAddress(),
      targetToken: evmAddress()
    }
  ];
}

export async function runG0D11Acceptance(): Promise<void> {
  const runId = `g0d11-${Date.now()}-${randomBytes(4).toString('hex')}`;
  const fixtures = createFixtures(runId);
  const fixtureByWallet = new Map(
    fixtures.map((fixture) => [`${fixture.chain}:${fixture.address.toLowerCase()}`, fixture])
  );
  const executionCounts = new Map<Chain, number>();
  const redisUrl = process.env.REDIS_URL ?? 'redis://localhost:6379';
  const queueName = `${QUEUES.walletBackfill}-acceptance-${runId}`;
  const queueConnection = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
  const eventsConnection = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
  const workerConnection = new Redis(redisUrl, { maxRetriesPerRequest: null });
  const queue = new Queue(queueName, { connection: queueConnection });
  const queueEvents = new QueueEvents(queueName, { connection: eventsConnection });
  let worker: Worker | null = null;
  const jobs: Job[] = [];
  let passSummary: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
  let primaryError: unknown;

  const backfillFixture = async (address: string, chain: Chain): Promise<IngestionBatchResult> => {
    const fixture = fixtureByWallet.get(`${chain}:${address.toLowerCase()}`);
    if (!fixture) throw new Error(`No ${chain} acceptance fixture for ${address}`);
    executionCounts.set(chain, (executionCounts.get(chain) ?? 0) + 1);

    await Promise.all([
      upsertToken(fixture.tokenIn, { chain, decimals: 6, symbol: 'G0IN' }),
      upsertToken(fixture.tokenOut, { chain, decimals: 6, symbol: 'G0OUT' }),
      upsertToken(fixture.targetToken, { chain, decimals: 6, symbol: 'G0TARGET' })
    ]);
    const eventAt = new Date();
    const inserted = await insertParsedTransaction({
      chain,
      signature: fixture.signature,
      walletAddress: fixture.address,
      tokenIn: fixture.tokenIn,
      tokenOut: fixture.tokenOut,
      amountIn: '1000000',
      amountOut: '2000000',
      amountInUsd: 1,
      amountOutUsd: 2,
      direction: 'buy',
      targetToken: fixture.targetToken,
      programId: 'g0-d11-fixture',
      timestamp: eventAt,
      blockTime: Math.floor(eventAt.getTime() / 1000)
    });
    await refreshWalletActivity(
      resolveChainAddress(fixture.address, chain).prefixed,
      eventAt,
      inserted ? 1 : 0
    );
    return {
      fetched: 1,
      inserted: inserted ? 1 : 0,
      skipped: inserted ? 0 : 1,
      failed: 0,
      lastEventAt: eventAt
    };
  };

  try {
    await queueEvents.waitUntilReady();
    const [existingWorkers, existingJobs] = await Promise.all([
      queue.getWorkers(),
      queue.getJobs(['active', 'waiting', 'delayed', 'prioritized', 'waiting-children'])
    ]);
    if (existingWorkers.length > 0 || existingJobs.length > 0) {
      const jobSummary = await Promise.all(existingJobs.map(async (job) => ({
        id: job.id,
        state: await job.getState()
      })));
      throw new Error(
        `Backfill queue is not isolated: ${JSON.stringify({
          workers: existingWorkers.map((workerInfo) => ({
            id: workerInfo.id,
            name: workerInfo.name
          })),
          jobs: jobSummary
        })}`
      );
    }

    for (const fixture of fixtures) {
      await upsertWallet({
        address: fixture.address,
        chain: fixture.chain,
        source: 'discovered',
        discoveryMethod: 'g0-d11-acceptance'
      });
      const spec = createWalletBackfillJob(fixture.address, fixture.chain);
      const first = await queue.add(spec.name, spec.data, spec.options);
      const duplicate = await queue.add(spec.name, spec.data, spec.options);
      if (first.id !== spec.options.jobId || duplicate.id !== first.id) {
        throw new Error(`Queue did not deduplicate ${fixture.chain} job ${spec.options.jobId}`);
      }
      jobs.push(first);
    }

    const queuedIds = new Set(
      (await queue.getJobs(['waiting', 'prioritized'])).map((job) => job.id)
    );
    if (queuedIds.size !== jobs.length || jobs.some((job) => !queuedIds.has(job.id))) {
      throw new Error(`Expected ${jobs.length} unique queued jobs before worker startup`);
    }

    const waits = jobs.map((job) => job.waitUntilFinished(queueEvents, 30_000));
    const processor = createWalletBackfillProcessor({
      backfillSolana: (address) => backfillFixture(address, 'solana'),
      backfillPolygon: (address) => backfillFixture(address, 'polygon'),
      backfillRobinhood: (address) => backfillFixture(address, 'robinhood-chain'),
      recordBatch: async () => {},
      sourceForChain: (chain) => `g0-d11-acceptance-${chain}`
    });
    worker = new Worker(queueName, processor, {
      connection: workerConnection,
      concurrency: 1
    });
    await worker.waitUntilReady();
    const results = await Promise.all(waits);

    for (const fixture of fixtures) {
      if (executionCounts.get(fixture.chain) !== 1) {
        throw new Error(`${fixture.chain} fixture executed ${executionCounts.get(fixture.chain) ?? 0} times`);
      }
    }
    if (results.some((result) => result.inserted !== 1 || result.failed !== 0)) {
      throw new Error(`Backfill results were not successful: ${JSON.stringify(results)}`);
    }

    const signatures = fixtures.map((fixture) => fixture.signature);
    const transactions = await query<{
      chain: Chain;
      signature: string;
      wallet_address: string;
    }>(
      `SELECT chain, signature, wallet_address
         FROM transactions
        WHERE signature = ANY($1::varchar[])
        ORDER BY chain`,
      [signatures]
    );
    if (transactions.length !== fixtures.length) {
      throw new Error(`Expected ${fixtures.length} transaction rows, found ${transactions.length}`);
    }
    for (const fixture of fixtures) {
      const expectedWallet = resolveChainAddress(fixture.address, fixture.chain).prefixed;
      const transaction = transactions.find((row) => row.signature === fixture.signature);
      if (transaction?.chain !== fixture.chain || transaction.wallet_address !== expectedWallet) {
        throw new Error(`Transaction identity mismatch for ${fixture.chain}`);
      }
    }

    passSummary = {
      runId,
      queueName,
      deduplicatedJobs: jobs.map((job) => job.id),
      transactions: transactions.map((row) => ({
        chain: row.chain,
        signature: row.signature,
        walletAddress: row.wallet_address
      }))
    };
  } catch (error) {
    primaryError = error;
  }

  const cleanupErrors: Error[] = [];
  const cleanupStep = async (label: string, action: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<void> => {
    try {
      await action();
    } catch (error) {
      cleanupErrors.push(new Error(`G0-D11 cleanup failed: ${label}`, { cause: error }));
    }
  };

  await cleanupStep('close worker', async () => {
    await worker?.close();
  });
  await cleanupStep('obliterate isolated queue', async () => {
    await queue.obliterate({ force: true });
  });

  const signatures = fixtures.map((fixture) => fixture.signature);
  const tokenMints = fixtures.flatMap((fixture) => [
    resolveChainValue(fixture.tokenIn, fixture.chain).prefixed,
    resolveChainValue(fixture.tokenOut, fixture.chain).prefixed,
    resolveChainValue(fixture.targetToken, fixture.chain).prefixed
  ]);
  const walletAddresses = fixtures.map((fixture) =>
    resolveChainAddress(fixture.address, fixture.chain).prefixed
  );
  await cleanupStep('delete transaction fixtures', async () => {
    await query('DELETE FROM transactions WHERE signature = ANY($1::varchar[])', [signatures]);
  });
  await cleanupStep('delete token fixtures', async () => {
    await query('DELETE FROM tokens WHERE mint = ANY($1::varchar[])', [tokenMints]);
  });
  await cleanupStep('delete wallet fixtures', async () => {
    await query('DELETE FROM wallets WHERE address = ANY($1::varchar[])', [walletAddresses]);
  });
  await cleanupStep('verify database fixture cleanup', async () => {
    const [counts] = await query<{
      transaction_count: string;
      token_count: string;
      wallet_count: string;
    }>(
      `SELECT
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE signature = ANY($1::varchar[])) AS transaction_count,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tokens WHERE mint = ANY($2::varchar[])) AS token_count,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wallets WHERE address = ANY($3::varchar[])) AS wallet_count`,
      [signatures, tokenMints, walletAddresses]
    );
    if (
      !counts
      || Number(counts.transaction_count) !== 0
      || Number(counts.token_count) !== 0
      || Number(counts.wallet_count) !== 0
    ) {
      throw new Error(`Fixture rows remain after cleanup: ${JSON.stringify(counts)}`);
    }
  });
  await cleanupStep('close queue events', () => queueEvents.close());
  await cleanupStep('close queue', () => queue.close());
  await cleanupStep('close queue Redis connection', () => queueConnection.quit());
  await cleanupStep('close event Redis connection', () => eventsConnection.quit());
  await cleanupStep('close worker Redis connection', () => workerConnection.quit());
  await cleanupStep('close PostgreSQL pool', () => closePool());

  const errors = [primaryError, ...cleanupErrors].filter((error) => error !== undefined);
  if (errors.length === 1) throw errors[0];
  if (errors.length > 1) {
    throw new AggregateError(errors, 'G0-D11 acceptance and cleanup encountered multiple failures');
  }

  console.log('[G0-D11] PASS', JSON.stringify(passSummary));
}
