==> apps/lp/src/scanner/scan-job.ts <==
import type { LpChain } from '@swat/shared';
import { realizedFeeApr } from './fee-apr.js';
import type { NormalizedPool, PoolFetcher, ScanSummary } from './types.js';

/**
 * The scan job (Track B6) — wires the fetchers (B1/B2), the active-TVL
 * calculators (B3, inside the fetchers), the fee APR calculator (B4), and the
 * ranking function (B5, applied by the API at request time) into one scheduled
 * pass that writes the `lp_pools` cache, tagged by chain.
 *
 * One fetcher failing must not lose the other chain's scan: failed fetchers
 * are reported in the summary, not thrown. A pool without a risk score still
 * gets written (Track C6 attaches the score in a second step) — the *feed*
 * excludes unassessed pools, so a crash between scan and risk pass degrades
 * freshness, never correctness.
 */

export interface UpsertLpPoolPort {
  upsert(input: {
    chain: LpChain;
    protocol: NormalizedPool['protocol'];
    poolAddress: string;
    pairLabel: string;
    baseTokenMint: string;
    quoteTokenMint: string;
    feeBps: number;
    binStep: number | null;
    tickSpacing: number | null;
    currentPrice: number | null;
    tvl: number;
    activeTvl: number;
    volume24h: number;
    feeApr24h: number | null;
    feeApr7d: number | null;
  }): Promise<unknown>;
}

export interface ScanJobDeps {
  readonly fetchers: readonly PoolFetcher[];
  readonly store: UpsertLpPoolPort;
}

export async function runPoolScan(deps: ScanJobDeps): Promise<ScanSummary> {
  const scannedByChain: Record<string, number> = {};
  const failedFetchers: string[] = [];

  for (const fetcher of deps.fetchers) {
    try {
      const pools = await fetcher.fetch();
      let written = 0;
      for (const pool of pools) {
        const apr = realizedFeeApr({ fees24h: pool.fees24h, fees7d: pool.fees7d, tvl: pool.tvl });
        await deps.store.upsert({
          chain: pool.chain,
          protocol: pool.protocol,
          poolAddress: pool.poolAddress,
          pairLabel: pool.pairLabel,
          baseTokenMint: pool.baseTokenMint,
          quoteTokenMint: pool.quoteTokenMint,
          feeBps: pool.feeBps,
          binStep: pool.binStep,
          tickSpacing: pool.tickSpacing,
          currentPrice: pool.currentPrice,
          tvl: pool.tvl,
          activeTvl: pool.activeTvlUsd,
          volume24h: pool.volume24h,
          feeApr24h: apr.feeApr24h,
          feeApr7d: apr.feeApr7d
        });
        written += 1;
      }
      scannedByChain[fetcher.chain] = (scannedByChain[fetcher.chain] ?? 0) + written;
    } catch (error) {
      failedFetchers.push(`${fetcher.chain}:${fetcher.protocol}`);
      console.error(
        `[lp] scan fetcher failed for ${fetcher.chain}/${fetcher.protocol}:`,
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : error
      );
    }
  }

  return { scannedByChain, failedFetchers };
}

==> apps/lp/src/scanner/solana-bins.test.ts <==
import bs58 from 'bs58';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import {
  BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY,
  BIN_STRIDE,
  createRpcSolanaBinSource,
  decodeBinArrayBins,
  decodeLbPairState,
  readU128LE,
  type SolanaRpcBinPort
} from './solana-bins.js';

/**
 * Layout fixtures encode the wire format exactly as verified on mainnet
 * (pool 5hbf9JP8…: active_id −604, bin_step 20, MET/USDC 6/6 decimals) so a
 * regression in the offsets cannot pass silently.
 */

const LB_PAIR_DISCRIMINATOR = Buffer.from([33, 11, 49, 98, 181, 101, 177, 13]);
const BIN_ARRAY_DISCRIMINATOR = Buffer.from([92, 142, 92, 220, 5, 148, 70, 181]);
const LB_PAIR_SIZE = 8 + 32 + 32 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 4 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 32 + 32 + 32 + 32;
const B58_MET = 'METvsvVRapdj9cFLzq4Tr43xK4tAjQfwX76z3n6mWQL';
const B58_USDC = 'EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v';

function writeU128LE(buffer: Buffer, offset: number, value: bigint): void {
  buffer.writeBigUInt64LE(value & 0xffffffffffffffffn, offset);
  buffer.writeBigUInt64LE(value >> 64n, offset + 8);
}

function encodeLbPair(activeBinId: number, binStep: number): Buffer {
  const data = Buffer.alloc(LB_PAIR_SIZE);
  LB_PAIR_DISCRIMINATOR.copy(data, 0);
  // StaticParameters @8 (32B), VariableParameters @40 (32B) — zeros are fine.
  data.writeInt32LE(activeBinId, 76);
  data.writeUInt16LE(binStep, 80);
  Buffer.from(bs58.decode(B58_MET)).copy(data, 88);
  Buffer.from(bs58.decode(B58_USDC)).copy(data, 120);
  return data;
}

function encodeBinArray(index: number, bins: { binId: number; rawX: bigint; rawY: bigint; priceQ64: bigint }[]): Buffer {
  const data = Buffer.alloc(56 + BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY * BIN_STRIDE);
  BIN_ARRAY_DISCRIMINATOR.copy(data, 0);
  data.writeBigInt64LE(BigInt(index), 8);
  data[16] = 2; // version, as seen on mainnet
  for (const bin of bins) {
    const i = bin.binId - index * BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY;
    if (i < 0 || i >= BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY) continue;
    const base = 56 + i * BIN_STRIDE;
    data.writeBigUInt64LE(bin.rawX, base);
    data.writeBigUInt64LE(bin.rawY, base + 8);
    writeU128LE(data, base + 16, bin.priceQ64);
  }
  return data;
}

const Q64 = 2n ** 64n;
const priceQ64 = (humanPrice: number): bigint => BigInt(Math.round(humanPrice * Number(Q64)));

function portWith(overrides: Partial<SolanaRpcBinPort> = {}): SolanaRpcBinPort & { calls: string[] } {
  const calls: string[] = [];
  const lbPair = encodeLbPair(-604, 20);
  const arrays = [
    // One account per real array (mainnet never duplicates a bin across
    // accounts): index -9 covers -630..-561 and holds everything near active;
    // index -8 covers -560..-491 — outside ±10, must be filtered out entirely.
    encodeBinArray(-9, [
      { binId: -606, rawX: 0n, rawY: 910_000000n, priceQ64: priceQ64(0.29806) },
      { binId: -605, rawX: 0n, rawY: 900_000000n, priceQ64: priceQ64(0.298657) },
      { binId: -595, rawX: 0n, rawY: 940_000000n, priceQ64: priceQ64(0.3026) }
    ]),
    encodeBinArray(-8, [{ binId: -560, rawX: 4_099_893529n, rawY: 0n, priceQ64: priceQ64(0.326645) }])
  ];
  return {
    calls,
    async getAccountInfoBase64(address) {
      calls.push(`info:${address}`);
      return lbPair.toString('base64');
    },
    async getProgramAccountsMemcmp(programId, offset, bytes) {
      calls.push(`gpa:${programId}:${offset}:${bytes}`);
      return arrays.map((data) => ({ pubkey: 'arr', dataBase64: data.toString('base64') }));
    },
    async getTokenDecimals(mint) {
      calls.push(`dec:${mint}`);
      return 6; // both MET and USDC carry 6 — verified on mainnet
    },
    ...overrides
  };
}

describe('decodeLbPairState (mainnet-verified offsets)', () => {
  it('reads active_id @76, bin_step @80, and the mints @88/@120', () => {
    const state = decodeLbPairState(encodeLbPair(-604, 20));
    expect(state.activeBinId).toBe(-604);
    expect(state.binStep).toBe(20);
    expect(state.tokenXMint).toBe(B58_MET);
    expect(state.tokenYMint).toBe(B58_USDC);
  });

  it('rejects a truncated account before reading out of bounds', () => {
    expect(() => decodeLbPairState(Buffer.alloc(100))).toThrow('too short');
  });
});

describe('decodeBinArrayBins', () => {
  it('validates the discriminator and maps index → bin ids', () => {
    const { index, bins } = decodeBinArrayBins(
      encodeBinArray(-8, [{ binId: -560, rawX: 1n, rawY: 2n, priceQ64: 3n }])
    );
    expect(index).toBe(-8);
    expect(bins).toHaveLength(BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY);
    expect(bins[0]?.binId).toBe(-560); // -8 * 70 + 0
    expect(bins[69]?.binId).toBe(-491);
  });

  it('rejects a non-BinArray account', () => {
    const wrong = Buffer.alloc(56 + 70 * BIN_STRIDE);
    expect(() => decodeBinArrayBins(wrong)).toThrow('discriminator');
  });

  it('reads the Q64.64 price across the u128 boundary', () => {
    const data = Buffer.alloc(56 + BIN_STRIDE);
    BIN_ARRAY_DISCRIMINATOR.copy(data, 0);
    writeU128LE(data, 56 + 16, (1n << 64n) + 5n); // 1.000000000000000005
    const { bins } = decodeBinArrayBins(data);
    expect(bins[0]?.priceQ64).toBe((1n << 64n) + 5n);
    expect(readU128LE(data, 56 + 16)).toBe((1n << 64n) + 5n);
  });
});

describe('createRpcSolanaBinSource', () => {
  it('humanizes amounts and prices, filters to ±binsEachSide, and filters by memcmp @24', async () => {
    const port = portWith();
    const source = createRpcSolanaBinSource({ port, binsEachSide: 10 });
    const { bins, activeBinId } = await source.fetchBins('solana:5hbf9JP8k5zdrZp9pokPypFQoBse5mGCmW6nqodurGcd');

    expect(activeBinId).toBe(-604);
    // Array -9's span (-630..-561) fully covers the ±10 window, so every bin
    // -614..-594 comes back — zero-liquidity ones included, exactly like the
    // live mainnet response (21 bins there too). Array -8's -560 stays out.
    const ids = bins.map((bin) => bin.binId).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    expect(ids).toHaveLength(21);
    expect(ids[0]).toBe(-614);
    expect(ids.at(-1)).toBe(-594);
    expect(bins.some((bin) => bin.binId === -560)).toBe(false);
    const below = bins.find((bin) => bin.binId === -605);
    expect(below?.quoteAmount).toBeCloseTo(900, 6);
    const above = bins.find((bin) => bin.binId === -595);
    expect(above?.quoteAmount).toBeCloseTo(940, 6);
    expect(below?.quoteAmount).toBeCloseTo(900, 6); // 900_000000 / 10^6
    expect(below?.baseAmount).toBe(0);
    // Q64.64 price × 10^(decX − decY) = human quote-per-base
    expect(below?.price).toBeCloseTo(0.298657, 8);
    expect(above?.price).toBeCloseTo(0.3026, 8);

    // the memcmp filter used the verified lb_pair offset, not the folk 16
    expect(port.calls.some((call) => call.startsWith('gpa:') && call.includes(':24:'))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('throws when the pair account does not exist', async () => {
    const source = createRpcSolanaBinSource({
      port: portWith({ getAccountInfoBase64: async () => null })
    });
    await expect(source.fetchBins('solana:5hbf9JP8k5zdrZp9pokPypFQoBse5mGCmW6nqodurGcd')).rejects.toThrow('not found');
  });

  it('passes a bare base58 pool address through unchanged', async () => {
    const port = portWith();
    const source = createRpcSolanaBinSource({ port });
    await source.fetchBins('5hbf9JP8k5zdrZp9pokPypFQoBse5mGCmW6nqodurGcd');
    expect(port.calls[0]).toBe('info:5hbf9JP8k5zdrZp9pokPypFQoBse5mGCmW6nqodurGcd');
  });
});

==> apps/lp/src/scanner/solana-bins.ts <==
import bs58 from 'bs58';
import type { MeteoraBin } from './active-tvl.js';
import type { MeteoraBinSource } from './meteora-pools.js';

/**
 * The live Solana bin source (Track I1) — reads DLMM bin liquidity straight
 * from RPC, with no SDK. `@meteora-ag/dlmm@1.9.14` cannot be imported in this
 * environment (broken ESM re-exports, CJS build missing the DLMM class), so
 * this module speaks the program's wire format directly. Every offset below
 * was verified byte-by-byte against mainnet (layout source:
 * `idls/dlmm.json` from MeteoraAg/dlmm-sdk).
 *
 * Layouts (all little-endian):
 *
 *   LbPair (borsh):
 *     0..8     anchor discriminator
 *     8..40    StaticParameters (32 bytes)
 *     40..72   VariableParameters (32 bytes)
 *     72       bump_seed u8
 *     73..75   bin_step_seed [u8;2]
 *     75       pair_type u8
 *     76..80   active_id i32            ← read
 *     80..82   bin_step u16             ← read
 *     82..88   status, require_base_factor_seed, base_factor_seed, activation,
 *              creator_pool_on_off_control
 *     88..120  token_x_mint pubkey      ← read
 *     120..152 token_y_mint pubkey      ← read
 *
 *   BinArray (zero-copy, C repr):
 *     0..8     discriminator [92,142,92,220,5,148,70,181]
 *     8..16    index i64                ← read (array covers index*70 … index*70+69)
 *     16..24   version u8 + padding
 *     24..56   lb_pair pubkey           ← memcmp filter offset (24, not 16 —
 *                                          verified: 16 returns zero accounts)
 *     56..     Bin[70], stride 144:
 *                +0   amount_x u64      ← read (raw, smallest unit)
 *                +8   amount_y u64      ← read
 *                +16  price u128, Q64.64 per-lamport  ← read
 */

export const DLMM_PROGRAM_ID = 'LBUZKhRxPF3XUpBCjp4YzTKgLccjZhTSDM9YuVaPwxo';
const BIN_ARRAY_DISCRIMINATOR = Buffer.from([92, 142, 92, 220, 5, 148, 70, 181]);
export const BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY = 70;
export const BIN_STRIDE = 144;
const BIN_ARRAY_HEADER = 56;
const BIN_ARRAY_LB_PAIR_OFFSET = 24;
const LB_PAIR_ACTIVE_ID_OFFSET = 76;
const LB_PAIR_BIN_STEP_OFFSET = 80;
const LB_PAIR_TOKEN_X_MINT_OFFSET = 88;
const LB_PAIR_TOKEN_Y_MINT_OFFSET = 120;
const Q64 = 2n ** 64n;

export interface SolanaRpcBinPort {
  /** getAccountInfo, base64 data; null when the account does not exist. */
  getAccountInfoBase64(address: string): Promise<string | null>;
  /** getProgramAccounts with one memcmp filter, base64, full data. */
  getProgramAccountsMemcmp(programId: string, offset: number, bytesBase58: string): Promise<{ pubkey: string; dataBase64: string }[]>;
  /** SPL mint decimals. */
  getTokenDecimals(mint: string): Promise<number>;
}

/** Raw JSON-RPC over fetch, matching the indexer's heliusRpc pattern. */
export function createWeb3SolanaBinPort(rpcUrl: string): SolanaRpcBinPort {
  let nextId = 0;
  const rpc = async <T>(method: string, params: unknown[]): Promise<T> => {
    const response = await fetch(rpcUrl, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: ++nextId, method, params })
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Solana RPC ${method} returned HTTP ${response.status}`);
    }
    const payload = (await response.json()) as { result?: T; error?: { message?: string } };
    if (payload.error) {
      throw new Error(`Solana RPC ${method} failed: ${payload.error.message ?? 'unknown'}`);
    }
    return payload.result as T;
  };

  return {
    async getAccountInfoBase64(address) {
      const result = await rpc<{ value: { data: [string, string] } | null }>('getAccountInfo', [
        address,
        { encoding: 'base64' }
      ]);
      return result.value ? result.value.data[0] : null;
    },
    async getProgramAccountsMemcmp(programId, offset, bytesBase58) {
      const result = await rpc<{ pubkey: string; account: { data: [string, string] } }[]>(
        'getProgramAccounts',
        [
          programId,
          {
            filters: [{ memcmp: { offset, bytes: bytesBase58 } }],
            encoding: 'base64'
          }
        ]
      );
      return result.map((entry) => ({ pubkey: entry.pubkey, dataBase64: entry.account.data[0] }));
    },
    async getTokenDecimals(mint) {
      const result = await rpc<{ value: { decimals: number } }>('getTokenSupply', [mint]);
      return result.value.decimals;
    }
  };
}

export function readU128LE(buffer: Buffer, offset: number): bigint {
  return buffer.readBigUInt64LE(offset) + buffer.readBigUInt64LE(offset + 8) * 2n ** 64n;
}

/** Decoded pair state, raw units. */
export function decodeLbPairState(data: Buffer): {
  activeBinId: number;
  binStep: number;
  tokenXMint: string;
  tokenYMint: string;
} {
  if (data.length < LB_PAIR_TOKEN_Y_MINT_OFFSET + 32) {
    throw new Error(`LbPair account too short: ${data.length} bytes`);
  }
  return {
    activeBinId: data.readInt32LE(LB_PAIR_ACTIVE_ID_OFFSET),
    binStep: data.readUInt16LE(LB_PAIR_BIN_STEP_OFFSET),
    tokenXMint: bs58.encode(data.subarray(LB_PAIR_TOKEN_X_MINT_OFFSET, LB_PAIR_TOKEN_X_MINT_OFFSET + 32)),
    tokenYMint: bs58.encode(data.subarray(LB_PAIR_TOKEN_Y_MINT_OFFSET, LB_PAIR_TOKEN_Y_MINT_OFFSET + 32))
  };
}

export interface DecodedBin {
  readonly binId: number;
  readonly rawAmountX: bigint;
  readonly rawAmountY: bigint;
  readonly priceQ64: bigint;
}

export function decodeBinArrayBins(data: Buffer): { index: number; bins: DecodedBin[] } {
  if (data.length < BIN_ARRAY_HEADER) {
    throw new Error(`BinArray account too short: ${data.length} bytes`);
  }
  if (!data.subarray(0, 8).equals(BIN_ARRAY_DISCRIMINATOR)) {
    throw new Error('account is not a DLMM BinArray (discriminator mismatch)');
  }
  const index = Number(data.readBigInt64LE(8));
  const capacity = Math.min(BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY, Math.floor((data.length - BIN_ARRAY_HEADER) / BIN_STRIDE));
  const bins: DecodedBin[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < capacity; i += 1) {
    const base = BIN_ARRAY_HEADER + i * BIN_STRIDE;
    bins.push({
      binId: index * BINS_PER_BIN_ARRAY + i,
      rawAmountX: data.readBigUInt64LE(base),
      rawAmountY: data.readBigUInt64LE(base + 8),
      priceQ64: readU128LE(data, base + 16)
    });
  }
  return { index, bins };
}

export interface RpcSolanaBinSourceOptions {
  readonly rpcUrl?: string;
  readonly port?: SolanaRpcBinPort;
  /** Bins each side of the active bin to return. */
  readonly binsEachSide?: number;
}

/**
 * The MeteoraBinSource the scanner and the live preview consume. Returns
 * human-scale amounts and quote-per-base prices — the on-chain Q64.64
 * per-lamport price with the decimals adjustment `× 10^(decX − decY)`
 * (verified on mainnet: MET/USDC, both 6 decimals, price 0.299 matches the
 * implied (1+binStep/10000)^activeId).
 */
export function createRpcSolanaBinSource(options: RpcSolanaBinSourceOptions = {}): MeteoraBinSource {
  const port = options.port ?? createWeb3SolanaBinPort(options.rpcUrl ?? 'https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com');
  const binsEachSide = options.binsEachSide ?? 10;

  return {
    async fetchBins(poolAddress) {
      const rawPool = poolAddress.startsWith('solana:') ? poolAddress.slice('solana:'.length) : poolAddress;

      const lbPairBase64 = await port.getAccountInfoBase64(rawPool);
      if (!lbPairBase64) {
        throw new Error(`DLMM pair ${rawPool} not found`);
      }
      const state = decodeLbPairState(Buffer.from(lbPairBase64, 'base64'));

      const arrays = await port.getProgramAccountsMemcmp(
        DLMM_PROGRAM_ID,
        BIN_ARRAY_LB_PAIR_OFFSET,
        rawPool // already base58 of the 32-byte pubkey; memcmp bytes accepts it directly
      );

      const [decX, decY] = await Promise.all([
        port.getTokenDecimals(state.tokenXMint),
        port.getTokenDecimals(state.tokenYMint)
      ]);
      const decimalAdjustment = 10 ** (decX - decY);

      const bins: MeteoraBin[] = [];
      for (const array of arrays) {
        const { bins: decoded } = decodeBinArrayBins(Buffer.from(array.dataBase64, 'base64'));
        for (const bin of decoded) {
          if (Math.abs(bin.binId - state.activeBinId) > binsEachSide) continue;
          bins.push({
            binId: bin.binId,
            price: (Number(bin.priceQ64) / Number(Q64)) * decimalAdjustment,
            baseAmount: Number(bin.rawAmountX) / 10 ** decX,
            quoteAmount: Number(bin.rawAmountY) / 10 ** decY
          });
        }
      }

      return { bins, activeBinId: state.activeBinId, binStep: state.binStep };
    }
  };
}

import { prefixChainValue } from '@swat/shared';
import type { LpPositionReader, ObservedPosition } from './types.js';

/**
 * Robinhood Chain position reader (Track D2) — Uniswap v3 position NFTs, with
 * v4 positions behind the same port once the v4 contracts are confirmed.
 *
 * `positions(tokenId)` gives the raw position; valuation needs the pool state
 * and both token prices, which the port provides already computed per leg, so
 * this reader only normalizes and prefixes.
 */

export interface V3PositionView {
  readonly tokenId: string;
  /** Raw token contract addresses. */
  readonly token0: string;
  readonly token1: string;
  /** Raw pool address backing the position. */
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  /** Human-scale amounts under the current price, priced legs. */
  readonly amount0: number;
  readonly amount1: number;
  /** Human-scale uncollected fees per leg. */
  readonly uncollectedFees0: number;
  readonly uncollectedFees1: number;
  readonly inRange: boolean;
}

export interface V3PositionsPort {
  /** All position NFTs the wallet owns, with priced amounts. */
  fetchWalletPositions(walletAddress: string): Promise<readonly V3PositionView[]>;
  /** The NonfungiblePositionManager contract holding these token ids. */
  readonly positionManagerAddress: string;
}

export interface LegUsdPriceSource {
  /** USD price by raw token address (lowercased); null when unknown. */
  priceUsd(token: string): Promise<number | null>;
}

export function createRobinhoodLpPositionReader(options: {
  port: V3PositionsPort;
  prices: LegUsdPriceSource;
  protocol?: 'uniswap-v3' | 'uniswap-v4';
}): LpPositionReader {
  void options.protocol; // valuation is protocol-agnostic through the port
  return {
    chain: 'robinhood-chain',
    async readPositions(walletAddress: string): Promise<readonly ObservedPosition[]> {
      const views = await options.port.fetchWalletPositions(walletAddress);
      const observed: ObservedPosition[] = [];

      for (const view of views) {
        const [price0, price1] = await Promise.all([
          options.prices.priceUsd(view.token0.toLowerCase()),
          options.prices.priceUsd(view.token1.toLowerCase())
        ]);
        if (price0 === null || price1 === null) continue;

        observed.push({
          // An EVM position's identity is its tokenId inside the position
          // manager, not an address. The chain prefix stays first and the
          // (contract, tokenId) pair rides behind it:
          // `robinhood-chain:<positionManager>:<tokenId>`.
          positionAddress: `robinhood-chain:${options.port.positionManagerAddress.toLowerCase()}:${view.tokenId}`,
          poolAddress: prefixChainValue(view.poolAddress.toLowerCase(), 'robinhood-chain'),
          positionValueUsd: view.amount0 * price0 + view.amount1 * price1,
          uncollectedFeesUsd: view.uncollectedFees0 * price0 + view.uncollectedFees1 * price1,
          inRange: view.inRange
        });
      }
      return observed;
    }
  };
}

==> apps/lp/src/wallets/pnl.test.ts <==
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { computeWalletPositionPnl } from './pnl.js';

const t0 = Date.parse('2026-10-01T00:00:00Z');

function point(hoursAfter: number, value: number, fees: number) {
  return {
    capturedAt: new Date(t0 + hoursAfter * 3_600_000),
    positionValueUsd: value,
    uncollectedFeesUsd: fees,
    inRange: true
  };
}

describe('computeWalletPositionPnl', () => {
  it('nets fee growth and inventory growth through the shared netLpResult', () => {
    const pnl = computeWalletPositionPnl([
      point(0, 1_000, 0),
      point(24, 1_050, 12)
    ]);
    expect(pnl?.feesEarnedUsd).toBe(12);
    expect(pnl?.inventoryChangeUsd).toBe(50);
    expect(pnl?.netResultUsd).toBe(62);
    expect(pnl?.closed).toBe(false);
  });

  it('a shrinking position nets negative', () => {
    const pnl = computeWalletPositionPnl([
      point(0, 2_000, 40),
      point(48, 1_700, 45)
    ]);
    expect(pnl?.inventoryChangeUsd).toBe(-300);
    expect(pnl?.feesEarnedUsd).toBe(5);
    expect(pnl?.netResultUsd).toBe(-295);
  });

  it('orders the series by capture time regardless of input order', () => {
    const pnl = computeWalletPositionPnl([
      point(24, 1_050, 12),
      point(0, 1_000, 0)
    ]);
    expect(pnl?.firstObservedAt).toEqual(new Date(t0));
    expect(pnl?.lastObservedAt).toEqual(new Date(t0 + 24 * 3_600_000));
    expect(pnl?.netResultUsd).toBe(62);
  });

  it('a single snapshot is an observation, not a result', () => {
    expect(computeWalletPositionPnl([point(0, 1_000, 0)])).toBeNull();
    expect(computeWalletPositionPnl([])).toBeNull();
  });

  it('a series ending emptied out is marked closed', () => {
    const pnl = computeWalletPositionPnl([
      point(0, 1_000, 0),
      point(24, 0, 0)
    ]);
    expect(pnl?.closed).toBe(true);
    expect(pnl?.netResultUsd).toBe(-1_000);
  });
});

==> apps/lp/src/wallets/pnl.ts <==
import { netLpResult } from '../domain/net-lp-result.js';

/**
 * Per-wallet PnL calculator (Track D3).
 *
 * Closes the books for one tracked wallet position from its snapshot series,
 * reusing the Track A net-LP-result function verbatim. The series decomposition
 * is honest about what snapshots can and cannot know:
 *
 *   - `feesEarned` = the growth of uncollected fees between first and last
 *     observation. Fees *collected mid-series* are invisible to this method —
 *     the value is documented, and the live indexer will fold fee-claim
 *     events into the series later.
 *   - `inventoryChange` = the growth of inventory value. Sign-convention note:
 *     inventory *growth* is positive, and netLpResult adds it.
 *   - `impermanentLoss`, `gasCost`, `rebalanceCost` are 0 here: the snapshot
 *     series cannot separate IL from inventory drift without a HODL baseline,
 *     and gas/repositioning are execution-side facts. What this computes is
 *     "series PnL" — a floor on the true net result.
 */

export interface WalletPositionSnapshotPoint {
  readonly capturedAt: Date;
  readonly positionValueUsd: number;
  readonly uncollectedFeesUsd: number;
  readonly inRange: boolean;
}

export interface WalletPositionPnl {
  readonly netResultUsd: number;
  readonly feesEarnedUsd: number;
  readonly inventoryChangeUsd: number;
  readonly firstObservedAt: Date;
  readonly lastObservedAt: Date;
  /** True when the series shows the position emptied out (value and fees at zero). */
  readonly closed: boolean;
}

export function computeWalletPositionPnl(
  series: readonly WalletPositionSnapshotPoint[]
): WalletPositionPnl | null {
  if (series.length < 2) {
    // One point is an observation, not a result — nothing has been earned or
    // lost *over time* yet.
    return null;
  }

  const ordered = [...series].sort(
    (left, right) => left.capturedAt.getTime() - right.capturedAt.getTime()
  );
  const first = ordered[0]!;
  const last = ordered[ordered.length - 1]!;

  const feesEarnedUsd = last.uncollectedFeesUsd - first.uncollectedFeesUsd;
  const inventoryChangeUsd = last.positionValueUsd - first.positionValueUsd;

  const netResultUsd = netLpResult({
    feesEarned: feesEarnedUsd,
    impermanentLoss: 0,
    gasCost: 0,
    rebalanceCost: 0,
    inventoryChange: inventoryChangeUsd
  });

  return {
    netResultUsd,
    feesEarnedUsd,
    inventoryChangeUsd,
    firstObservedAt: first.capturedAt,
    lastObservedAt: last.capturedAt,
    closed: last.positionValueUsd === 0 && last.uncollectedFeesUsd === 0
  };
}

==> apps/lp/src/wallets/solana-positions.ts <==
import { prefixChainValue } from '@swat/shared';
import type { LpPositionReader, ObservedPosition } from './types.js';

/**
 * Solana DLMM position reader (Track D1).
 *
 * The DLMM SDK call (`getAllLbPairPositionsByUser`) sits behind a port so the
 * normalization is testable without a chain. The SDK returns per-pair amounts
 * in token units; this reader prices both legs through an injected mint-price
 * source and skips positions it cannot price — an unpriceable position must
 * read as *absent* from the snapshot, not as a zero-value one, or the PnL
 * series would book a phantom total loss.
 */

export interface DlmmPairPosition {
  /** Raw pair pubkey (unprefixed). */
  readonly pairAddress: string;
  /** Raw position pubkey (unprefixed). */
  readonly positionAddress: string;
  /** Raw mints for pricing. */
  readonly baseMint: string;
  readonly quoteMint: string;
  /** Human-scale token amounts in the position's inventory. */
  readonly baseAmount: number;
  readonly quoteAmount: number;
  /** Human-scale uncollected fees per leg. */
  readonly uncollectedBaseFees: number;
  readonly uncollectedQuoteFees: number;
  /** Current quote-per-base price at the pair's active bin. */
  readonly currentPrice: number;
  readonly inRange: boolean;
}

export interface DlmmUserPositionsPort {
  fetchUserPositions(walletAddress: string): Promise<readonly DlmmPairPosition[]>;
}

export interface MintUsdPriceSource {
  /** USD price by chain-prefixed mint; null when unknown. */
  priceUsd(chainPrefixedMint: string): Promise<number | null>;
}

export function createSolanaLpPositionReader(options: {
  port: DlmmUserPositionsPort;
  prices: MintUsdPriceSource;
}): LpPositionReader {
  return {
    chain: 'solana',
    async readPositions(walletAddress: string): Promise<readonly ObservedPosition[]> {
      const pairs = await options.port.fetchUserPositions(walletAddress);
      const observed: ObservedPosition[] = [];

      for (const pair of pairs) {
        const [basePriceUsd, quotePriceUsd] = await Promise.all([
          options.prices.priceUsd(prefixChainValue(pair.baseMint, 'solana')),
          options.prices.priceUsd(prefixChainValue(pair.quoteMint, 'solana'))
        ]);
        if (basePriceUsd === null || quotePriceUsd === null) continue;

        // Each leg is priced once, in USD per token. `currentPrice` is
        // quote-per-base — multiplying it in as well would double-count the
        // quote leg's unit and inflate the base leg by the pool price.
        const positionValueUsd =
          pair.baseAmount * basePriceUsd + pair.quoteAmount * quotePriceUsd;
        const uncollectedFeesUsd =
          pair.uncollectedBaseFees * basePriceUsd
          + pair.uncollectedQuoteFees * quotePriceUsd;

        observed.push({
          positionAddress: prefixChainValue(pair.positionAddress, 'solana'),
          poolAddress: prefixChainValue(pair.pairAddress, 'solana'),
          positionValueUsd,
          uncollectedFeesUsd,
          inRange: pair.inRange
        });
      }
      return observed;
    }
  };
}

==> apps/lp/src/wallets/types.ts <==
import type { LpChain } from '@swat/shared';

/**
 * LP wallet indexer shapes (Track D).
 *
 * A reader turns one wallet into a set of *observations* — what the wallet's
 * LP positions are worth right now. Valuation happens inside the reader (it
 * has the chain context); the indexer records the series and the PnL
 * calculator closes the books from the series.
 */

export interface ObservedPosition {
  /** Chain-prefixed position identifier (Solana position pubkey; EVM tokenId as address-shaped? no — `position:<tokenId>` is NOT valid here; use the chain-prefixed NFT/position account). */
  readonly positionAddress: string;
  /** Chain-prefixed pool the position sits in. */
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  /** Current inventory value of the position, USD (excludes uncollected fees). */
  readonly positionValueUsd: number;
  /** Uncollected fees sitting in the position, USD. */
  readonly uncollectedFeesUsd: number;
  /** Whether the position's range contains the current price. */
  readonly inRange: boolean;
}

export interface LpPositionReader {
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  /** All LP positions one wallet holds, ready to be recorded as a snapshot row. */
  readPositions(walletAddress: string): Promise<readonly ObservedPosition[]>;
}

    expect(summary.positionsObserved).toBe(1);
    expect(summary.failedWallets).toEqual([]);
    expect(dbMocks.recordLpWalletIndexPass).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'w1',
      expect.arrayContaining([expect.objectContaining({ positionAddress: 'solana:posA' })])
    );
  });

  it('a wallet on a chain with no reader is reported as failed, not dropped silently', async () => {
    const wallets: readonly TrackedWalletRef[] = [
      { id: 'w2', chain: 'robinhood-chain', walletAddress: 'robinhood-chain:0xwal' }
    ];

    const summary = await runWalletIndexPass({
      readers: [reader],
      listWallets: async () => wallets
    });

    expect(summary.walletsIndexed).toBe(0);
    expect(summary.failedWallets).toEqual(['robinhood-chain:0xwal']);
  });

  it('closes the books for positions with a series and upserts the result', async () => {
    dbMocks.recordLpWalletIndexPass.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    dbMocks.upsertLpWalletPositionResult.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    const now = new Date();

    const summary = await runWalletIndexPass({
      readers: [reader],
      listWallets: async () => [{ id: 'w1', chain: 'solana', walletAddress: 'solana:wal1' }],
      snapshotSeries: async () => [
        { capturedAt: new Date(now.getTime() - 3_600_000), positionValueUsd: 900, uncollectedFeesUsd: 0, inRange: true },
        { capturedAt: now, positionValueUsd: 1_000, uncollectedFeesUsd: 10, inRange: true }
      ]
    });

    expect(summary.resultsClosed).toBe(1);
    const [walletId, result] = dbMocks.upsertLpWalletPositionResult.mock.calls[0];
    expect(walletId).toBe('w1');
    expect(result.netResultUsd).toBe(110); // 10 fees + 100 inventory
    expect(result.chain).toBe('solana');
  });

  it('a reader throwing does not take down the sweep', async () => {
    const failingReader: LpPositionReader = {
      chain: 'solana',
      readPositions: vi.fn(async () => {
        throw new Error('SDK exploded');
      })
    };

    const summary = await runWalletIndexPass({
      readers: [failingReader],
      listWallets: async () => [{ id: 'w1', chain: 'solana', walletAddress: 'solana:wal1' }]
    });

    expect(summary.failedWallets).toEqual(['solana:wal1']);
    expect(dbMocks.recordLpWalletIndexPass).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('re-exports untrack for the API layer', async () => {
    dbMocks.untrackLpWallet.mockResolvedValue(true);
    await expect(untrackLpWallet('solana', 'solana:wal')).resolves.toBe(true);
  });
});

==> apps/lp/src/wallets/wallet-indexer.ts <==
import type { Chain } from '@swat/shared';
import {
  recordLpWalletIndexPass,
  trackLpWallet,
  untrackLpWallet,
  upsertLpWalletPositionResult
} from '@swat/db';
import { computeWalletPositionPnl, type WalletPositionSnapshotPoint } from './pnl.js';
import type { LpPositionReader, ObservedPosition } from './types.js';

/**
 * The wallet indexer (Track D4) — storage wiring around the readers.
 *
 * `runWalletIndexPass` is one scheduled sweep: every tracked wallet is read
 * through its chain's reader, the observation becomes a snapshot row, and any
 * position whose series can close the books gets its net result upserted into
 * the results table the leaderboard aggregates.
 *
 * Track D5 (the leaderboard query) lives in `@swat/db`
 * (`queryLpWalletLeaderboard`) because it is a pure SQL aggregation.
 */

export interface TrackedWalletRef {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly chain: Chain;
  readonly walletAddress: string;
}

export interface WalletIndexPassDeps {
  readonly readers: readonly LpPositionReader[];
  readonly listWallets?: () => Promise<readonly TrackedWalletRef[]>;
  readonly recordPass?: typeof recordLpWalletIndexPass;
  readonly upsertResult?: typeof upsertLpWalletPositionResult;
  /** Snapshot series per (tracked wallet id, position address), for PnL closing. */
  readonly snapshotSeries?: (trackedWalletId: string, positionAddress: string) => Promise<readonly WalletPositionSnapshotPoint[]>;
}

export interface WalletIndexPassSummary {
  walletsIndexed: number;
  positionsObserved: number;
  resultsClosed: number;
  failedWallets: string[];
}

export async function runWalletIndexPass(deps: WalletIndexPassDeps): Promise<WalletIndexPassSummary> {
  const listWallets = deps.listWallets ?? defaultListWallets;
  const recordPass = deps.recordPass ?? recordLpWalletIndexPass;
  const upsertResult = deps.upsertResult ?? upsertLpWalletPositionResult;
  const snapshotSeries = deps.snapshotSeries ?? (async () => []);

  const wallets = await listWallets();
  const summary: WalletIndexPassSummary = {
    walletsIndexed: 0,
    positionsObserved: 0,
    resultsClosed: 0,
    failedWallets: []
  };

  for (const wallet of wallets) {
    const reader = deps.readers.find((candidate) => candidate.chain === wallet.chain);
    if (!reader) {
      summary.failedWallets.push(wallet.walletAddress);
      continue;
    }
    try {
      const observed = await reader.readPositions(wallet.walletAddress);
      await recordPass(
        wallet.id,
        observed.map((position) => ({
          positionAddress: position.positionAddress,
          poolAddress: position.poolAddress,
          capturedAt: new Date(),
          positionValueUsd: position.positionValueUsd,
          uncollectedFeesUsd: position.uncollectedFeesUsd,
          inRange: position.inRange
        }))
      );
      summary.walletsIndexed += 1;
      summary.positionsObserved += observed.length;

      for (const position of observed) {
        const series = await snapshotSeries(wallet.id, position.positionAddress);
        const pnl = computeWalletPositionPnl(series);
        if (!pnl) continue;
        await upsertResult(wallet.id, {
          positionAddress: position.positionAddress,
          poolAddress: position.poolAddress,
          chain: reader.chain,
          strategyType: 'spot', // strategy attribution arrives with position metadata; spot is the ladder default
          netResultUsd: pnl.netResultUsd,
          firstObservedAt: pnl.firstObservedAt,
          lastObservedAt: pnl.lastObservedAt,
          closed: pnl.closed
        });
        summary.resultsClosed += 1;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      summary.failedWallets.push(wallet.walletAddress);
      console.error(
        '[lp] wallet index pass failed for',
        wallet.walletAddress,
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : error
      );
    }
  }

  return summary;
}

async function defaultListWallets(): Promise<readonly TrackedWalletRef[]> {
  const { listTrackedLpWallets } = await import('@swat/db');
  const wallets = await listTrackedLpWallets({ limit: 500 });
  return wallets.map((wallet) => ({
    id: wallet.id,
    chain: wallet.chain,
    walletAddress: wallet.walletAddress
  }));
}

export { trackLpWallet, untrackLpWallet };

describe('usableLiquidityForFanout', () => {

      chain: 'solana',

  });

  it('uses the same pool basis on robinhood-chain', () => {
    const liquidity = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'robinhood-chain',
      tokenMint: 'robinhood-chain:0xabc',
      poolTvlUsd: 50_000
    });
    expect(liquidity.basis).toBe('amm-pool-tvl');
    expect(liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBe(25_000);
  });

  it('reports unknown, not zero, when DexScreener has no pair', () => {
    const liquidity = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'solana',
      tokenMint: TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null
    });
    expect(liquidity.basis).toBe('unknown');
    expect(liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
  });

  it('refuses to substitute a pool figure for Polymarket, even when one is supplied', () => {
    // The whole point of the polygon branch: a non-null figure here is some
    // unrelated Polygon DEX pair, and using it would let the cap admit a cohort
    // against liquidity that does not exist for this market.
    const liquidity = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: 5_000_000
    });
    expect(liquidity.basis).toBe('unknown');
    expect(liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
  });

  it('names the CLOB and the missing feed in the polygon note, for whoever reads the skip', () => {
    const liquidity = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null
    });
    expect(liquidity.note).toMatch(/CLOB/);
    expect(liquidity.note).toMatch(/S4-M38/);
  });

  it('does not fetch DexScreener for polygon at all', async () => {
    await expect(fetchPoolTvlUsdForCapacity('polygon', POLY_TOKEN)).resolves.toBeNull();
  });
  it('accepts a measured order-book verdict on polygon (S4-M38)', () => {
    // The gate this replaces was correct while no honest depth figure existed.
    // Now that one does, refusing it would keep Polymarket permanently
    // uncopyable for a reason that no longer applies.
    const book = {
      chain: 'polygon' as const,
      tokenMint: 'polygon:token-1',
      usableLiquidityUsd: 250_000,
      basis: 'order-book-depth' as const,
      // Always true for a book: resting size is an option the maker holds, not a
      // commitment, so the figure can evaporate before the order lands.
      approximate: true,
      note: 'walked ladder within 100bps'
    };
    const result = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: 'polygon:token-1',
      poolTvlUsd: 5_000_000,
      polymarketBook: book
    });
    expect(result).toBe(book);
    // The pool figure must still be ignored even now the gate is open.
    expect(result.usableLiquidityUsd).toBe(250_000);
  });

  it('refuses a book verdict that came back unknown, rather than publishing it', () => {
    // A stale, gapped or unsnapshotted book is a VENUE condition; no subscriber
    // at all is a DEPLOYMENT gap. Both fail closed, and the notes differ so an
    // operator is not sent to the wrong place.
    const result = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: 'polygon:token-1',
      poolTvlUsd: null,
      polymarketBook: {
        chain: 'polygon',
        tokenMint: 'polygon:token-1',
        // Deliberately INCONSISTENT: a figure present while the basis says the
        // book was not measured. A verdict like this should never arrive, and the
        // point of the fixture is that trusting `basis` blindly -- or passing the
        // verdict straight through -- publishes 999_999 as real liquidity.
        // An earlier version of this test used a null figure, which the
        // pass-through mutation satisfied trivially.
        usableLiquidityUsd: 999_999,
        basis: 'unknown',
        approximate: false,
        note: 'snapshot is 40s stale'
      }
    });
    expect(result.basis).toBe('unknown');
    // The load-bearing assertion: the inconsistent figure must NOT survive.
    expect(result.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
    expect(result.note).toContain('40s stale');
    expect(result.note).toContain('S4-M38');
  });

  it('carries a book verdict through resolveFanoutCapacity, not just the pure helper', () => {
    // The wiring test. `usableLiquidityForFanout` accepting a verdict is useless
    // if `resolveFanoutCapacity` never passes one -- which is exactly the
    // correct-but-inert shape this checklist has been burned by four times, and
    // which a unit test on the helper alone cannot detect.
    const forwarded = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: 'polygon:token-1',
      poolTvlUsd: 9_999_999,
      polymarketBook: {
        chain: 'polygon',
        tokenMint: 'polygon:token-1',
        usableLiquidityUsd: 250_000,
        basis: 'order-book-depth',
        approximate: true,
        note: 'walked ladder'
      }
    });
    expect(forwarded.basis).toBe('order-book-depth');
    expect(forwarded.usableLiquidityUsd).toBe(250_000);
    // And the pool figure is still ignored, even though it is much larger.
    expect(forwarded.usableLiquidityUsd).not.toBe(9_999_999);
  });

  it('still refuses polygon when no subscriber supplied a book', () => {
    // The pre-S4-M38 behaviour, retained for the case it was written for.
    const result = usableLiquidityForFanout({
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: 'polygon:token-1',
      poolTvlUsd: 5_000_000
    });
    expect(result.basis).toBe('unknown');
    expect(result.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
  });

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// The cohort projection

describe('projectCohortNotionalUsd', () => {
  it('sums the whole known balance of every admissible user', () => {
    const projection = projectCohortNotionalUsd(
      [
        candidate({ userId: 'a', knownBalanceUsd: 1_000 }),
        candidate({ userId: 'b', knownBalanceUsd: 250 })
      ],
      SIGNAL,
      PLATFORM
    );
    expect(projection.projectedNotionalUsd).toBe(1_250);
    expect(projection.cohortSize).toBe(2);
    expect(projection.basis).toBe('sum-of-admissible-known-balances');
  });

  it('errs high: the bound exceeds what per-user sizing would really request', () => {
    // A user at the default 5% max_position_pct would request $50 of a $1,000
    // balance. The bound charges the whole $1,000, which refuses a cohort that
    // would have fitted rather than admitting one that moves the market.
    const projection = projectCohortNotionalUsd(
      [candidate({ knownBalanceUsd: 1_000 })],
      SIGNAL,
      PLATFORM
    );
    expect(projection.projectedNotionalUsd).toBeGreaterThan(1_000 * 0.05);
    expect(projection.projectedNotionalUsd).toBe(1_000);
  });

  it('excludes users the fan-out would exclude anyway, so the cap is not charged for them', () => {
    const projection = projectCohortNotionalUsd(
      [
        candidate({ userId: 'in', knownBalanceUsd: 100 }),
        candidate({ userId: 'killed', knownBalanceUsd: 9_000, killed: true }),
        candidate({ userId: 'manual', knownBalanceUsd: 9_000, autoExecute: false }),
        candidate({ userId: 'low-score', knownBalanceUsd: 9_000, minSignalScore: 99 }),
        candidate({ userId: 'capped', knownBalanceUsd: 9_000, openPositionCount: 10 }),
        candidate({ userId: 'gone', knownBalanceUsd: 9_000, subscriptionState: 'ended' })
      ],
      SIGNAL,
      PLATFORM
    );
    expect(projection.projectedNotionalUsd).toBe(100);
    expect(projection.cohortSize).toBe(1);
  });

  it('never counts an unknown balance as zero — such a user is excluded upstream', () => {
    const projection = projectCohortNotionalUsd(
      [
        candidate({ userId: 'known', knownBalanceUsd: 500 }),
        candidate({ userId: 'unpriced', knownBalanceUsd: null })
      ],
      SIGNAL,
      PLATFORM
    );
    expect(projection.projectedNotionalUsd).toBe(500);
    expect(projection.cohortSize).toBe(1);
  });

  it('projects zero for an empty candidate list', () => {
    const projection = projectCohortNotionalUsd([], SIGNAL, PLATFORM);
    expect(projection.projectedNotionalUsd).toBe(0);
    expect(projection.cohortSize).toBe(0);
  });

  it('excludes nobody for capacity itself — the provisional plan admits', () => {
    // If the provisional gate were `skip` or `null`, the projection would always
    // be 0 and the cap would admit every cohort.
    const projection = projectCohortNotionalUsd(
      [candidate({ knownBalanceUsd: 777 })],
      SIGNAL,
      PLATFORM
    );
    expect(projection.projectedNotionalUsd).toBe(777);
  });
});

describe('capacityGateFor', () => {
  it('maps an unevaluable cap to null so users read capacity-unknown', async () => {

  });

  it('calls the injected book reader with the cap actually in force (S4-M38)', async () => {
    const readPolymarketBook = vi.fn(async () => ({
      chain: 'polygon' as const,
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      usableLiquidityUsd: 5_000_000,
      basis: 'order-book-depth' as const,
      approximate: true,
      note: 'walked ladder'
    }));

    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null,
      readPolymarketBook,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });

    // The reader must be reached at all -- the inert-wiring failure this repo has
    // hit repeatedly is a value accepted by the pure helper and never fetched.
    expect(readPolymarketBook).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(resolved.capacity).not.toBeNull();
    expect(resolved.decision?.reasonCode).not.toBe('capacity-not-assessable');
  });

  it('hands the reader the platform default cap when no override exists', async () => {
    const readPolymarketBook = vi.fn(async () => ({
      chain: 'polygon' as const,
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      usableLiquidityUsd: 5_000_000,
      basis: 'order-book-depth' as const,
      approximate: true,
      note: 'walked ladder'
    }));

    await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null,
      readPolymarketBook,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });

    expect(readPolymarketBook).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ impactCapBps: PLATFORM_MAX_AGGREGATE_IMPACT_BPS.polygon })
    );
  });

  it("hands the reader the master's override cap, not the platform default", async () => {
    // The reason the read is deferred into this function at all. The published
    // reserve is exact only at its own cap, so pricing the book at the default
    // while the cap judges it at 42bps is a fail-open arithmetic error.
    dbMocks.fetchMasterCapacityPolicy.mockResolvedValue({
      policy: { maxAggregateImpactBps: 42 },
      dailyBudgetShareBps: null
    });
    const readPolymarketBook = vi.fn(async () => ({
      chain: 'polygon' as const,
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      usableLiquidityUsd: 5_000_000,
      basis: 'order-book-depth' as const,
      approximate: true,
      note: 'walked ladder'
    }));

    await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      poolTvlUsd: null,
      readPolymarketBook,
      projection: projectCohortNotionalUsd([candidate()], SIGNAL, PLATFORM),
      now: NOW
    });

    expect(readPolymarketBook).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ impactCapBps: 42 })
    );
    expect(readPolymarketBook).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ impactCapBps: PLATFORM_MAX_AGGREGATE_IMPACT_BPS.polygon })
    );
  });

  it('defaults the cohort direction to buy, the side the cap governs', async () => {
    const readPolymarketBook = vi.fn(async () => ({
      chain: 'polygon' as const,
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,
      usableLiquidityUsd: 5_000_000,
      basis: 'order-book-depth' as const,
      approximate: true,
      note: 'walked ladder'
    }));

    await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,
      chain: 'polygon',
      tokenMint: POLY_TOKEN,

      now: NOW
    });

    expect(readPolymarketBook).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ cohortDirection: 'buy' })

      now: NOW
    });

  });

    await resolveFanoutCapacity({

      now: NOW
    });

    expect(readPolymarketBook).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('still excludes everyone when the reader returns an unknown book', async () => {
    const readPolymarketBook = vi.fn(async () => ({

      approximate: false,
      note: 'polymarket-book-snapshot-stale'

    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,

    // A stale book must not admit anybody. This is the fail-closed direction and

  it('survives a reader that throws, degrading to no feed rather than aborting', async () => {

      throw new Error('redis unreachable');

      now: NOW

    // resolution the way a failed window read does.

    expect(resolved.capacity).toBeNull();
    expect(resolved.logLine).toContain('polymarket book read threw');

  it('admits a polygon cohort once a book verdict is threaded through (S4-M38)', async () => {
    // The wiring assertion. The test directly above proves polygon is
    // unassessable WITHOUT a book; this proves the verdict actually reaches

    // then dropped on the floor -- the correct-but-inert shape this checklist has

    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({
      masterWalletAddress: POLY_MASTER,

  it('maps a real impact breach to skip so users read capacity-exhausted', async () => {
    // $20,000 TVL -> $10,000 usable -> 500 bps on solana -> $500 of room.
    const resolved = await resolveFanoutCapacity({

  it('admits when the cohort fits under the chain ceiling', async () => {
