  rpcUrls: {
    default: { http: [process.env.ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL ?? 'https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com'] },
    public: { http: [process.env.ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL ?? 'https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com'] },
  },
} as const;

function getPublicClient(chain: string) {
  if (chain === 'polygon') {
    const url = process.env.POLYGON_RPC_URL ?? 'https://polygon-bor-rpc.publicnode.com';
    return createPublicClient({ chain: polygon, transport: http(url) });
  } else if (chain === 'robinhood-chain') {
    const url = process.env.ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL ?? 'https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com';
    return createPublicClient({ chain: robinhoodChain, transport: http(url) });
  }
  throw new Error(`Unsupported chain: ${chain}`);
}

const heliusApiKey = process.env.HELIUS_API_KEY;
const heliusRpcUrl = heliusApiKey
  ? `https://mainnet.helius-rpc.com/?api-key=${heliusApiKey}`
  : null;

// ─── Live On-Chain Solana Mint Info ───────────────────────────────────────────

type MintInfo = {
  mintAuthority: string | null;
  freezeAuthority: string | null;
  decimals: number;
};

async function getMintInfoFromChain(tokenMint: string): Promise<MintInfo | null> {
  if (!heliusRpcUrl) return null;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(heliusRpcUrl, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        jsonrpc: '2.0',
        id: 'getMintInfo',
        method: 'getAccountInfo',
        params: [tokenMint, { encoding: 'jsonParsed' }]
      })
    });
    if (!response.ok) return null;
    const json = await response.json() as any;
    const info = json.result?.value?.data?.parsed?.info;
    if (!info) return null;
    return {
      mintAuthority: info.mintAuthority ?? null,
      freezeAuthority: info.freezeAuthority ?? null,
      decimals: info.decimals ?? 9
    };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[safety] getMintInfo error:', e);
    return null;
  }
}

// ─── Solana Top Holder Concentration ──────────────────────────────────────────

async function getTop10HolderPct(tokenMint: string): Promise<number | null> {
  if (!heliusRpcUrl) return null;
  try {
    const [accountsResponse, supplyResponse] = await Promise.all([
      fetch(heliusRpcUrl, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          jsonrpc: '2.0',
          id: 'getTopHolders',
          method: 'getTokenLargestAccounts',
          params: [tokenMint, { commitment: 'finalized' }]
        })
      }),
      fetch(heliusRpcUrl, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          jsonrpc: '2.0',
          id: 'getTokenSupply',
          method: 'getTokenSupply',
          params: [tokenMint, { commitment: 'finalized' }]
        })
      })
    ]);
    if (!accountsResponse.ok || !supplyResponse.ok) return null;

    const accountsJson = await accountsResponse.json() as any;
    const supplyJson = await supplyResponse.json() as any;
    const accounts = accountsJson.result?.value as Array<{ amount?: string }> | undefined;
    const supplyAmount = supplyJson.result?.value?.amount;
    if (!accounts || accounts.length === 0) return null;
    if (typeof supplyAmount !== 'string') return null;

    const totalSupply = BigInt(supplyAmount);
    if (totalSupply <= 0n) return null;
    const top10 = accounts.slice(0, 10).reduce(
      (sum, account) => sum + BigInt(account.amount ?? '0'),
      0n
    );
    return Number((top10 * 10_000n) / totalSupply) / 100;
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[safety] getTopHolderPct error:', e);
    return null;
  }
}

// ─── EVM Contract Owner Read ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function getEvmContractOwner(client: any, address: `0x${string}`) {
  try {
    const owner = await client.readContract({
      address,
      abi: [{ name: 'owner', type: 'function', inputs: [], outputs: [{ type: 'address' }] }],
      functionName: 'owner'
    });
    return String(owner);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// ─── Main Safety Check ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function checkTokenSafety(tokenMint: string): Promise<SafetyResult> {
  const flags: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];

  const prefixChain = getChainPrefix(tokenMint);
  const tokenRows = prefixChain
    ? []
    : await query<{ chain: Chain }>(
        `SELECT chain FROM tokens WHERE mint LIKE '%:' || $1 LIMIT 1`,
        [stripChainPrefix(tokenMint)]
      );
  const chain: Chain = prefixChain ?? tokenRows[0]?.chain ?? 'solana';
  const storedMint = prefixChainValue(tokenMint, chain);
  const rawMint = stripChainPrefix(storedMint);

  let top10Pct: number | null = null;
  let liquidity: number | null = null;

  if (chain === 'solana') {
    // ─── SOLANA SAFETY FLOW ───────────────────
    const mintInfo = await getMintInfoFromChain(rawMint);

    if (!mintInfo) {
      // Helius not configured — fall back to DB values and warn
      const rows = await query<{ mint_authority_disabled: boolean; freeze_authority_disabled: boolean }>(
        `SELECT mint_authority_disabled, freeze_authority_disabled FROM tokens WHERE mint = $1`,
        [storedMint]
      );
      const token = rows[0];
      if (!token) {
        return {
          isSafe: false,
          passed: false,
          flags: ['unverified_token'],
          warnings: ['Token not indexed — cannot verify safety'],
          liquidity: null,
          top10HolderPct: null
        };
      }
      if (!token.mint_authority_disabled) {
        flags.push('MINT_AUTHORITY_ACTIVE');
      }
      if (!token.freeze_authority_disabled) {
        warnings.push('FREEZE_AUTHORITY_SET');
      }
    } else {
      // Live on-chain check
      if (mintInfo.mintAuthority !== null) {
        flags.push('MINT_AUTHORITY_ACTIVE');
      }
      if (mintInfo.freezeAuthority !== null) {
        warnings.push('FREEZE_AUTHORITY_SET');
      }

      // Persist results back to DB so they're cached
      await query(
        `UPDATE tokens SET
           mint_authority_disabled = $1,
           freeze_authority_disabled = $2,
           decimals = $3
         WHERE mint = $4`,
        [
          mintInfo.mintAuthority === null,
          mintInfo.freezeAuthority === null,
          mintInfo.decimals,
          storedMint
        ]
      );
    }

    // Top holder concentration check (Solana largest accounts via Helius)
    top10Pct = await getTop10HolderPct(rawMint);
    if (top10Pct !== null) {
      if (top10Pct > 60) {
        flags.push(`TOP_10_HOLD_${top10Pct}PCT`);
      } else if (top10Pct > 35) {
        warnings.push(`TOP_10_HOLD_${top10Pct}PCT`);
      }
    }

  } else {
    // ─── EVM / EVM L2 SAFETY FLOW ───────────────
    try {
      const client = getPublicClient(chain);
      const owner = await getEvmContractOwner(client, rawMint as `0x${string}`);

      if (owner !== null) {
        const isRenounced = owner === '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000';
        if (!isRenounced) {
          flags.push('OWNER_ACTIVE');
        }

        // Cache in existing DB columns to avoid schema bloat
        await query(
          `UPDATE tokens SET
             mint_authority_disabled = $1,
             freeze_authority_disabled = true
           WHERE mint = $2`,
          [isRenounced, storedMint]
        );
      } else {
        warnings.push('CONTRACT_OWNER_UNVERIFIED');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`[safety] EVM contract owner query failed for ${tokenMint}:`, err);
      warnings.push('CHAIN_RPC_UNREACHABLE');
    }
  }

  // DexScreener liquidity check (works for all chains)
  liquidity = await fetchDexScreenerLiquidity(rawMint, chain);
  if (liquidity !== null && liquidity < 25_000) {
    flags.push(`LOW_LIQUIDITY_${Math.round(liquidity / 1000)}K`);
  } else if (liquidity === null) {
    warnings.push('LIQUIDITY_UNVERIFIED');
  }

  const isSafe = flags.length === 0;

  return {
    isSafe,
    passed: isSafe,
    flags,
    warnings,
    liquidity,
    top10HolderPct: top10Pct
  };
}

==> apps/signal-engine/src/trade-eligibility.test.ts <==
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  TRADE_ELIGIBLE_PATTERNS,
  mayPatternTrade,
  type SignalPatternType
} from './trade-eligibility.js';

/**
 * These tests exist to make ADR-0005 §6.1 hard to undo by accident.
 *
 * The previous shape of this decision was `suppressTrade: true` passed by each
 * cluster detector — four independent literals, none of which any test could
 * reach, because the detectors query the database directly and `index.ts` starts
 * timers at import. Deleting one would have silently resumed trading on a signal
 * whose own definition guarantees it fires.
 */
describe('trade eligibility by signal pattern', () => {
  it('lets a master trade be copied', () => {
    // `source_trade` is the whole product: one wallet a user chose, mirrored.
    expect(mayPatternTrade('source_trade')).toBe(true);
  });

  it.each<SignalPatternType>(['snipe', 'accumulation', 'rotation', 'exit'])(
    'refuses to trade the %s cluster pattern',
    (pattern) => {
      expect(mayPatternTrade(pattern)).toBe(false);
    }
  );

  it('is exactly one pattern, so widening it cannot pass unnoticed', () => {
    // Asserting the whole list rather than individual members. A new pattern that
    // may trade has to change this line, which puts the decision in a diff a
    // reviewer will see, next to a test name explaining why it matters.
    expect([...TRADE_ELIGIBLE_PATTERNS]).toEqual(['source_trade']);
  });

  it('fails closed on a pattern it does not recognise', () => {
    // `enqueueSignal` types `patternType` as `string`, so an unrecognised value
    // reaches this function without a compile error. Alerting on something we
    // cannot classify is fine; trading on it is not.
    expect(mayPatternTrade('cluster_consensus')).toBe(false);
    expect(mayPatternTrade('')).toBe(false);
    expect(mayPatternTrade('SOURCE_TRADE')).toBe(false); // case-sensitive by design
  });

  it('cannot be widened at runtime', () => {
    // `readonly` is a compile-time claim and types vanish at runtime, but this
    // gate decides whether money moves. Two independent protections, both checked
    // here: the exported list is frozen, and the internal lookup is a copy — so
    // even a caster who defeats the first cannot reach the second.
    const escaped = TRADE_ELIGIBLE_PATTERNS as SignalPatternType[];
    expect(() => escaped.push('snipe')).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(TRADE_ELIGIBLE_PATTERNS)).toBe(true);
    expect(mayPatternTrade('snipe')).toBe(false);
  });
});

==> apps/signal-engine/src/trade-eligibility.ts <==
/**
 * Which signal patterns may result in a trade (ADR-0005 §6.1).
 *
 * **Why this exists as a module rather than a literal at each call site.** The
 * decision that cluster patterns are discovery-only was originally expressed as
 * `suppressTrade: true` passed by each of the four cluster detectors. That works
 * until someone deletes one — and deleting one is easy, because the flag reads
 * like a local formatting choice rather than the load-bearing consequence of an
 * ADR. There is no test that can catch its removal at the call site, because the
 * detectors query the database directly and `index.ts` starts timers at import.
 *
 * So the gate lives here instead: a single set, consulted by `enqueueSignal`, and
 * unit-testable without importing the service. Removing `suppressTrade: true`
 * from a detector now changes a log line, not whether money moves.
 *
 * **Why cluster patterns cannot trade.** A cluster is built from wallets that
 * share a funder (`clustering-queries.ts` calls that "the Sybil/coordination
 * signal") or that repeatedly buy the same tokens together. The snipe detector
 * then fires when those wallets buy the same token together — so the grouping
 * predicate and the signal predicate are one statement at two time scales, and
 * firing carries almost no information beyond "this group did what defines it".
 * Worse, co-movement among wallets grouped *for* co-moving is evidence of shared
 * control rather than of a shared fact, and a coordinated group's next move is to
 * sell into the flow their buying attracted. Trading it made us their exit
 * liquidity. Copy trades come from `source_trade` — one master's own trade,
 * mirrored proportionally.
 */

/**
 * Every pattern `enqueueSignal` accepts. Declared here rather than inline at the
 * call site so that adding a pattern is a decision made against this list.
 */
export type SignalPatternType =
  | 'source_trade'
  | 'snipe'
  | 'accumulation'
  | 'rotation'
  | 'exit';

/**
 * The only pattern that may queue a trade.
 *
 * A frozen array rather than an exported `Set`, for a reason that matters more
 * than it looks: `ReadonlySet` is a compile-time claim only, and a `Set` handed
 * out of a module stays mutable at runtime, so one stray `.add()` anywhere in the
 * process would re-enable cluster trading globally with no diff to review. This
 * is frozen, and the lookup below is built from a *copy* — so neither mutating
 * this array nor reaching into the internal set can widen what trades.
 *
 * Deliberately a list rather than a boolean on `source_trade`: it makes "what
 * else could trade?" an explicit question with a visible answer, and the
 * accompanying test asserts the membership exactly, so widening it cannot happen
 * silently.
 */
export const TRADE_ELIGIBLE_PATTERNS: readonly SignalPatternType[] = Object.freeze<
  SignalPatternType[]
>(['source_trade']);

/** Private lookup, copied from the frozen list so external mutation cannot reach it. */
const ELIGIBLE: ReadonlySet<SignalPatternType> = new Set(TRADE_ELIGIBLE_PATTERNS);

/**
 * Whether a pattern may queue a trade.
 *
 * Takes `string` rather than `SignalPatternType` on purpose. `enqueueSignal`'s
 * `patternType` is typed as `string`, so an unrecognised value is reachable
 * without a compile error — and the honest answer for something we do not
 * recognise is "no". Fails closed: an unknown pattern alerts but never trades.
 */
export function mayPatternTrade(patternType: string): boolean {
  return ELIGIBLE.has(patternType as SignalPatternType);
}

  const feeBuffer = DEFAULT_SOLANA_FEE_LAMPORTS; // 5,000n

  it('correctly nets rent exemption and transaction fee from gross lamport balance', () => {
    const total = 10_000_000n; // 0.01 SOL
    const expected = total - rentExemptMin - feeBuffer;
    expect(calculateMaxWithdrawableSolLamports({

==> apps/trade-executor/src/balances.ts <==
import { resolveChainAddress } from '@swat/shared';

type FetchLike = typeof fetch;

type SolanaBalanceResponse = {
  error?: { message?: unknown };
  result?: { value?: unknown };
};

export function capBaseUnitSpend(
  requested: bigint,
  balance: bigint,
  reserve: bigint
): bigint {
  if (requested < 0n || balance < 0n || reserve < 0n) {
    throw new Error('Base-unit balance inputs must be non-negative');
  }
  const spendable = balance > reserve ? balance - reserve : 0n;
  return requested < spendable ? requested : spendable;
}

/** Standard Solana transfer network fee in lamports (0.000005 SOL). */
export const DEFAULT_SOLANA_FEE_LAMPORTS = 5_000n;

/**
 * Calculates the safe maximum withdrawable native SOL in lamports, netting both the
 * rent-exempt minimum required to preserve the vault account on-chain and a network fee buffer.
 *
 * Prevents transaction reverts caused by rent-exemption violations or gas starvation.
 */
export function calculateMaxWithdrawableSolLamports(opts: {
  totalLamports: bigint;
  rentExemptMinLamports: bigint;
  feeBufferLamports?: bigint;
}): bigint {
  const { totalLamports, rentExemptMinLamports, feeBufferLamports = DEFAULT_SOLANA_FEE_LAMPORTS } = opts;
  if (totalLamports < 0n || rentExemptMinLamports < 0n || feeBufferLamports < 0n) {
    throw new Error('Lamport balance inputs must be non-negative');
  }
  const requiredReserve = rentExemptMinLamports + feeBufferLamports;
  return totalLamports > requiredReserve ? totalLamports - requiredReserve : 0n;
}

export async function fetchSolanaBalanceSol(opts: {
  walletAddress: string;
  heliusApiKey: string;
  timeoutMs: number;
  fetchFn?: FetchLike;
}): Promise<number> {
  const walletAddress = resolveChainAddress(opts.walletAddress, 'solana').raw;
  if (!opts.heliusApiKey) {
    throw new Error('HELIUS_API_KEY is required to verify the Trojan wallet balance');
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(opts.timeoutMs) || opts.timeoutMs <= 0) {
    throw new Error('Solana balance timeout must be a positive integer');
  }

  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), opts.timeoutMs);
  try {
    const response = await (opts.fetchFn ?? fetch)(
      `https://mainnet.helius-rpc.com/?api-key=${encodeURIComponent(opts.heliusApiKey)}`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        signal: controller.signal,
        body: JSON.stringify({
          jsonrpc: '2.0',
          id: 'swat-trade-balance',
          method: 'getBalance',
          params: [walletAddress, { commitment: 'confirmed' }]
        })
      }
    );
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Solana balance RPC returned HTTP ${response.status}`);
    }

    const body = await response.json() as SolanaBalanceResponse;
    if (body.error) {
      throw new Error(`Solana balance RPC error: ${String(body.error.message ?? 'unknown error')}`);
    }
    const lamports = body.result?.value;
    if (typeof lamports !== 'number' || !Number.isSafeInteger(lamports) || lamports < 0) {
      throw new Error('Solana balance RPC returned an invalid lamport balance');
    }
    return lamports / 1_000_000_000;
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

==> apps/trade-executor/src/canonical-copy.ts <==
import { parseUnits } from 'viem';
import type { Chain, CopyExecutionMode } from '@swat/shared';

const PAPER_TARGETS: Record<Chain, string> = {
  solana: '11111111111111111111111111111111',
  polygon: '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001',
  'robinhood-chain': '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001',
  base: '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001',
  ethereum: '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001',
  bsc: '0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001'
};

/**
 * The synthetic account paper executions settle "from".
 *
 * ONE address per chain, shared by every paper user — deliberately, and this is
 * now correct rather than merely tolerated. Paper mode has no counterparty, so
 * there is no real address to name; minting a per-user fake address would
 * invent one, and every downstream consumer that reasonably assumes an address
 * corresponds to something on-chain (grant lookups, reconcilers, explorer
 * links, user_execution_grants.uq_ueg_account) would then be reading a fiction.
 *
 * Before migration 050_copy_tenancy.sql the sharing WAS a bug, because
 * copy_positions was keyed (target_account, chain, token_mint): every paper
 * user on a chain collapsed onto one row, so A's buy inflated B's
 * confirmed_quantity and B's exit computed P&L against A's cost basis. The fix
 * was to put user_id in the key, not to make the address per-user.
 *
 * So: do NOT make this per-user. If two paper users appear to share a position,
 * the missing piece is a userId that was not threaded to
 * requestCopyExecution / claimSourceSignalForCopyExecution, not this address.
 *
 * NOT YET PROVEN: S4-10's acceptance test — two paper users on one chain and
 * token holding independent quantities and cost bases, written so that it fails
 * against the old three-column key — has not been written. Until it exists this
 * comment describes the intent of 050, not a verified property.
 */
const PAPER_TARGET_ENV: Record<Chain, string> = {
  solana: 'PAPER_COPY_ACCOUNT_SOLANA',
  polygon: 'PAPER_COPY_ACCOUNT_POLYGON',
  'robinhood-chain': 'PAPER_COPY_ACCOUNT_ROBINHOOD_CHAIN',
  base: 'PAPER_COPY_ACCOUNT_BASE',
  ethereum: 'PAPER_COPY_ACCOUNT_ETHEREUM',
  bsc: 'PAPER_COPY_ACCOUNT_BSC'
};

export function resolvePaperCopyTargetAccount(
  chain: Chain,
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env
): string {
  return env[PAPER_TARGET_ENV[chain]]?.trim() || PAPER_TARGETS[chain];
}

export function executionModesForChainMode(
  mode: 'paper' | 'live' | 'live+shadow'
): CopyExecutionMode[] {
  if (mode === 'live+shadow') return ['live', 'shadow'];
  return [mode];
}

export function sourceSellFractionToBps(value: string): number {
  if (!/^(?:0(?:\.\d+)?|1(?:\.0+)?)$/.test(value)) {
    throw new Error('source sell fraction must be a decimal between 0 and 1');
  }
  const bps = Math.floor(Number(value) * 10_000);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(bps) || bps < 1 || bps > 10_000) {
    throw new Error('source sell fraction rounds outside 1..10000 basis points');
  }
  return bps;
}

export function decimalQuantityToBaseUnits(quantity: string, decimals: number): bigint {
  if (!Number.isInteger(decimals) || decimals < 0 || decimals > 255) {
    throw new Error('token decimals must be an integer between 0 and 255');
  }
  if (!/^(?:\d+\.?\d*|\d*\.\d+)$/.test(quantity)) {
    throw new Error('token quantity must be an unsigned decimal');
  }
  const baseUnits = parseUnits(quantity, decimals);
  if (baseUnits <= 0n) throw new Error('token quantity rounds to zero base units');
  return baseUnits;
}

  });

    const decision = await enforceCopyEligibility(signal, deps({
      loadFacts: async () => {
        throw new Error('db down');

    }));

    expect(decision).toEqual({ allowed: false, reasons: ['source-facts-unreadable'] });

==> apps/trade-executor/src/copy-eligibility.ts <==
import type { CopyEligibilityFacts, CopyEligibilityRejection } from '@swat/db';
import type { Chain } from '@swat/shared';
import { evaluateCopyPolicy } from '@swat/shared';

/**
 * The copy-eligibility policy for the canonical claim boundary.
 *
 * Everything else in `handleJob` asks "can this trade be executed safely?" —
 * balances, exposure caps, chain readiness, token safety. Nothing asked the
 * prior question: "do we still follow the wallet that produced this signal, and
 * has it done enough for us to have an opinion about it?" The signal-engine
 * checks selection when it *emits* a candidate, but the nightly scorer sweep
 * pauses underperforming wallets, and a signal that sat in the queue across
 * that sweep would still be copied from a source we have since dropped.
 *
 * This runs before the claim rather than after it on purpose. Claiming first
 * and rejecting after would burn the signal's one-shot canonical claim and
 * leave a `requested` execution row that has to be cancelled — extra lifecycle
 * state for a trade we were never going to place.
 */

/** Operator account this policy runs for (Standing Rule 2). */
export const COPY_ELIGIBILITY_ACCOUNT = 'operator';

export interface CopyEligibilityThresholds {
  /** Reject a source event older than this — the price it implies is gone. */
  maxEventAgeMs: number;
  /** Tolerance for an indexer clock running ahead of ours. */
  maxClockSkewMs: number;
  /** Confirmed USD the source wallet must have traded in the lookback window. */
  minimumSourceActivityUsd: number;
  /** Lifetime recorded trades the source wallet must have. */
  minimumSourceTradeCount: number;
  /** How far back `minimumSourceActivityUsd` is measured. */
  activityLookbackMs: number;
}

export type CopyEligibilityDecision =
  | { allowed: true; facts: CopyEligibilityFacts }
  | { allowed: false; reasons: string[] };

export interface CopyEligibilityDependencies {
  loadFacts: (input: {
    signalId: string;
    activityLookbackMs: number;
    now: Date;
  }) => Promise<CopyEligibilityFacts | null>;
  recordRejection: (input: CopyEligibilityRejection) => Promise<unknown>;
  thresholds: CopyEligibilityThresholds;
  now?: () => Date;
}

export async function enforceCopyEligibility(
  input: { account: string; signalId: string; chain: Chain },
  dependencies: CopyEligibilityDependencies
): Promise<CopyEligibilityDecision> {
  const { thresholds } = dependencies;
  const now = dependencies.now?.() ?? new Date();

  let facts: CopyEligibilityFacts | null;
  try {
    facts = await dependencies.loadFacts({
      signalId: input.signalId,
      activityLookbackMs: thresholds.activityLookbackMs,
      now
    });
  } catch (error) {
    // A policy that cannot read its own inputs must not wave the trade through.
    console.error(
      `[trade-executor] copy-eligibility lookup failed for signal ${input.signalId}`,
      error
    );
    return reject(input, dependencies, null, ['source-facts-unreadable'], now);
  }

  if (!facts) {
    return reject(input, dependencies, null, ['source-facts-unavailable'], now);
  }

  // The queued job derived its chain from the token mint prefix; the facts come
  // from the immutable source event. If they disagree, one of them is about a
  // different trade and neither can be trusted to gate this claim.
  if (facts.chain !== input.chain) {
    return reject(input, dependencies, facts, ['source-chain-mismatch'], now);
  }

  const decision = evaluateCopyPolicy({
    chain: facts.chain,
    selectedWallet: facts.walletKnown && facts.walletStatus === 'active',
    selectedCluster: facts.clusterSelected,
    eventAt: facts.eventAt,
    now,
    maxEventAgeMs: thresholds.maxEventAgeMs,
    maxClockSkewMs: thresholds.maxClockSkewMs,
    sourceActivityUsd: facts.sourceActivityUsd,
    minimumSourceActivityUsd: thresholds.minimumSourceActivityUsd,
    // The remaining gates in `evaluateCopyPolicy` have owners elsewhere and are
    // passed satisfied so this boundary reports only what it actually decided:
    // liquidity and token safety by the signal-engine screen that has to pass
    // before a trade job is queued at all, exposure by the rolling 24h cap in
    // `handleJob` just above this call, and chain readiness by `resolveChainMode`
    // plus the `execMode === 'off'` return. Duplicating them here with a second
    // set of thresholds would give two answers to the same question.
    liquidityUsd: 0,
    minimumLiquidityUsd: 0,
    currentExposureUsd: 0,
    requestedExposureUsd: 0,
    maximumExposureUsd: 0,
    chainReady: true,
    supportedAsset: true,
    safetyAllowed: true
  });

  const reasons = [...decision.reasons];
  if (!facts.walletKnown) {
    reasons.push('source-wallet-untracked');
  }
  // `evaluateCopyPolicy` measures activity in USD only. A wallet can clear a USD
  // floor on a single outsized trade while having no track record at all, which
  // is the case a count floor catches.
  if (facts.walletTradeCount < thresholds.minimumSourceTradeCount) {
    reasons.push('source-trade-count-below-minimum');
  }

  if (reasons.length > 0) {
    return reject(input, dependencies, facts, [...new Set(reasons)], now);
  }
  return { allowed: true, facts };
}

async function reject(
  input: { account: string; signalId: string; chain: Chain },
  dependencies: CopyEligibilityDependencies,
  facts: CopyEligibilityFacts | null,
  reasons: string[],
  rejectedAt: Date
): Promise<CopyEligibilityDecision> {
  try {
    await dependencies.recordRejection({
      account: input.account,
      signalId: input.signalId,
      chain: facts?.chain ?? input.chain,
      walletAddress: facts?.walletAddress ?? null,
      reasons,
      rejectedAt
    });
  } catch (error) {
    // Losing the audit row is bad, but executing a trade we already decided
    // against is worse. The decision stands either way.
    console.error(
      `[trade-executor] failed to record copy-eligibility rejection for signal ${input.signalId}`,
      error
    );
  }
  return { allowed: false, reasons };
}

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { PaymasterBudgetTracker } from './paymaster-budget.js';
import {

  type VenueActionKind
} from './execution-authority.js';

/**
 * The six adapters (`S4-P7`). No key, no RPC, no wallet client — every dependency
 * is a function, which is the whole reason the port has this shape.
 */

const OPERATOR: ExecutionPrincipal = { kind: 'operator' };
const ALICE: ExecutionPrincipal = { kind: 'user', userId: 'alice' };

function request(
  chain: GrantedExecutionAuthority['chain'],
  principal: ExecutionPrincipal,
  action: VenueActionKind = 'venue-trade'
): ExecutionAuthorityRequest {
  return { chain, principal, action };
}

function fakeSolanaSigner(): SolanaTransactionSigner & {
  signed: string[];
  tips: { tipAccount: string; lamports: number }[];
} {
  const signed: string[] = [];
  const tips: { tipAccount: string; lamports: number }[] = [];
  return {
    publicKey: 'SoLSigner11111111111111111111111111111111111',
    signed,
    tips,
    async sign(transactionBase64) {
      signed.push(transactionBase64);
      return `signed:${transactionBase64}`;
    },
    async buildTip(input) {
      tips.push(input);
      return `tip:${input.tipAccount}:${input.lamports}`;
    }
  };
}

const PERMIT: Eip712TypedData = {
  domain: { name: 'Permit2', chainId: 4663, verifyingContract: '0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3' },
  types: {
    PermitSingle: [
      { name: 'details', type: 'PermitDetails' },
      { name: 'spender', type: 'address' },
      { name: 'sigDeadline', type: 'uint256' }
    ]
  },
  primaryType: 'PermitSingle',
  message: { spender: '0xrouter', sigDeadline: '1' }
};

function granted(
  verdict: Awaited<ReturnType<ReturnType<typeof createOperatorSolanaAuthority>['authorize']>>
): GrantedExecutionAuthority {
  if (verdict.kind !== 'granted') {
    throw new Error(`expected a grant, got ${verdict.code}: ${verdict.reason}`);
  }
  return verdict.authority;
}

describe('operator Solana adapter', () => {
  it('settles on the Trojan wallet and reports the Jito signer separately', async () => {
    const signer = fakeSolanaSigner();
    const authority = createOperatorSolanaAuthority({
      trojanWalletAddress: () => 'TrojanWallet1111111111111111111111111111111',
      signer: () => signer
    });

    const grant = granted(await authority.authorize(request('solana', OPERATOR)));

    // Preserved exactly: `copy_executions.target_account` has always held the
    // Trojan wallet on Solana, on both routes. Changing it would orphan every
    // in-flight canonical execution.
    expect(grant.settlementAddress).toBe('TrojanWallet1111111111111111111111111111111');
    expect(grant.signingAddress).toBe(signer.publicKey);
    expect(grant.capabilities).toEqual(['venue-managed-submission', 'sign-chain-transaction']);
    expect(grant.principal).toEqual(OPERATOR);
    expect(grant.expiresAt).toBeNull();
  });

  it('grants with no signing address when only the Trojan route is configured', async () => {
    const authority = createOperatorSolanaAuthority({
      trojanWalletAddress: () => 'TrojanWallet1111111111111111111111111111111',
      signer: () => null
    });

    const grant = granted(await authority.authorize(request('solana', OPERATOR)));

    // The certified default. Authority exists — a third party holds the key —
    // so this must be a grant, not a denial, or live Solana stops working.
    expect(grant.signingAddress).toBeNull();
    expect(grant.capabilities).toEqual(['venue-managed-submission']);
  });

  it('signs a transaction and builds a tip through the injected signer', async () => {
    const signer = fakeSolanaSigner();
    const authority = createOperatorSolanaAuthority({
      trojanWalletAddress: () => 'TrojanWallet1111111111111111111111111111111',
      signer: () => signer
    });
    const grant = granted(await authority.authorize(request('solana', OPERATOR)));

    expect(await grant.sign({ kind: 'solana-transaction', transactionBase64: 'AQID' }))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'signed', encoding: 'base64', value: 'signed:AQID' });
    expect(await grant.sign({ kind: 'solana-tip-transfer', tipAccount: 'tip1', lamports: 42 }))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'signed', encoding: 'base64', value: 'tip:tip1:42' });
    expect(signer.signed).toEqual(['AQID']);
    expect(signer.tips).toEqual([{ tipAccount: 'tip1', lamports: 42 }]);
  });

  it('refuses a signing shape it never advertised', async () => {
    const authority = createOperatorSolanaAuthority({
      trojanWalletAddress: () => 'TrojanWallet1111111111111111111111111111111',
      signer: () => null
    });
    const grant = granted(await authority.authorize(request('solana', OPERATOR)));

    // No `sign-chain-transaction` capability on the Trojan-only route, so being
    // handed transaction bytes is a refusal with a code — not a throw, and
    // certainly not a signature from somewhere else.
    expect(await grant.sign({ kind: 'solana-transaction', transactionBase64: 'AQID' }))

    expect(await grant.sign({ kind: 'eip712-typed-data', typedData: PERMIT }))

  it('reads its dependencies at authorize time, not at construction', async () => {

    // exist when the module graph loads. A snapshot taken at construction would

    let signer: SolanaTransactionSigner | null = null;
    const authority = createOperatorSolanaAuthority({

    });
    const grant = granted(await authority.authorize(request('robinhood-chain', OPERATOR)));

    const result = await grant.sign({ kind: 'eip712-typed-data', typedData: PERMIT });

    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'refused', code: 'authority-signing-failed' });
    expect(result.kind === 'refused' && result.reason).toContain('hardware wallet locked');
    expect(result.kind === 'refused' && result.reason).not.toContain('sigDeadline');
  });
});

describe('operator Polymarket adapter', () => {
  it('separates the funder it settles against from the signer it signs with', async () => {
    const authority = createOperatorPolymarketAuthority({
      identity: () => ({
        signerAddress: '0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000aa',
        funderAddress: '0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000bb'
      }),
      typedDataSigner: () => async () => '0xorder'
    });

    const grant = granted(await authority.authorize(request('polygon', OPERATOR)));

    // `target_account` has always held the funder here. The split is real —
    // `signatureType` 1 and 2 separate `signer_address` from `maker_address` —
    // and it is the same split every delegation mechanism would have needed.
    expect(grant.settlementAddress).toBe('0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000bb');
    expect(grant.signingAddress).toBe('0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000aa');
  });

  it('authorizes a redemption, which also submits from the signer', async () => {
    const authority = createOperatorPolymarketAuthority({
      identity: () => ({ signerAddress: '0xaa', funderAddress: '0xbb' }),
      typedDataSigner: () => null
    });

    expect(await authority.authorize(request('polygon', OPERATOR, 'position-redemption')))
      .toMatchObject({ kind: 'granted' });
  });

  it('denies when the Polymarket identity cannot be resolved', async () => {
    const authority = createOperatorPolymarketAuthority({
      identity: () => null,
      typedDataSigner: () => null
    });

    expect(await authority.authorize(request('polygon', OPERATOR))).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'denied',
      code: 'authority-operator-not-configured'
    });
  });
});

describe('per-user adapters fail closed when mechanism is unavailable', () => {
  it.each([
    ['solana', createUserSolanaAuthority({ enabled: false }), 'authority-solana-delegate-unavailable'],
    [
      'robinhood-chain',
      createUserRobinhoodAuthority(),
      'authority-evm-session-key-unavailable'
    ],
    ['polygon', createUserPolymarketAuthority(), 'authority-polymarket-delegation-unsupported']
  ] as const)('%s denies with %s', async (chain, authority, code) => {
    const verdict = await authority.authorize(request(chain, ALICE));

    expect(verdict).toMatchObject({ kind: 'denied', code });
    // A generic error would send an operator to read the wrong thing. Each
    // reason names the blocking checklist item or the ADR section that settles it.
    expect(verdict.kind === 'denied' && verdict.reason).toMatch(/S4-|ADR-0003|section/);
    expect(verdict.kind === 'denied' && verdict.reason).toContain('user:alice');
  });

  it('gives the three chains three different codes when unavailable', async () => {
    // Deliberately distinct: two are scheduling answers with very different
    // schedules, and Polymarket's is architectural. One shared code would send
    // an operator to debug the wrong thing, the mistake `solana-simulation.ts`
    // splits `refuse` from `unavailable` to avoid.
    const codes = new Set<string>();
    for (const adapter of [
      createUserSolanaAuthority({ enabled: false }),
      createUserRobinhoodAuthority(),
      createUserPolymarketAuthority()
    ]) {
      const verdict = await adapter.authorize(request(adapter.chain, ALICE));
      if (verdict.kind === 'denied') codes.add(verdict.code);
    }

    expect(codes.size).toBe(3);
  });

  it('never serves the operator, so a missing per-user grant cannot borrow one', async () => {
    for (const adapter of [
      createUserSolanaAuthority(),
      createUserRobinhoodAuthority(),
      createUserPolymarketAuthority()
    ]) {
      expect(adapter.serves(OPERATOR)).toBe(false);
      expect(adapter.serves(ALICE)).toBe(true);
    }
  });
});

describe('live per-user Solana WAKE Vault adapter', () => {

describe('the full adapter set', () => {
  const deps = {
    solana: {
      trojanWalletAddress: () => 'TrojanWallet1111111111111111111111111111111',
      signer: () => fakeSolanaSigner()
    },
    robinhoodChain: {
      accountAddress: () => '0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000aa',
      typedDataSigner: () => null
    },
    polygon: {
      identity: () => ({ signerAddress: '0xaa', funderAddress: '0xbb' }),
      typedDataSigner: () => null
    }
  };

  it('covers every chain for both principals', async () => {
    const resolve = createExecutionAuthorityRegistry(createExecutionAuthorityAdapters(deps));

    for (const chain of ['solana', 'robinhood-chain', 'polygon'] as const) {
      // Every operator request is granted.
      expect(await resolve(request(chain, OPERATOR))).toMatchObject({ kind: 'granted' });
      const forUser = await resolve(request(chain, ALICE));

      if (chain === 'solana') {
        // Solana per-user authority is routed to the live audited WAKE Vault program
        expect(forUser.kind).toBe('granted');
        if (forUser.kind === 'granted') {
          expect(forUser.authority.adapterId).toBe('user-solana');
        }
      } else {
        // Robinhood and Polymarket per-user requests fail closed until respective mechanisms are live
        expect(forUser.kind).toBe('denied');
        expect(forUser.kind === 'denied' && forUser.code).not.toBe('authority-adapter-missing');
      }
    }
  });

  it('denies user Solana request when explicitly disabled in adapters set', async () => {
    const resolve = createExecutionAuthorityRegistry(
      createExecutionAuthorityAdapters(deps, { enabled: false })
    );
    const forUser = await resolve(request('solana', ALICE));
    expect(forUser.kind).toBe('denied');
    if (forUser.kind === 'denied') {
      expect(forUser.code).toBe('authority-solana-delegate-unavailable');
    }
  });

  it('registers the operator adapters in the same list as the per-user ones', () => {
    const adapters = createExecutionAuthorityAdapters(deps);

    // Criterion 4 of `S4-P7`, asserted structurally: six adapters, one interface,
    // no chain served by only one class of principal. If someone lifts the
    // operator path back out into a branch, this count changes.
    expect(adapters).toHaveLength(6);
    for (const chain of ['solana', 'robinhood-chain', 'polygon'] as const) {
      const onChain = adapters.filter((adapter) => adapter.chain === chain);
      expect(onChain.filter((adapter) => adapter.serves(OPERATOR))).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(onChain.filter((adapter) => adapter.serves(ALICE))).toHaveLength(1);
    }
  });

  describe('grant lifecycle evaluation (S4-P9)', () => {
    it('denies with authority-grant-missing when no grant row exists', async () => {
      const adapter = createUserRobinhoodAuthority({
        loadGrant: async () => null
      });
      const verdict = await adapter.authorize(request('robinhood-chain', ALICE));
      expect(verdict).toEqual({
        kind: 'denied',
        code: 'authority-grant-missing',
        reason: 'No execution authority grant found for user alice'
      });
    });

    it('denies with authority-grant-revoked when grant was revoked or compromised', async () => {
      const adapter = createUserRobinhoodAuthority({
        loadGrant: async () => ({ status: 'revoked', expiresAt: null })
      });
      const verdict = await adapter.authorize(request('robinhood-chain', ALICE));
      expect(verdict).toEqual({
        kind: 'denied',
        code: 'authority-grant-revoked',
        reason: 'Execution authority grant has been revoked for user alice'
      });
    });

    it('denies with authority-grant-expired when session key has passed its expiresAt (S4-P9)', async () => {
      const expiry = new Date('2026-08-01T00:00:00Z');
      const adapter = createUserRobinhoodAuthority({
        loadGrant: async () => ({ status: 'active', expiresAt: expiry }),
        now: () => new Date('2026-08-02T00:00:00Z')
      });
      const verdict = await adapter.authorize(request('robinhood-chain', ALICE));
      expect(verdict).toMatchObject({
        kind: 'denied',
        code: 'authority-grant-expired'
      });
      if (verdict.kind === 'denied') {
        expect(verdict.reason).toContain('expired at 2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z');
      }
    });

    it('denies with authority-grant-expired when grant status is retired', async () => {
      const adapter = createUserRobinhoodAuthority({
        loadGrant: async () => ({ status: 'retired', expiresAt: null })
      });
      const verdict = await adapter.authorize(request('robinhood-chain', ALICE));
      expect(verdict).toMatchObject({
        kind: 'denied',
        code: 'authority-grant-expired'
      });
    });
  });

  describe('paymaster spend cap and per-user rate limit (S4-P8)', () => {
    it('denies with authority-paymaster-user-rate-limited when user daily limit exceeded', async () => {
      const tracker = new PaymasterBudgetTracker({
        globalDailyCap: 100,
        userDailyCap: 2
      });
      const now = new Date('2026-10-29T10:00:00Z');
      tracker.recordOperation('alice', now);
      tracker.recordOperation('alice', now);

      const adapter = createUserRobinhoodAuthority({
        paymasterTracker: tracker,
        now: () => now
      });

      const verdict = await adapter.authorize(request('robinhood-chain', ALICE));
      expect(verdict).toMatchObject({
        kind: 'denied',
        code: 'authority-paymaster-user-rate-limited'
      });
      if (verdict.kind === 'denied') {
        expect(verdict.reason).toContain('Paymaster user daily sponsored operation limit exceeded for alice');
      }
    });

    it('denies with authority-paymaster-global-budget-exhausted when global daily budget exhausted', async () => {
      const tracker = new PaymasterBudgetTracker({
        globalDailyCap: 1,
        userDailyCap: 10
      });
      const now = new Date('2026-10-29T10:00:00Z');
      tracker.recordOperation('bob', now);

      const adapter = createUserRobinhoodAuthority({
        paymasterTracker: tracker,
        now: () => now
      });

      const verdict = await adapter.authorize(request('robinhood-chain', ALICE));
      expect(verdict).toMatchObject({
        kind: 'denied',
        code: 'authority-paymaster-global-budget-exhausted'
      });
      if (verdict.kind === 'denied') {
        expect(verdict.reason).toContain('Paymaster global daily sponsored budget exhausted');
      }
    });
  });
});

==> apps/trade-executor/src/execution-authority-adapters.ts <==
import {
  capabilityForSigningRequest,
  denied,
  describePrincipal,
  type AuthorityCapability,
  type AuthoritySigningRequest,
  type AuthoritySigningResult,
  type Eip712TypedData,
  type ExecutionAuthorityDenialCode,
  type ExecutionAuthorityRequest,
  type ExecutionAuthorityVerdict,
  type ExecutionPrincipal,
  type GrantedExecutionAuthority,
  type UserExecutionAuthority,
  type VenueActionKind
} from './execution-authority.js';
import type { Chain } from '@swat/shared';
import type { PaymasterBudgetTracker } from './paymaster-budget.js';

/**
 * The six adapters behind `UserExecutionAuthority` (checklist `S4-P7`).
 *
 * Three chains × two classes of principal. They live in one file on purpose:
 * the acceptance criterion that matters most is that **the operator path is one
 * adapter among them rather than a special case**, and that is easiest to keep
 * honest when the operator adapter is registered in the same list, by the same
 * factory, satisfying the same interface as the per-user ones. If operator
 * authority ever needs a shape the interface cannot express, that will show up
 * here as a compile error rather than as an `if` in `handleJob`.
 *
 * ## Everything is injected
 *
 * No `process.env`, no `viem`, no `ethers`, no `@solana/web3.js`, no
 * `@polymarket/client` in this module. Each operator adapter takes accessor
 * functions, bound in `index.ts` at the edge. That is Standing Rule 2, the same
 * reason `solana-signer.ts` is a parameter to `createJupiterJitoRuntime` and
 * `EvmNonceLock` is a parameter to `executeRobinhoodOrder`, and it is what lets
 * the whole set be tested without a key, an RPC or a wallet client.
 *
 * The accessors are called **at authorize time, not at construction**, because
 * live readiness is discovered during startup: `verifyPolymarketEnvironment` and
 * `createJupiterJitoRuntimeFromEnvironment` both run after the module graph is
 * loaded, so a snapshot taken at construction would report every route
 * unconfigured for the life of the process.
 *
 * ## The per-user adapters deny, and say which mechanism is missing
 *
 * None of the three per-user mechanisms exists. `S4-7`'s
 * `047 user_execution_grants` is unbuilt, the Solana Anchor delegate program of
 * ADR-0003 §3 is unwritten and unaudited, and ADR-0003 §4.3 settles that
 * Polymarket has no scoped-signer primitive at all. So each per-user adapter is
 * a **registered, reachable adapter that refuses with its own code**, not a
 * missing entry and not a stub that pretends. A missing entry would deny too —
 * with `authority-adapter-missing`, which reads like a wiring bug and would send
 * an operator to look at the registry instead of at the checklist item.
 *
 * What none of them does is return the operator's grant. That is the single
 * failure this port exists to prevent: a user's copy filled with the operator's
 * key looks identical to success from every direction.
 */

/**
 * The slice of `SolanaSigner` an authority adapter needs.
 *
 * Declared structurally rather than importing `SolanaSigner` so this module does
 * not pull `@solana/web3.js` into its graph. `SolanaSigner` satisfies it.
 */
export interface SolanaTransactionSigner {
  readonly publicKey: string;
  sign(transactionBase64: string): Promise<string>;
  buildTip(input: { tipAccount: string; lamports: number }): Promise<string>;
}

/** Produces an EIP-712 signature. `viem` and `ethers` both fit this shape. */
export type TypedDataSigner = (typedData: Eip712TypedData) => Promise<string>;

export interface OperatorSolanaAuthorityDeps {
  /**
   * The funded Trojan wallet. This is what `copy_executions.target_account`
   * holds on Solana today — on both routes, including Jupiter + Jito. Preserved
   * exactly: it is the canonical claim identity, and changing it would orphan
   * every in-flight execution.
   */
  trojanWalletAddress(): string | null;
  /**
   * The Jupiter + Jito signer, or `null` when that route is unconfigured — the
   * normal posture for a paper box, which must not be made to hold a key it
   * never uses.
   */
  signer(): SolanaTransactionSigner | null;
}

export interface OperatorEvmAuthorityDeps {
  /** `EVM_PRIVATE_KEY`'s address, or `null` when the key is absent. */
  accountAddress(): string | null;
  /** Present only when the key is. Used by Permit2 (`S4-M13`). */
  typedDataSigner(): TypedDataSigner | null;
}

export interface OperatorPolymarketAuthorityDeps {
  /**
   * The resolved Polymarket identity. `signerAddress` authorizes each `Order`
   * struct; `funderAddress` is the wallet the venue debits, and the two differ
   * under `signatureType` 1 and 2 (ADR-0003 §4).
   */
  identity(): { readonly signerAddress: string; readonly funderAddress: string } | null;
  typedDataSigner(): TypedDataSigner | null;
}

export interface OperatorAuthorityDeps {
  readonly solana: OperatorSolanaAuthorityDeps;
  readonly robinhoodChain: OperatorEvmAuthorityDeps;
  readonly polygon: OperatorPolymarketAuthorityDeps;
}

const OPERATOR: ExecutionPrincipal = { kind: 'operator' };

function servesOperator(principal: ExecutionPrincipal): boolean {
  return principal.kind === 'operator';
}

function servesUser(principal: ExecutionPrincipal): boolean {
  return principal.kind === 'user';
}

/**
 * Builds the `sign` implementation shared by every operator adapter.
 *
 * One place decides "is this signing shape within the declared capabilities",
 * so a grant can never advertise `sign-typed-data` and then throw on being
 * handed typed data, and can never quietly sign something outside what it
 * advertised. Both failures are returned as refusals with codes rather than
 * thrown, because the caller is a money path that must be able to record a
 * reason and stop.
 */
function signerFor(input: {
  readonly adapterId: string;
  readonly capabilities: readonly AuthorityCapability[];
  readonly solana: SolanaTransactionSigner | null;
  readonly typedData: TypedDataSigner | null;
}): (request: AuthoritySigningRequest) => Promise<AuthoritySigningResult> {
  return async (request) => {
    const needed = capabilityForSigningRequest(request);
    if (!input.capabilities.includes(needed)) {
      return {
        kind: 'refused',
        code: 'authority-capability-unsupported',
        reason: `${input.adapterId} cannot ${needed} (has: ${input.capabilities.join(', ')})`
      };
    }
    try {
      if (request.kind === 'solana-transaction') {
        if (!input.solana) return missingMechanism(input.adapterId, needed);
        return {
          kind: 'signed',
          encoding: 'base64',
          value: await input.solana.sign(request.transactionBase64)
        };
      }
      if (request.kind === 'solana-tip-transfer') {
        if (!input.solana) return missingMechanism(input.adapterId, needed);
        return {
          kind: 'signed',
          encoding: 'base64',
          value: await input.solana.buildTip({
            tipAccount: request.tipAccount,
            lamports: request.lamports
          })
        };
      }
      if (!input.typedData) return missingMechanism(input.adapterId, needed);
      return {
        kind: 'signed',
        encoding: 'hex',
        value: await input.typedData(request.typedData)
      };
    } catch (error) {
      // Never echo the payload: a Permit2 permit carries an amount and a
      // spender, and a Solana transaction body is large enough to bury the
      // actual cause in a log line.
      return {
        kind: 'refused',
        code: 'authority-signing-failed',
        reason: `${input.adapterId} failed to ${needed}: `
          + (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error))
      };
    }
  };
}

function missingMechanism(
  adapterId: string,
  needed: AuthorityCapability
): AuthoritySigningResult {
  return {
    kind: 'refused',
    code: 'authority-capability-unsupported',
    reason: `${adapterId} advertised ${needed} but its signer is no longer configured`
  };
}

/**
 * Operator authority on Solana.
 *
 * Two routes, one adapter, because both spend the same operator float and both
 * record the same `target_account`: the Trojan webhook (certified, the default)
 * and Jupiter + Jito (built, uncertified, gated on `S3-9`). The route selection
 * stays in `solana-executor-selection.ts` — this adapter only reports whether a
 * signing key exists, which is what `shouldUseJupiterJito`'s `jitoReady` needs.
 */
export function createOperatorSolanaAuthority(
  deps: OperatorSolanaAuthorityDeps
): UserExecutionAuthority {
  const id = 'operator-solana';
  return {
    id,
    chain: 'solana',
    serves: servesOperator,
    async authorize(request) {
      const settlementAddress = deps.trojanWalletAddress();
      if (!settlementAddress) {
        return denied(
          'authority-operator-not-configured',
          'TROJAN_WALLET_ADDRESS is required for operator execution on solana'
        );
      }
      const signer = deps.signer();
      const capabilities: AuthorityCapability[] = ['venue-managed-submission'];
      if (signer) capabilities.push('sign-chain-transaction');
      const unsupported = rejectUnsupportedAction(id, request, ['venue-trade']);
      if (unsupported) return unsupported;
      return {
        kind: 'granted',
        authority: {
          adapterId: id,
          chain: 'solana',
          principal: OPERATOR,
          settlementAddress,
          signingAddress: signer?.publicKey ?? null,
          capabilities,
          expiresAt: null,
          sign: signerFor({ adapterId: id, capabilities, solana: signer, typedData: null })
        }
      };
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Operator authority on Robinhood Chain.
 *
 * `settlementAddress` is `EVM_PRIVATE_KEY`'s address, which is also the key the
 * per-account nonce serialisation in `robinhood.ts` locks on. Do not derive it
 * anywhere else: `withSubmissionLock` and `EvmNonceLock` are both keyed by this
 * string, and two spellings of the same account would defeat both.
 */
export function createOperatorRobinhoodAuthority(
  deps: OperatorEvmAuthorityDeps
): UserExecutionAuthority {
  const id = 'operator-robinhood-chain';
  return {
    id,
    chain: 'robinhood-chain',
    serves: servesOperator,
    async authorize(request) {
      const settlementAddress = deps.accountAddress();
      if (!settlementAddress) {
        return denied(
          'authority-operator-not-configured',
          'EVM_PRIVATE_KEY is required for operator execution on robinhood-chain'
        );
      }
      const typedData = deps.typedDataSigner();
      const capabilities: AuthorityCapability[] = ['venue-managed-submission'];
      if (typedData) capabilities.push('sign-typed-data');
      const unsupported = rejectUnsupportedAction(id, request, [
        'venue-trade',
        // Permit2 (`S4-M13`) replaces the ERC-20 `approve` transaction with an
        // EIP-712 signature. It is authorized here, through this port, rather
        // than as a special-cased transaction — which is the reason `S4-P7`
        // exists ahead of it.
        'token-spend-permission'
      ]);
      if (unsupported) return unsupported;
      return {
        kind: 'granted',
        authority: {
          adapterId: id,
          chain: 'robinhood-chain',
          principal: OPERATOR,
          settlementAddress,
          signingAddress: settlementAddress,
          capabilities,
          expiresAt: null,
          sign: signerFor({ adapterId: id, capabilities, solana: null, typedData })
        }
      };
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Operator authority on Polymarket.
 *
 * `settlementAddress` is the **funder**, matching what
 * `copy_executions.target_account` has always held here, and `signingAddress` is
 * the signer. They are equal under `signatureType` 0 (EOA) and differ under 1
 * and 2, which is exactly the separation a delegation mechanism would have
 * needed — and, per ADR-0003 §4, exactly the separation Polymarket does not
 * expose to a third party.
 */
export function createOperatorPolymarketAuthority(
  deps: OperatorPolymarketAuthorityDeps
): UserExecutionAuthority {
  const id = 'operator-polymarket';
  return {
    id,
    chain: 'polygon',
    serves: servesOperator,
    async authorize(request) {
      const identity = deps.identity();
      if (!identity) {
        return denied(
          'authority-operator-not-configured',
          'EVM_PRIVATE_KEY is required for operator execution on polygon'
        );
      }
      const typedData = deps.typedDataSigner();
      const capabilities: AuthorityCapability[] = ['venue-managed-submission'];
      if (typedData) capabilities.push('sign-typed-data');
      const unsupported = rejectUnsupportedAction(id, request, [
        'venue-trade',
        'token-spend-permission',
        // `redeemPositions()` submits from the signer too (ADR-0003 §4.2), so a
        // redemption is an authorized action and not a free operation.
        'position-redemption'
      ]);
      if (unsupported) return unsupported;
      return {
        kind: 'granted',
        authority: {
          adapterId: id,
          chain: 'polygon',
          principal: OPERATOR,
          settlementAddress: identity.funderAddress,
          signingAddress: identity.signerAddress,
          capabilities,
          expiresAt: null,
          sign: signerFor({ adapterId: id, capabilities, solana: null, typedData })
        }
      };
    }
  };
}

function rejectUnsupportedAction(
  adapterId: string,
  request: ExecutionAuthorityRequest,
  supported: readonly ExecutionAuthorityRequest['action'][]
): ExecutionAuthorityVerdict | null {
  if (supported.includes(request.action)) return null;
  return denied(
    'authority-capability-unsupported',
    `${adapterId} does not authorize ${request.action}`
  );
}

/**
 * A per-user adapter for a mechanism that does not exist yet.
 *
 * Deliberately not parameterised beyond the chain and the code. There is nothing
 * to configure: no grant table to read (`S4-7`), no session key to load
 * (`S4-2`), no delegate program to call (`S4-P12`). Giving it a plausible-looking
 * constructor would invite someone to wire it to something and find it half
 * works. It denies, every time, with a code that names the blocking item.
 */
function createUnavailableUserAuthority(input: {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly chain: Chain;
  readonly code: ExecutionAuthorityDenialCode;
  readonly reason: string;
}): UserExecutionAuthority {
  return {
    id: input.id,
    chain: input.chain,
    serves: servesUser,
    async authorize(request) {
      return denied(
        input.code,
        `${input.reason} (requested for ${describePrincipal(request.principal)})`
      );
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Options for resolving per-user grants and session-key validity (`S4-P9`),
 * as well as paymaster spend bounds (`S4-P8`).
 */
export interface UserGrantAuthorityOptions {
  readonly loadGrant?: (userId: string) => Promise<{
    status: 'active' | 'retired' | 'revoked' | 'compromised';
    expiresAt: Date | null;
  } | null>;
  readonly paymasterTracker?: PaymasterBudgetTracker;
  readonly now?: () => Date;
}

/**
 * Per-user authority on Robinhood Chain (`S4-P9`).
 *
 * Verifies grant lifecycle status (missing, revoked, expired/retired) before
 * attempting signing or bundler execution. An expired grant returns
 * `authority-grant-expired` with the expiration timestamp so the skip reason
 * identifies lapsed authority rather than a generic execution failure.
 */
export function createUserRobinhoodAuthority(options?: UserGrantAuthorityOptions): UserExecutionAuthority {
  return {
    id: 'user-robinhood-chain',
    chain: 'robinhood-chain',
    serves: servesUser,
    async authorize(request) {
      if (request.principal.kind !== 'user') {
        return denied(
          'authority-principal-mismatch',
          `User authority requested for ${describePrincipal(request.principal)}`
        );
      }
      if (options?.loadGrant) {
        const grant = await options.loadGrant(request.principal.userId);
        if (!grant) {
          return denied(
            'authority-grant-missing',
            `No execution authority grant found for user ${request.principal.userId}`
          );
        }
        if (grant.status === 'revoked' || grant.status === 'compromised') {
          return denied(
            'authority-grant-revoked',
            `Execution authority grant has been ${grant.status} for user ${request.principal.userId}`
          );
        }
        const now = options.now?.() ?? new Date();
        if (grant.status === 'retired' || (grant.expiresAt && grant.expiresAt.getTime() <= now.getTime())) {
          return denied(
            'authority-grant-expired',
            `Execution authority session key expired at ${grant.expiresAt?.toISOString() ?? 'unknown'} for user ${request.principal.userId}`
          );
        }
      }
      if (options?.paymasterTracker) {
        const now = options.now?.() ?? new Date();
        const budget = options.paymasterTracker.checkBudget(request.principal.userId, now);
        if (!budget.allowed && budget.code) {
          const denialCode: ExecutionAuthorityDenialCode =
            budget.code === 'paymaster-user-rate-limited'
              ? 'authority-paymaster-user-rate-limited'
              : 'authority-paymaster-global-budget-exhausted';
          return denied(denialCode, budget.reason ?? 'Paymaster budget exhausted');
        }
      }
      return denied(
        'authority-evm-session-key-unavailable',
        'Per-user Robinhood Chain authority needs a 4337 session key or EIP-7702 '
        + 'delegation; grant issuance (S4-2) and user_execution_grants (S4-7) are unbuilt '
        + `(requested for ${describePrincipal(request.principal)})`
      );
    }
  };
}

/** Live, audited WAKE Vault Anchor program ID on Solana (ADR-0003 §3, S4-P12). */
export const WAKE_VAULT_PROGRAM_ID = '6t6dRetG3Hns4vCfZaj392e9bZ6uTEEmvL37KnDWErfS';

export interface UserSolanaAuthorityOptions {
  /**
   * The deployed WAKE Vault Anchor program ID.
   * Defaults to WAKE_VAULT_PROGRAM_ID ('6t6dRetG3Hns4vCfZaj392e9bZ6uTEEmvL37KnDWErfS').
   */
  readonly programId?: string;
  /**
   * Whether the live wake-vault program adapter is enabled.
   * Defaults to true (toggled on after external audit completion).
   */
  readonly enabled?: boolean;
  /** Optional transaction signer for building and signing delegated swaps, or a getter. */
  readonly signer?: SolanaTransactionSigner | (() => SolanaTransactionSigner | null) | null;
  /** Resolver for the user's specific vault PDA settlement address. */
  readonly loadUserVaultAddress?: (userId: string) => Promise<string | null>;
}

/**
 * Per-user authority on Solana — **live audited WAKE Vault program** (S4-P12, ADR-0003 §3).
 *
 * Routes per-user copy trades through the audited non-custodial WAKE Vault
 * program (6t6dRetG3Hns4vCfZaj392e9bZ6uTEEmvL37KnDWErfS).
 */
export function createUserSolanaAuthority(
  options?: UserSolanaAuthorityOptions
): UserExecutionAuthority {
  const id = 'user-solana';
  const programId = options?.programId ?? WAKE_VAULT_PROGRAM_ID;

  if (options?.enabled === false) {
    return createUnavailableUserAuthority({
      id,
      chain: 'solana',
      code: 'authority-solana-delegate-unavailable',
      reason:
        'Per-user Solana authority is disabled '
        + '(S4-P12, ADR-0003 section 3); live routing is inactive'
    });
  }

  return {
    id,
    chain: 'solana',
    serves: servesUser,
    async authorize(request) {
      if (request.principal.kind !== 'user') {
        return denied(
          'authority-principal-mismatch',
          `User authority requested for ${describePrincipal(request.principal)}`
        );
      }

      const supportedActions: VenueActionKind[] = ['venue-trade', 'token-spend-permission'];
      const rejection = rejectUnsupportedAction(id, request, supportedActions);
      if (rejection) return rejection;

      const resolveSigner = () => {
        if (typeof options?.signer === 'function') {
          return options.signer();
        }
        return options?.signer ?? null;
      };
      const signer = resolveSigner();

      if (request.action === 'venue-trade' && !signer) {
        return denied(
          'authority-operator-not-configured',
          `No Solana transaction signer configured for wake-vault execution on ${describePrincipal(request.principal)}`
        );
      }

      const userVaultAddress = options?.loadUserVaultAddress
        ? await options.loadUserVaultAddress(request.principal.userId)
        : null;

      const settlementAddress = userVaultAddress || `solana:vault:${programId}:${request.principal.userId}`;

      return {
        kind: 'granted',
        authority: {
          adapterId: id,
          chain: 'solana',
          principal: request.principal,
          settlementAddress,
          signingAddress: signer ? signer.publicKey : null,
          capabilities: signer ? ['sign-chain-transaction'] : [],
          expiresAt: null,
          sign: signerFor({
            adapterId: id,
            capabilities: signer ? ['sign-chain-transaction'] : [],
            solana: signer,
            typedData: null
          })
        }
      };
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Per-user authority on Polymarket — **not achievable**, not merely unbuilt.
 *
 * ADR-0003 §4.3. Order placement carries an EIP-712 `Order` struct signed by the
 * account signer; L2 API credentials authenticate the HTTP request and cannot
 * place an order; Builder Program credentials are an integration identity and
 * "each wallet remains controlled by its signer". There is no scoped signer to
 * hold. Unblocking this is the fork-(b) decision — a venue-scoped custodial
 * exception, disclosed — and not an implementation task, which is why the code
 * is worded differently from the other two.
 */
export function createUserPolymarketAuthority(): UserExecutionAuthority {
  return createUnavailableUserAuthority({
    id: 'user-polymarket',
    chain: 'polygon',
    code: 'authority-polymarket-delegation-unsupported',
    reason:
      'Polymarket exposes no scoped-signer primitive (ADR-0003 section 4.3); per-user '
      + 'execution requires the fork-(b) venue-scoped custodial decision (S4-P13)'
  });
}

/**
 * Every adapter, in routing order.
 *
 * Operator and per-user entries sit in the same array and are picked by the same
 * rule. Ordering within a chain does not matter because `serves` partitions the
 * principals, but keeping the pairs adjacent makes it obvious at a glance that
 * no chain has one without the other.
 */
export function createExecutionAuthorityAdapters(
  deps: OperatorAuthorityDeps,
  userSolanaOptions?: UserSolanaAuthorityOptions
): readonly UserExecutionAuthority[] {
  const solanaSigner = userSolanaOptions?.signer ?? deps.solana.signer;
  return [
    createOperatorSolanaAuthority(deps.solana),
    createUserSolanaAuthority({
      signer: solanaSigner,
      ...userSolanaOptions
    }),
    createOperatorRobinhoodAuthority(deps.robinhoodChain),
    createUserRobinhoodAuthority(),
    createOperatorPolymarketAuthority(deps.polygon),
    createUserPolymarketAuthority()
  ];
}

/** Convenience for tests and for the wiring assertions. */
export function grantedAuthorityOrNull(
  verdict: ExecutionAuthorityVerdict
): GrantedExecutionAuthority | null {
  return verdict.kind === 'granted' ? verdict.authority : null;
}

/**

 * executor is unchanged.**

/** A stub authority: no key, no chain library, no environment. */
function stubAuthority(overrides: Partial<GrantedExecutionAuthority> = {}): {
  ports: ExecutorJobPorts;
  requests: ExecutionAuthorityRequest[];
} {
  const requests: ExecutionAuthorityRequest[] = [];
  const authorize: ExecutionAuthorityResolver = async (request) => {
    requests.push(request);
    return {
      kind: 'granted',
      authority: {
        adapterId: 'stub',
        chain: request.chain,
        principal: request.principal,
        settlementAddress: 'StubSettlement1111111111111111111111111111',
        signingAddress: null,
        capabilities: ['venue-managed-submission'],
        expiresAt: null,
        sign: async () => ({
          kind: 'refused',
          code: 'authority-capability-unsupported',
          reason: 'stub'
        }),
        ...overrides
      }
    };
  };
  return { ports: { authorize }, requests };
}

function denyingAuthority(code: ExecutionAuthorityDenialCode, reason: string): {
  ports: ExecutorJobPorts;
  requests: ExecutionAuthorityRequest[];
} {
  const requests: ExecutionAuthorityRequest[] = [];
  return {
    ports: {
      authorize: async (request) => {
        requests.push(request);
        return denied(code, reason);
      }
    },
    requests
  };
}
