        simBaseQuantity = simTokenAmount.toString();
        simPriceUsd = plan.averagePrice;
        simAmountUsd = plan.estimatedNotionalUsd;
        console.log(
          `[trade-executor] PAPER (polymarket-sim): ${payload.tokenMint} | Size: $${simAmountUsd} | `
          + `Avg Price: $${plan.averagePrice} (best $${plan.bestPrice}, ${plan.slippageBps.toFixed(1)} bps)`
        );
      } else if (chain === 'robinhood-chain' && (direction === 'buy' || paperExecution)) {
        const tokenDecimals = await getTokenDecimals(payload.tokenMint, 'robinhood-chain');
        if (tokenDecimals === null) throw new Error('Robinhood token decimals are unavailable');
        const amountIn = direction === 'buy'
          ? BigInt(Math.floor(size * 1e18))
          : decimalQuantityToBaseUnits(paperExecution?.requestedBaseQuantity ?? '', tokenDecimals);
        const quoteWei = direction === 'buy'
          ? await getRobinhoodQuote(WETH_ROBINHOOD, cleanMint, amountIn, 3000)
          : await getRobinhoodQuote(cleanMint, WETH_ROBINHOOD, amountIn, 3000);
        simulatedVia = 'robinhood-quoter';
        simExecutor = 'robinhood-sim';
        if (direction === 'buy') {
          simBaseQuantity = formatUnits(quoteWei, tokenDecimals);
          simTokenAmount = Number(simBaseQuantity);
        } else {
          simBaseQuantity = paperExecution?.requestedBaseQuantity ?? null;
          simTokenAmount = simBaseQuantity ? Number(simBaseQuantity) : null;
        }
        console.log(`[trade-executor] PAPER (robinhood-sim): ${payload.tokenMint} | Size: ${size} ETH -> Out: ${quoteWei} units`);
      }

      if (simulatedVia === 'spot-price') {
        // Stop-loss sells have no canonical execution but still need a priced,
        // quantity-accurate fill, so they take this path too.
        if (paperExecution || stopLossSellQuantity !== null) {
          simPriceUsd = await fetchTokenPriceUsd(payload.tokenMint);
          if (!simPriceUsd || simPriceUsd <= 0) {
            throw new Error('Spot-price simulation lacks a positive token price');
          }
          if (direction === 'buy') {
            if (chain === 'solana') {
              const nativePrice = await getCachedSolPrice();
              if (!nativePrice) throw new Error('Spot-price simulation lacks a SOL price');
              simAmountUsd = size * nativePrice;
            } else if (chain === 'robinhood-chain') {
              const nativePrice = await getCachedEthPrice();
              if (!nativePrice) throw new Error('Spot-price simulation lacks an ETH price');
              simAmountUsd = size * nativePrice;
            } else {
              simAmountUsd = size;
            }
            simBaseQuantity = (simAmountUsd / simPriceUsd).toString();
          } else {
            simBaseQuantity = stopLossSellQuantity !== null
              ? stopLossSellQuantity.toString()
              : paperExecution!.requestedBaseQuantity;
            simAmountUsd = Number(simBaseQuantity) * simPriceUsd;
          }
          simTokenAmount = Number(simBaseQuantity);
        }
        console.log(
          `[trade-executor] PAPER (spot-price fallback): ${payload.tokenMint} | ` +
          `${stopLossSellQuantity !== null ? `${stopLossSellQuantity} tokens (stop-loss)` : `${size} base units`} ` +
          `(score: ${payload.score})`
        );
      }

      const confirmedAt = new Date();

      if (paperExecution) {
        if (!simBaseQuantity || Number(simBaseQuantity) <= 0) {
          throw new Error('Paper simulation did not produce a positive token quantity');
        }
        await transitionCopyExecution({
          executionId: paperExecution.id,
          nextState: 'simulated',
          simulationId: `${simExecutor}:${paperExecution.clientOrderId}`
        });
        await persistCanonicalFill({
          execution: paperExecution,
          evidenceType: 'paper_simulation',
          evidenceId: `${simExecutor}:${paperExecution.clientOrderId}`,
          baseQuantity: simBaseQuantity,
          // Paper simulation sizes its quote leg in USD on every chain -- see the
          // simAmountUsd assignments above, which already multiply a SOL or ETH size
          // by its native price. So the currency is stated, not inferred from
          // `chain`, which would mislabel a Solana paper fill as SOL.
          quoteLeg: simAmountUsd == null
            ? null
            : { amount: simAmountUsd.toString(), currency: 'USD' },
          priceUsd: simPriceUsd?.toString() ?? null,
          occurredAt: confirmedAt
        });
      }

      await persistTrade({
        signalId: payload.signalId,
        sourceTradeId: payload.sourceTradeId,
        copyExecutionId: paperExecution?.id ?? payload.copyExecutionId,
        tokenMint: payload.tokenMint,
        size,
        amountUsd: simAmountUsd ?? (chain === 'polygon' ? size : undefined),
        chain,
        executionMode: execMode === 'live+shadow' ? 'shadow' : 'paper',
        direction,
        executor: simExecutor,
        jupiterFill,
        tokenAmount: simTokenAmount,
        shadowOf: execMode === 'live+shadow' ? liveTradeId : undefined,
        submittedAt,
        confirmedAt
      });

      paperResult = {
        status:    'paper-filled',
        signalId:  payload.signalId,
        tokenMint: payload.tokenMint,
        size,
        mode:      'paper',
        simulatedVia
      };
      } catch (paperError: unknown) {
        const message = paperError instanceof Error ? paperError.message : String(paperError);
        console.error(`[trade-executor] Shadow execution failed: ${message}`);
        await terminateCanonicalExecution(paperExecution, message);
        if (execMode === 'paper') {
          if (!payload.sourceTradeId) await releaseSignalClaim(payload.signalId);
          paperResult = { status: 'skipped', reason: `Paper simulation failed: ${message}` };
        }
      }
    }


    return liveResult || paperResult || { status: 'skipped', reason: 'Unknown execution mode' };
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    await Promise.allSettled(
      Object.values(canonicalExecutions).map((execution) =>
        terminateCanonicalExecution(execution, message)
      )
    );
    if (!payload.sourceTradeId) await releaseSignalClaim(payload.signalId).catch(() => {});
    throw err;
  }
}

export async function main() {
  initLogger('trade-executor');
  console.log('[trade-executor] Starting executor worker...');
  const redisClient = getRedis();
  configureRobinhoodOpsAlerts(redisClient);

  let robinhoodRuntime: RobinhoodRuntime | null = null;
  let robinhoodRuntimeError: Error | null = null;
  try {
    robinhoodRuntime = createRobinhoodRuntime(redisClient);
  } catch (error) {
    robinhoodRuntimeError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
  }
  await verifyRobinhoodEnvironment({
    runtimeCheck: () => {
      if (!robinhoodRuntime) {
        throw robinhoodRuntimeError ?? new Error('Robinhood live runtime is unavailable');
      }
    }
  });

  let trojanRuntime: TrojanRuntime | null = null;
  try {
    trojanRuntime = createTrojanRuntimeFromEnvironment(redisClient);
    configureTrojanRuntime(trojanRuntime);
  } catch (error) {
    const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    setTrojanRuntimeUnavailable(reason);
  }

  // Jupiter + Jito (DG-1). Stood up alongside Trojan, not in place of it: the
  // legacy path retires only once this one is certified (S3-6), and until then
  // `resolveChainMode` accepts either being ready.
  //
  // A configuration error here must not stop the worker — it is caught, recorded
  // as a readiness reason, and the chain clamps to paper. Throwing would take
  // down execution for every chain because one chain's optional live path is
  // misconfigured.
  try {
    const created = createJupiterJitoRuntimeFromEnvironment(redisClient);
    if (created) {
      console.log(
        `[trade-executor] Jupiter+Jito ready, signer ${created.signer.publicKey.slice(0, 8)}…`
      );
    } else {
      console.log(
        `[trade-executor] Jupiter+Jito unavailable: ${getJupiterJitoLiveReadiness().reason}`
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    console.error(`[trade-executor] Jupiter+Jito configuration failed: ${reason}`);
  }

  await verifyPolymarketEnvironment().catch(err => {
    console.error(`[trade-executor] Polymarket startup check failed: ${err.message}`);
  });

  let reconciliationRunning = false;
  const reconcilePending = async () => {
    if (reconciliationRunning) return;
    reconciliationRunning = true;
    try {
      const tasks: ChainReconciliationTask[] = [];
      if (robinhoodRuntime) {
        tasks.push({
          chain: 'robinhood-chain',
          run: () => runRobinhoodReconciliation(robinhoodRuntime)
        });
      }
      if (trojanRuntime) {
        tasks.push({ chain: 'solana', run: () => runTrojanReconciliation(trojanRuntime) });
      }
      const jupiterJito = getConfiguredJupiterJitoRuntime();
      if (jupiterJito) {
        tasks.push({
          chain: 'solana',
          run: async () => {
            // The block height is what makes an expired-blockhash miss
            // *provable*. Without it the sweep can only ever time out into
            // `ambiguous`, so a definitively-dead bundle would sit pending until
            // its TTL instead of resolving immediately. A failure reading it is
            // not fatal — the sweep degrades to the timeout path.
            let blockHeight: number | undefined;
            try {
              blockHeight = await getJupiterJitoSigner()?.getBlockHeight();
            } catch (error) {
              console.warn(
                '[trade-executor] block height unavailable for Jito sweep',
                error instanceof Error ? error.message : error
              );
            }
            const resolutions = await jupiterJito.sweep(blockHeight);
            if (resolutions.length > 0) {
              console.log(
                `[trade-executor] jito sweep resolved ${resolutions.length}: `
                + resolutions.map((r) => `${r.clientOrderId}=${r.status}`).join(', ')
              );
            }
          }
        });
      }

      // Redeem resolved Polymarket positions (S3-18). A resolved market stops
      // accepting orders, so a winning position cannot be sold — redemption is
      // the only exit, and without this the position stays open in the ledger
      // forever with its collateral stranded.
      //
      // Gated on the live client existing: redemption is a real on-chain claim,
      // so there is nothing to do in paper mode. `runChainReconciliations` maps
      // positionally rather than keying by chain, so a second 'polygon' task
      // sits alongside the venue sweep without either being dropped.
      const polymarketClient = getPolymarketClientIfReady();
      if (polymarketClient && getPolymarketLiveReadiness().ready) {
        tasks.push({
          chain: 'polygon',
          run: async () => {
            // The claim ports are REQUIRED, not optional decoration. Without
            // them `runPolymarketRedemptionSweep` falls back to
            // `unwiredPositionExitPort`, which throws for every market that maps
            // to a position -- so before this line, S4-M19's single-winner claim
            // was inert in production and every market was counted `failed`.
            // Found 2026-09-01 while wiring S4-M45.
            const sweep = await runPolymarketRedemptionSweep({
              client: polymarketClient as unknown as PolymarketRedemptionClient,
              claimPositionExit: claimPolymarketPositionExit,
              confirmPositionExit: confirmPolymarketPositionExit,
              releasePositionExit: releasePolymarketPositionExit,
              releaseStalePositionExits: releaseStalePolymarketPositionExits,
              log: (message) => console.log(message)
            });
            if (sweep.redeemed > 0 || sweep.failed > 0) {
              console.log(
                `[trade-executor] polymarket redemption: scanned ${sweep.scanned}, `
                + `redeemed ${sweep.redeemed}, failed ${sweep.failed}, skipped ${sweep.skipped}`
              );
            }
          }
        });
      }

      await runChainReconciliations(tasks);

      // The per-venue sweeps above are the fast path and run first. This is the
      // backstop for canonical executions their pending stores can no longer
      // see. It shares this guard rather than getting its own timer so two
      // reconciliation passes can never overlap.
      try {
        const sweep = await runReconciliationCoordinator({
          claim: ({ limit }) => claimCopyExecutionsForReconciliation({ limit }),
          release: (input) => releaseCopyExecutionReconciliationClaim(input),
          reconcilers: buildVenueReconcilers({
            robinhoodRuntime,
            trojanRuntime,
            polymarketReady: getPolymarketLiveReadiness().ready
          }),
          escalate: escalateStuckExecution(redisClient),
          account: RECONCILIATION_ACCOUNT
        });
        if (sweep.claimed > 0) {
          console.log(
            `[trade-executor] canonical reconciliation: claimed ${sweep.claimed}, `
            + `resolved ${sweep.resolved}, pending ${sweep.pending}, `
            + `unresolved ${sweep.unresolved}, exhausted ${sweep.exhausted}, `
            + `unsupported ${sweep.unsupported}`
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('[trade-executor] canonical reconciliation failed', error);
      }

      // Escalate Polymarket exits reconciliation has already declared unfilled
      // (S4-M17). An unfilled sell leaves the user holding a position their
      // master has left, which is worse than a missed entry, so the ladder in
      // `polymarket-exit-escalation.ts` re-offers it at progressively deeper
      // limits and then hands the decision to a human.
      //
      // Last in the pass, and inside this guard rather than on a timer of its
      // own (C1): a rung rests for its full lifetime inside this call, so
      // running it earlier would delay the fast per-venue sweeps above, and a
      // second timer could overlap a ladder with the reconciliation that
      // classifies its own rungs.
      try {
        const exits = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep({
          emitAlert: async (alert, candidate) => {
            console.error(
              `[trade-executor] polymarket exit escalation ${alert.code} on trade `
              + `${candidate.id}: ${alert.reason}`
            );
            await redisClient.publish(REDIS_CHANNELS.alertQueue, JSON.stringify({
              type: 'POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION',
              title: 'Polymarket exit could not be completed',
              message:
                `Trade ${candidate.id} (sell ${candidate.token_mint}) still holds `
                + `${alert.remainingShares} shares after the exit escalation ladder.\n`
                + `Venue order: ${candidate.venue_order_id}\n`
                + `Code: ${alert.code}\n`
                + `Reason: ${alert.reason}\n`
                + 'It will not be escalated further automatically. Redeem, hold, or unwind by hand.',
              severity: alert.severity === 'critical' ? 'high' : 'medium',
              chain: 'polygon'
            }));
          },
          log: (message) => console.log(message)
        });
        if (exits.escalated > 0 || exits.alerted > 0 || exits.failed > 0 || exits.skipped > 0) {
          console.log(
            `[trade-executor] polymarket exit escalation: scanned ${exits.scanned}, `
            + `escalated ${exits.escalated}, completed ${exits.completed}, `
            + `alerted ${exits.alerted}, redeemed ${exits.redeemed}, `
            + `failed ${exits.failed}, skipped ${exits.skipped}`
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('[trade-executor] polymarket exit escalation failed', error);
      }
    } finally {
      reconciliationRunning = false;
    }
  };
  await reconcilePending().catch((error) => {
    console.error('[trade-executor] startup reconciliation failed', error);
  });
  // One worker per chain at concurrency 1, plus a drain worker on the pre-split
  // queue (D6 / S3-25). Before the split a single concurrency-3 worker served
  // every chain, so a slow venue held a slot the other two needed; now a
  // Polymarket settlement delay or a Robinhood RPC outage cannot stall Solana
  // copies. Total concurrency is unchanged — the three slots are just no longer
  // shared. See `trade-workers.ts` for why concurrency stays at 1.
  // The authority port, constructed here at the process edge and threaded into
  // every job (`S4-P7`). `handleJob`'s default parameter exists for the test
  // suites and the acceptance scripts; the worker never relies on it.
  const jobPorts = createExecutorJobPorts();

  for (const spec of tradeWorkerSpecs()) {
    const tradeWorker = new Worker(
      spec.queue,
      (job) => {
        const misroute = misroutedJobWarning(spec, chainFromJob(job));
        if (misroute) console.error(misroute);
        return executeJobWithCircuitBreaker(job, (queued) => handleJob(queued, jobPorts));
      },
      { connection: redisClient, concurrency: spec.concurrency, autorun: true }
    );

    tradeWorker.on('failed', (_job, err) => {
      console.error(`[trade-executor] job failed on ${spec.queue}`, err?.message);
    });
    tradeWorker.on('error', (err) => {
      console.error(`[trade-executor] worker error on ${spec.queue}`, err);
    });
    console.log(
      `[trade-executor] worker listening on ${spec.queue}`
      + ` (chain: ${spec.chain ?? 'any — drain only'}, concurrency: ${spec.concurrency})`
    );
  }

setInterval(() => {
  reconcilePending().catch((error) => {
    console.error('[trade-executor] periodic reconciliation failed', error);
  });
}, 60_000);

setInterval(() => {
  pollPolymarketOrders().catch(() => {});
}, 60_000);
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {
  main().catch((error) => {
    console.error('[trade-executor] fatal startup failure', error);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  });
}

function memoryRedis() {
  const store = new Map<string, Map<string, string>>();
  return {
    async hget(key: string, field: string) {
      return store.get(key)?.get(field) ?? null;
    },
    async hgetall(key: string) {
      return Object.fromEntries(store.get(key) ?? new Map());
    },
    async hset(key: string, field: string, value: string) {
      if (!store.has(key)) store.set(key, new Map());
      store.get(key)!.set(field, value);
      return 1;
    }
  };
}

describe('solana signer', () => {
  it('rejects a non-base58 key without echoing the material', () => {
    let message = '';
    try {
      createSolanaSigner({ privateKeyBase58: 'not-base58-!!!', rpcUrl: 'https://rpc.test' });
    } catch (error) {
      message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    }
    expect(message).toMatch(/not valid base58/);
    expect(message).not.toContain('not-base58-!!!');
  });

  it('rejects a key of the wrong length', () => {
    const short = bs58.encode(Buffer.alloc(32, 7));
    expect(() => createSolanaSigner({ privateKeyBase58: short, rpcUrl: 'https://rpc.test' }))
      .toThrow(/64 bytes/);
  });

  it('exposes the public key but never the secret', () => {
    const keypair = Keypair.generate();
    const signer = createSolanaSigner({
      privateKeyBase58: bs58.encode(keypair.secretKey),
      rpcUrl: 'https://rpc.test'
    });
    expect(signer.publicKey).toBe(keypair.publicKey.toBase58());
    // The key is held in a closure; nothing on the returned object exposes it.
    expect(JSON.stringify(Object.keys(signer))).not.toMatch(/secret|private/i);
  });

  it('refuses a non-positive tip amount', async () => {
    const signer = createSolanaSigner({
      privateKeyBase58: VALID_KEY,
      rpcUrl: 'https://rpc.test'
    });
    // Rejected before any RPC call, so this needs no network.
    await expect(signer.buildTip({ tipAccount: 'x', lamports: 0 })).rejects.toThrow(/positive/);
    await expect(signer.buildTip({ tipAccount: 'x', lamports: 1.5 })).rejects.toThrow(/positive/);
  });

import type { RedisHashClient } from './runtime-codec.js';
import { createSolanaSimulationGateFromEnvironment } from './solana-simulation.js';
import {
  createJupiterJitoRuntime,
  createRedisJupiterJitoStore,
  type JupiterJitoRuntime
} from './jupiter-jito-runtime.js';
import { createSolanaSignerFromEnvironment, type SolanaSigner } from './solana-signer.js';

/**
 * Environment wiring and live-readiness gate for the Jupiter + Jito path
 * (checklist S3-1…S3-5).
 *
 * Mirrors `configureTrojanRuntime` / `getTrojanLiveReadiness` so the executor's
 * existing mode-resolution gate keeps working with a one-symbol swap. The Trojan
 * path is retired only once this one is certified (`S3-6`), so both exist
 * side by side until then.
 */

let configured: JupiterJitoRuntime | null = null;
let signer: SolanaSigner | null = null;
let unavailableReason = 'Jupiter/Jito runtime is not configured';

/** Default tip ceiling: 0.005 SOL. Overridden by `JITO_MAX_TIP_LAMPORTS`. */
const DEFAULT_MAX_TIP_LAMPORTS = 5_000_000;
/** Used when the block engine's tip floor is unreadable. 0.0001 SOL. */
const DEFAULT_FALLBACK_TIP_LAMPORTS = 100_000;
const DEFAULT_PENDING_TTL_MS = 600_000;

function readPositiveInt(name: string, fallback: number): number {
  const raw = process.env[name];
  if (!raw) return fallback;
  const parsed = Number(raw);
  if (!Number.isInteger(parsed) || parsed <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be a positive integer, got ${raw}`);
  }
  return parsed;
}

function readTipPercentile(): 'p50' | 'p75' | 'p95' {
  const raw = process.env.JITO_TIP_PERCENTILE ?? 'p75';
  if (raw !== 'p50' && raw !== 'p75' && raw !== 'p95') {
    throw new Error(`JITO_TIP_PERCENTILE must be p50, p75, or p95; got ${raw}`);
  }
  return raw;
}

export function configureJupiterJitoRuntime(
  runtime: JupiterJitoRuntime,
  runtimeSigner: SolanaSigner
): void {
  configured = runtime;
  signer = runtimeSigner;
  unavailableReason = '';
}

export function setJupiterJitoUnavailable(reason: string): void {
  configured = null;
  signer = null;
  unavailableReason = reason;
}

export function getConfiguredJupiterJitoRuntime(): JupiterJitoRuntime | null {
  return configured;
}

export function getJupiterJitoSigner(): SolanaSigner | null {
  return signer;
}

/**
 * Whether Solana may execute live.
 *
 * Fail-closed: an unconfigured runtime reports not-ready with a reason, and
 * `resolveChainMode` clamps the chain to paper rather than attempting a live
 * trade it cannot sign.
 */
export function getJupiterJitoLiveReadiness(): { ready: boolean; reason: string } {
  return configured && signer
    ? { ready: true, reason: '' }
    : { ready: false, reason: unavailableReason || 'Jupiter/Jito runtime is not configured' };
}

/**
 * Builds the runtime from the environment.
 *
 * Returns null when the Solana key or Jito endpoint is absent — the normal
 * posture for a paper-mode deployment, which must not be forced to hold a
 * signing key it never uses.
 */
export function createJupiterJitoRuntimeFromEnvironment(
  redis: RedisHashClient
): { runtime: JupiterJitoRuntime; signer: SolanaSigner } | null {
  const environmentSigner = createSolanaSignerFromEnvironment();
  if (!environmentSigner) {
    setJupiterJitoUnavailable('SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY or an RPC URL is not configured');
    return null;
  }

  const baseUrl = process.env.JITO_BLOCK_ENGINE_URL;
  if (!baseUrl) {
    // Deliberately not defaulted. A wrong block-engine URL fails every bundle
    // at submit time, and silently guessing one turns a config omission into a
    // runtime mystery.
    setJupiterJitoUnavailable('JITO_BLOCK_ENGINE_URL is not configured');
    return null;
  }

  const runtime = createJupiterJitoRuntime({
    pendingStore: createRedisJupiterJitoStore(redis),
    jito: {
      baseUrl,
      apiKey: process.env.JITO_AUTH_KEY,
      timeoutMs: readPositiveInt('JITO_TIMEOUT_MS', 10_000)
    },
    signTransaction: (transaction) => environmentSigner.sign(transaction),
    buildTipTransaction: (input) => environmentSigner.buildTip(input),
    maxTipLamports: readPositiveInt('JITO_MAX_TIP_LAMPORTS', DEFAULT_MAX_TIP_LAMPORTS),
    fallbackTipLamports: readPositiveInt(
      'JITO_FALLBACK_TIP_LAMPORTS',
      DEFAULT_FALLBACK_TIP_LAMPORTS
    ),
    tipPercentile: readTipPercentile(),
    pendingTtlMs: readPositiveInt('JITO_PENDING_TTL_MS', DEFAULT_PENDING_TTL_MS),
    jupiterApiKey: process.env.JUPITER_API_KEY,
    // S4-M15. Without this the runtime's simulation branch is dead code on a live
    // box: `submit()` guards on `options.simulation` being present, so an absent
    // gate means every Solana bundle goes out unsimulated exactly as before. The
    // factory returns null when unconfigured, which is the same
    // explicitly-disabled shape `createSolanaSignerFromEnvironment` uses.
    simulation: createSolanaSimulationGateFromEnvironment() ?? undefined
  });

  configureJupiterJitoRuntime(runtime, environmentSigner);
  return { runtime, signer: environmentSigner };
}

/** Resets module state. Test-only. */
export function resetJupiterJitoRuntimeForTests(): void {
  configured = null;
  signer = null;
  unavailableReason = 'Jupiter/Jito runtime is not configured';
}

const QUOTE = { inAmount: '1000', outAmount: '900' } as unknown as JupiterQuote;

/** Base58 without `0`, `O`, `I`, `l`, padded to the 32-char minimum. */
function fakeTipAccount(label: string): string {
  return label.padEnd(32, 'z');
}

const LIVE_TIP_ACCOUNTS = [fakeTipAccount('LiveTip1'), fakeTipAccount('LiveTip2')];
const SOL_PRICE_USD = 200;

function memoryStore(): JupiterJitoPendingStore {
  const pending = new Map<string, PendingJupiterJitoSubmission>();
  const resolved = new Map<string, JupiterJitoResolution>();
  return {
    async findPending(id) {
      return pending.get(id) ?? null;
    },
    async findResolution(id) {
      return resolved.get(id) ?? null;
    },
    async listPending() {
      return [...pending.values()];
    },
    async save(p) {
      pending.set(p.clientOrderId, p);
    },
    async resolve(id, resolution) {
      pending.delete(id);
      resolved.set(id, resolution);
    }
  };
}

function makeRuntime(store: JupiterJitoPendingStore, now = () => new Date('2026-08-05T00:00:00Z')) {
  return createJupiterJitoRuntime({
    pendingStore: store,
    jito: { baseUrl: 'https://block-engine.test' },
    signTransaction: async (tx) => `signed:${tx}`,
    buildTipTransaction: async ({ tipAccount, lamports }) => `tip:${tipAccount}:${lamports}`,
    maxTipLamports: 1_000_000,
    fallbackTipLamports: 10_000,
    pendingTtlMs: 600_000,
    now
  });
}

describe('submit idempotency', () => {

    expect(mocks.submitJitoBundle).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    expect(mocks.submitJitoBundle).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

  });

describe('reconciliation', () => {
  const pending: PendingJupiterJitoSubmission = {
    clientOrderId: 'order-r',

    expiresAt: new Date('2026-08-05T00:10:00Z')
  };

  it('returns null when the outcome cannot be observed', async () => {

    mocks.getJitoBundleStatus.mockResolvedValue({
      bundleId: 'bundle-r', status: 'Landed', transactions: [], slot: 42

    mocks.getJitoBundleStatus.mockResolvedValue({
      bundleId: 'bundle-r', status: 'Failed', transactions: [], slot: null

    const resolution = await makeRuntime(memoryStore()).reconcile(pending, 500);
    expect(resolution).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed', reason: 'bundle-failed' });

  it('stays unresolved while pending below the expiry block height', async () => {

    mocks.getJitoBundleStatus.mockResolvedValue({

    expect(resolution).toBe(null);

  it('declares a miss only once the blockhash has expired', async () => {

    mocks.getJitoBundleStatus.mockResolvedValue({

/** Reads the tip transfer the fixture encodes as `signed:tip:${account}:${lamports}`. */
function submittedTip(): { account: string; lamports: number } {
  const submitted = mocks.submitJitoBundle.mock.calls[0]![0] as string[];
  const tipTx = submitted.find((tx) => tx.includes('tip:'))!;
  const [, account, lamports] = tipTx.replace('signed:', '').split(':');
  return { account: account!, lamports: Number(lamports) };
}

/**
 * The fee a resolution reports, or `undefined` if it is not a fill.
 *
 * Narrows rather than casts, so a test that expects a fee on something other than
 * a `filled` resolution fails instead of quietly reading a missing property.
 */
function feeUsdOf(
  resolution: JupiterJitoResolution | null | undefined
): number | null | undefined {
  return resolution?.status === 'filled' ? resolution.feeUsd : undefined;
}

/**
 * The tip goes to a runtime-resolved account (checklist S4-P18).
 *
 * Jito rotates its tip accounts. Tipping one it has retired means the block engine
 * ignores the bundle: nothing lands, and the executor still reports a successful
 * submission. There is no error anywhere to notice.
 */
describe('tip account sourcing', () => {
  it('tips an account from the runtime-resolved set', async () => {
    await makeRuntime(memoryStore()).submit({
      clientOrderId: 'order-t1',
      quote: QUOTE,
      signerPublicKey: 's'
    });

    expect(mocks.getJitoTipAccounts).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ baseUrl: 'https://block-engine.test' });
    const { account } = submittedTip();
    expect(LIVE_TIP_ACCOUNTS).toContain(account);
    // The regression this guards: quietly paying the compiled-in array while the
    // live set says otherwise.
    expect(JITO_TIP_ACCOUNTS).not.toContain(account);
  });

  it('still submits when the tip-account lookup has fallen back', async () => {
    // An unreadable endpoint must never block an otherwise-valid trade — the
    // resolver hands back the hard-coded set and submission proceeds unchanged.
    mocks.getJitoTipAccounts.mockResolvedValue(JITO_TIP_ACCOUNTS);

    const result = await makeRuntime(memoryStore()).submit({
      clientOrderId: 'order-t2',
      quote: QUOTE,
      signerPublicKey: 's'
    });

    expect(result.status).toBe('submitted');
    expect(JITO_TIP_ACCOUNTS).toContain(submittedTip().account);
  });
});

/**
 * The tip is a real cost and must reach `trades.fee_usd` (checklist S4-P18).
 *
 * It was computed at submit time and then discarded, so every Jito fill
 * understated its own cost — a permanent, silent P&L bias in the optimistic
 * direction, on every single Solana trade.
 *
 * The three outcomes below must stay distinguishable. Bundles are atomic, so an
 * unlanded one was never charged a tip; an *unobserved* one may or may not have
 * been, and a fabricated number for it would be indistinguishable from a real
 * cost once it is in the ledger.
 */
describe('tip accounting', () => {
  const landedPending: PendingJupiterJitoSubmission = {
    clientOrderId: 'order-fee',
    bundleId: 'bundle-fee',
    lastValidBlockHeight: 1_000,
    expiresAt: new Date('2026-08-05T00:10:00Z'),
    tipLamports: 20_000
  };

  it('records the tip as feeUsd on a landed bundle', async () => {
    mocks.getJitoBundleStatus.mockResolvedValue({
      bundleId: 'bundle-fee', status: 'Landed', transactions: ['sig-fee'], slot: 42
    });

    const resolution = await makeRuntime(memoryStore()).reconcile(landedPending, 500);

    expect(resolution).toMatchObject({ status: 'filled', tipLamports: 20_000 });
    // 20000 lamports / 1e9 * $200. Asserted non-null explicitly: the whole defect
    // was this arriving as undefined.
    const feeUsd = feeUsdOf(resolution);
    expect(feeUsd).not.toBe(null);
    expect(feeUsd).not.toBe(undefined);
    expect(feeUsd).toBeCloseTo(0.004, 12);
    expect(mocks.fetchTokenPriceUsd).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112'
    );
  });

  it('records no fee for a bundle that definitively failed', async () => {
    // Atomic: it never landed, so it never paid. There is no cost to book, and
    // booking one would charge a position that does not exist.
    mocks.getJitoBundleStatus.mockResolvedValue({
      bundleId: 'bundle-fee', status: 'Failed', transactions: [], slot: null
    });

    const resolution = await makeRuntime(memoryStore()).reconcile(landedPending, 500);

    expect(resolution).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed' });
    expect(resolution).not.toHaveProperty('feeUsd');
    expect(resolution).not.toHaveProperty('tipLamports');
    // Not even priced: there is nothing to price.
    expect(mocks.fetchTokenPriceUsd).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('records no fee for a bundle that missed its blockhash', async () => {
    mocks.getJitoBundleStatus.mockResolvedValue({
      bundleId: 'bundle-fee', status: 'Invalid', transactions: [], slot: null
    });

    const resolution = await makeRuntime(memoryStore()).reconcile(landedPending, 1_001);

    expect(resolution).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed', reason: 'blockhash-expired' });
    expect(resolution).not.toHaveProperty('feeUsd');
    expect(mocks.fetchTokenPriceUsd).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('never fabricates a cost for an unobserved outcome', async () => {
    // A confirmation timeout is ambiguous, not free and not known: the bundle may
    // still have landed. A guessed fee here is the worst option — once written it
    // is indistinguishable from a real one, and a zero is an active claim that the
    // trade cost nothing.
    mocks.getJitoBundleStatus.mockResolvedValue({
      bundleId: 'bundle-fee', status: 'Pending', transactions: [], slot: null
    });
    const runtime = makeRuntime(memoryStore(), () => new Date('2026-08-05T01:00:00Z'));

    const resolution = await runtime.reconcile(landedPending, 500);

    expect(resolution).toMatchObject({ status: 'ambiguous', reason: 'confirmation-timeout' });
    expect(resolution).not.toHaveProperty('feeUsd');
    expect(resolution).not.toHaveProperty('tipLamports');
    expect(mocks.fetchTokenPriceUsd).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('records no fee when a landed bundle reports no signature', async () => {
    // This one probably *did* pay a tip, but there is no fill to attribute it to.
    // Left for an operator to settle against the chain rather than guessed into a
    // position that may not exist.
    mocks.getJitoBundleStatus.mockResolvedValue({
      bundleId: 'bundle-fee', status: 'Landed', transactions: [], slot: 42
    });

    const resolution = await makeRuntime(memoryStore()).reconcile(landedPending, 500);

    expect(resolution).toMatchObject({ status: 'ambiguous', reason: 'landed-without-signature' });
    expect(resolution).not.toHaveProperty('feeUsd');
  });

  it('leaves the fee null rather than zero when the SOL price is unavailable', async () => {
    // `fetchTokenPriceUsd` returns null when every upstream fails. A zero would
    // assert the trade was free, which is a different and false statement — and
    // one that silently understates cost basis forever.
    mocks.fetchTokenPriceUsd.mockResolvedValue(null);
    mocks.getJitoBundleStatus.mockResolvedValue({
      bundleId: 'bundle-fee', status: 'Landed', transactions: ['sig-fee'], slot: 42
    });

    const resolution = await makeRuntime(memoryStore()).reconcile(landedPending, 500);

    // The lamport amount is still reported, so the fee is recoverable later.
    expect(resolution).toMatchObject({ status: 'filled', feeUsd: null, tipLamports: 20_000 });
  });

  it('leaves the fee null when the price lookup throws', async () => {
    mocks.fetchTokenPriceUsd.mockRejectedValue(new Error('dexscreener down'));
    mocks.getJitoBundleStatus.mockResolvedValue({
      bundleId: 'bundle-fee', status: 'Landed', transactions: ['sig-fee'], slot: 42
    });

    const resolution = await makeRuntime(memoryStore()).reconcile(landedPending, 500);

    // A price outage must not lose the fill itself.
    expect(resolution).toMatchObject({ status: 'filled', signature: 'sig-fee', feeUsd: null });
  });

  it('records no fee for a pending record written before tips were tracked', async () => {
    // Records already in Redis at deploy time carry no tip. They must reconcile
    // normally, with a missing fee rather than an invented one.
    mocks.getJitoBundleStatus.mockResolvedValue({
      bundleId: 'bundle-legacy', status: 'Landed', transactions: ['sig-legacy'], slot: 9
    });

    const resolution = await makeRuntime(memoryStore()).reconcile(
      {
        clientOrderId: 'order-legacy',
        bundleId: 'bundle-legacy',
        lastValidBlockHeight: 1_000,
        expiresAt: new Date('2026-08-05T00:10:00Z')
      },
      500
    );

    expect(resolution).toMatchObject({ status: 'filled', feeUsd: null, tipLamports: null });
    expect(mocks.fetchTokenPriceUsd).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('carries the tip it actually submitted through to the landed fee', async () => {
    // End to end, because the two halves are written in different process ticks:
    // the tip is chosen at submit and priced at reconcile. Recomputing it at
    // reconcile time would re-read a tip floor that has since moved and book a
    // number the chain never saw.
    const store = memoryStore();
    const runtime = makeRuntime(store);
    await runtime.submit({ clientOrderId: 'order-e2e', quote: QUOTE, signerPublicKey: 's' });

    // p75 of the fixture floor, under the 1_000_000 cap.
    expect(submittedTip().lamports).toBe(20_000);
    expect(await store.findPending('order-e2e')).toMatchObject({ tipLamports: 20_000 });

    mocks.getJitoBundleStatus.mockResolvedValue({
      bundleId: 'bundle-1', status: 'Landed', transactions: ['sig-e2e'], slot: 11
    });
    const [resolution] = await runtime.sweep(500);

    expect(resolution).toMatchObject({ status: 'filled', tipLamports: 20_000 });
    expect(feeUsdOf(resolution)).toBeCloseTo(0.004, 12);
    expect(await store.findResolution('order-e2e')).toMatchObject({ feeUsd: expect.any(Number) });
  });
});

describe('pre-trade simulation gate (S4-M15)', () => {
  function runtimeWithGate(gate: SolanaSimulationGate) {
    return createJupiterJitoRuntime({
      pendingStore: memoryStore(),
      jito: { baseUrl: 'https://block-engine.test' },
      signTransaction: async (tx) => `signed:${tx}`,
      buildTipTransaction: async ({ tipAccount, lamports }) => `tip:${tipAccount}:${lamports}`,
      maxTipLamports: 1_000_000,
      fallbackTipLamports: 10_000,
      pendingTtlMs: 600_000,
      simulation: gate,
      now: () => new Date('2026-08-05T00:00:00Z')
    });
  }

  it('simulates the transaction that was actually built', async () => {
    const evaluate = vi.fn(async () => ({ kind: 'submit' as const, outcome: { kind: 'proceed' as const, unitsConsumed: 1, slot: 2 } }));
    const runtime = runtimeWithGate({ evaluate });

    await runtime.submit({ clientOrderId: 'order-sim-1', quote: QUOTE, signerPublicKey: 'signer' });

    expect(evaluate).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      transactionBase64: 'base64-swap',
      clientOrderId: 'order-sim-1'
    });
  });

  it('rejects without submitting, tipping, or signing when the simulation refuses', async () => {
    const runtime = runtimeWithGate({
      evaluate: async () => ({
        kind: 'skip',
        code: 'solana-simulation-reverted',
        reason: 'simulation reverted: {"InstructionError":[3,{"Custom":6001}]}'
      })
    });

    const submission = await runtime.submit({
      clientOrderId: 'order-sim-2',
      quote: QUOTE,
      signerPublicKey: 'signer'
    });

    expect(submission.status).toBe('rejected');
    if (submission.status !== 'rejected') throw new Error('expected a rejection');
    expect(submission.code).toBe('solana-simulation-reverted');
    expect(submission.reason).toContain('solana-simulation-reverted');
    expect(submission.reason).toContain('InstructionError');
    // A refused route must not cost a tip lookup, a signature, or a bundle. This
    // is the whole point of the item: discovering the failure without paying.
    expect(mocks.getJitoTipFloor).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mocks.getJitoTipAccounts).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mocks.submitJitoBundle).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('rejects rather than submitting when the simulator is unavailable and policy is skip', async () => {
    const runtime = runtimeWithGate({
      evaluate: async () => ({
        kind: 'skip',
        code: 'solana-simulator-unreachable',
        reason: 'simulateTransaction failed: fetch failed'
      })
    });

    const submission = await runtime.submit({
      clientOrderId: 'order-sim-3',
      quote: QUOTE,
      signerPublicKey: 'signer'
    });

    expect(submission.status).toBe('rejected');
    if (submission.status !== 'rejected') throw new Error('expected a rejection');
    // Distinct from a revert so an operator triaging skips is pointed at the RPC,
    // not at the route.
    expect(submission.code).toBe('solana-simulator-unreachable');
    expect(mocks.submitJitoBundle).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('never marks a simulation skip as submission_unknown', async () => {
    const runtime = runtimeWithGate({
      evaluate: async () => ({
        kind: 'skip',
        code: 'solana-simulation-transaction-undecodable',
        reason: 'built swap transaction did not decode'
      })
    });

    const submission = await runtime.submit({
      clientOrderId: 'order-sim-4',
      quote: QUOTE,
      signerPublicKey: 'signer'
    });

    // Nothing was transmitted, so there is no venue state to reconcile and the
    // job must not be routed to the ambiguous path.
    expect(submission.status).not.toBe('submission_unknown');
    expect(submission.status).toBe('rejected');
  });

  it('does not run the gate for an order that is already terminal', async () => {
    const store = memoryStore();
    await store.resolve('order-sim-5', {
      status: 'filled',
      clientOrderId: 'order-sim-5',
      signature: 'sig-5',
      slot: 10
    });
    const evaluate = vi.fn();
    const runtime = createJupiterJitoRuntime({
      pendingStore: store,
      jito: { baseUrl: 'https://block-engine.test' },
      signTransaction: async (tx) => `signed:${tx}`,
      buildTipTransaction: async () => 'tip',
      maxTipLamports: 1_000_000,
      fallbackTipLamports: 10_000,
      pendingTtlMs: 600_000,
      simulation: { evaluate: evaluate as never }
    });

    const submission = await runtime.submit({
      clientOrderId: 'order-sim-5',
      quote: QUOTE,
      signerPublicKey: 'signer'
    });

    expect(submission.status).toBe('already_resolved');
    expect(evaluate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mocks.buildJupiterSwap).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('submits unsimulated when no gate is supplied, preserving prior behaviour', async () => {
    const runtime = makeRuntime(memoryStore());

    const submission = await runtime.submit({
      clientOrderId: 'order-sim-6',
      quote: QUOTE,
      signerPublicKey: 'signer'
    });

    expect(submission.status).toBe('submitted');
    expect(mocks.submitJitoBundle).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it('proceeds to submission when the simulation is clean', async () => {
    const runtime = runtimeWithGate({
      evaluate: async () => ({
        kind: 'submit',
        outcome: { kind: 'proceed', unitsConsumed: 210_000, slot: 300_000_500 }
      })
    });

    const submission = await runtime.submit({
      clientOrderId: 'order-sim-7',
      quote: QUOTE,
      signerPublicKey: 'signer'
    });

    expect(submission.status).toBe('submitted');
    expect(mocks.submitJitoBundle).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});

==> apps/trade-executor/src/jupiter-jito-runtime.ts <==
import {
  buildJupiterSwap,
  fetchTokenPriceUsd,
  getJitoBundleStatus,
  getJitoTipAccounts,
  getJitoTipFloor,
  lamportsToUsd,
  selectJitoTip,
  selectTipAccount,
  submitJitoBundle,
  type JitoClientOptions,
  type JupiterQuote
} from '@swat/shared';
import {
  decodeRuntimeValue,
  encodeRuntimeValue,
  type RedisHashClient
} from './runtime-codec.js';
import type { SolanaSimulationGate } from './solana-simulation.js';

/**
 * Solana execution over Jupiter + Jito bundles (DG-1, checklist S3-1…S3-5).
 *
 * Replaces the Trojan webhook path. The state machine deliberately mirrors
 * `trojan-runtime.ts` — `pending_confirmation` handed to the existing sweeper,
 * terminal resolutions cached by client order id — so the executor's
 * reconciliation semantics carry over unchanged and only the transport differs.
 *
 * **Bundles, never public RPC.** A swap broadcast to the public mempool is
 * visible to searchers before it lands, which is the window a sandwich needs.
 * Bundles go straight to block builders and land atomically, so there is also no
 * partial-fill state to reconcile.
 */

const DEFAULT_STORE_KEY = 'swat:trade-executor:pending:jupiter-jito:v1';

/**
 * Wrapped SOL. The tip is paid in lamports; `feeUsd` needs a USD price for them.
 *
 * Duplicated rather than imported from `solana-dispatch.ts`, which already exports
 * the same constant — that module imports *this* one, so importing back would
 * close an import cycle.
 */
const WRAPPED_SOL_MINT = 'So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112';

export interface JupiterJitoSubmitInput {
  /** Stable idempotency key. Must be `(signalId, target_account)`-derived. */
  readonly clientOrderId: string;
  readonly quote: JupiterQuote;
  readonly signerPublicKey: string;
}

export type JupiterJitoSubmission =
  | { readonly status: 'submitted'; readonly clientOrderId: string; readonly bundleId: string; readonly lastValidBlockHeight: number }
  | { readonly status: 'pending_confirmation'; readonly clientOrderId: string; readonly bundleId: string; readonly lastValidBlockHeight: number }
  | {
      readonly status: 'rejected';
      readonly clientOrderId: string;
      readonly reason: string;
      /**
       * Stable machine-readable code, when the rejection has one.
       *
       * Optional and additive so existing consumers that only read `reason` keep
       * working; `S4-M24` reads this to render an actionable skip reason instead
       * of parsing prose.
       */
      readonly code?: string;
    }
  | { readonly status: 'submission_unknown'; readonly clientOrderId: string; readonly reason: string }
  | { readonly status: 'already_resolved'; readonly clientOrderId: string; readonly resolution: JupiterJitoResolution };

/**
 * Terminal outcomes.
 *
 * **Only `filled` carries a tip** (checklist S4-P18). Jito bundles are atomic and
 * all-or-nothing, so a bundle that never landed was never charged a tip, and
 * booking one against a `failed` or `ambiguous` outcome would fabricate a cost
 * against a position that does not exist. Keeping the fields off the non-landed
 * variants makes that a type-level guarantee rather than a convention a future
 * call site can forget.
 *
 * `ambiguous` is the case worth being explicit about: it covers a confirmation
 * timeout and a bundle that landed without an observable signature. Neither is a
 * *free* outcome — the second one almost certainly did pay a tip — but neither is
 * an observed one either, and there is no position to attribute a cost to. The
 * cost of an ambiguous outcome is settled by an operator reading the chain, not
 * guessed here.
 */
export type JupiterJitoResolution =
  | {
      readonly status: 'filled';
      readonly clientOrderId: string;
      readonly signature: string;
      readonly slot: number | null;
      /** Tip actually paid by the landed bundle. Absent on records written before S4-P18. */
      readonly tipLamports?: number | null;
      /**
       * The tip in USD, for `persistTrade`'s `feeUsd`.
       *
       * `null` when the SOL price was unavailable: a missing fee is visibly
       * absent, a guessed one silently misstates P&L.
       */
      readonly feeUsd?: number | null;
    }
  | { readonly status: 'failed'; readonly clientOrderId: string; readonly reason: string }
  | { readonly status: 'ambiguous'; readonly clientOrderId: string; readonly reason: string };

export interface PendingJupiterJitoSubmission {
  readonly clientOrderId: string;
  readonly bundleId: string;
  /** Beyond this block height the transaction can never land — see below. */
  readonly lastValidBlockHeight: number;
  readonly expiresAt: Date;
  /**
   * Tip carried by the submitted bundle, in lamports.
   *
   * Optional because records already in Redis when this shipped do not have it,
   * and an in-flight bundle must reconcile normally rather than crash the sweep.
   * A missing value resolves to no fee rather than to a guessed one.
   */
  readonly tipLamports?: number | null;
}

type StoredState =
  | { state: 'pending'; pending: PendingJupiterJitoSubmission }
  | { state: 'resolved'; resolution: JupiterJitoResolution };

export interface JupiterJitoPendingStore {
  findPending(clientOrderId: string): Promise<PendingJupiterJitoSubmission | null>;
  findResolution(clientOrderId: string): Promise<JupiterJitoResolution | null>;
  listPending(): Promise<PendingJupiterJitoSubmission[]>;
  save(pending: PendingJupiterJitoSubmission): Promise<void>;
  resolve(clientOrderId: string, resolution: JupiterJitoResolution): Promise<void>;
}

export function createRedisJupiterJitoStore(
  redis: RedisHashClient,
  key = DEFAULT_STORE_KEY
): JupiterJitoPendingStore {
  async function read(clientOrderId: string): Promise<StoredState | null> {
    const encoded = await redis.hget(key, clientOrderId);
    return encoded ? decodeRuntimeValue<StoredState>(encoded) : null;
  }

  return {
    async findPending(clientOrderId) {
      const stored = await read(clientOrderId);
      return stored?.state === 'pending' ? stored.pending : null;
    },
    async findResolution(clientOrderId) {
      const stored = await read(clientOrderId);
      return stored?.state === 'resolved' ? stored.resolution : null;
    },
    async listPending() {
      const values = await redis.hgetall(key);
      return Object.values(values).flatMap((encoded) => {
        const stored = decodeRuntimeValue<StoredState>(encoded);
        return stored.state === 'pending' ? [stored.pending] : [];
      });
    },
    async save(pending) {
      await redis.hset(
        key,
        pending.clientOrderId,
        encodeRuntimeValue({ state: 'pending', pending } satisfies StoredState)
      );
    },
    async resolve(clientOrderId, resolution) {
      await redis.hset(
        key,
        clientOrderId,
        encodeRuntimeValue({ state: 'resolved', resolution } satisfies StoredState)
      );
    }
  };
}

export interface JupiterJitoRuntimeOptions {
  readonly pendingStore: JupiterJitoPendingStore;
  readonly jito: JitoClientOptions;
  /**
   * Signs a base64 transaction and returns it base64-encoded.
   *
   * A **parameter**, not a module-level key (Standing Rule 2): the operator
   * wallet today, a per-user custodial key at Stage 4, with no call-site change.
   */
  readonly signTransaction: (transactionBase64: string) => Promise<string>;
  /** Builds the base64 tip transfer to the given tip account. */
  readonly buildTipTransaction: (input: {
    tipAccount: string;
    lamports: number;
  }) => Promise<string>;
  readonly maxTipLamports: number;
  readonly fallbackTipLamports: number;
  readonly tipPercentile?: 'p50' | 'p75' | 'p95';
  readonly pendingTtlMs: number;
  readonly jupiterApiKey?: string;
  /**
   * Pre-trade simulation gate (checklist S4-M15).
   *
   * A **parameter**, not a module-level `Connection` (Standing Rule 2), and
   * optional: when absent the swap is submitted unsimulated, which is the
   * behaviour every caller had before this existed. Supply it from
   * `createSolanaSimulationGateFromEnvironment()`.
   */
  readonly simulation?: SolanaSimulationGate;
  readonly now?: () => Date;
}

export function createJupiterJitoRuntime(options: JupiterJitoRuntimeOptions) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(options.pendingTtlMs) || options.pendingTtlMs < 60_000) {
    throw new Error('pendingTtlMs must be an integer of at least 60000');
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(options.maxTipLamports) || options.maxTipLamports <= 0) {
    // Without a positive cap the tip is unbounded, and the tip is real SOL
    // charged against position P&L on every trade.
    throw new Error('maxTipLamports must be a positive integer');
  }
  const now = options.now ?? (() => new Date());

  async function submit(input: JupiterJitoSubmitInput): Promise<JupiterJitoSubmission> {
    // Terminal states are sticky: a resolved order must never be resubmitted,
    // however many times the queue redelivers the job.
    const resolved = await options.pendingStore.findResolution(input.clientOrderId);
    if (resolved) {
      return { status: 'already_resolved', clientOrderId: input.clientOrderId, resolution: resolved };
    }
    const pending = await options.pendingStore.findPending(input.clientOrderId);
    if (pending) {
      return {
        status: 'pending_confirmation',
        clientOrderId: input.clientOrderId,
        bundleId: pending.bundleId,
        lastValidBlockHeight: pending.lastValidBlockHeight
      };
    }

    const built = await buildJupiterSwap({
      quote: input.quote,
      userPublicKey: input.signerPublicKey,
      // No priority fee: the Jito tip is what buys inclusion, and layering a
      // priority fee on top is paying twice for the same thing.
      computeUnitPriceMicroLamports: undefined,
      apiKey: options.jupiterApiKey
    });
    if (!built) {
      return { status: 'rejected', clientOrderId: input.clientOrderId, reason: 'swap-build-failed' };
    }

    // Pre-trade simulation (checklist S4-M15).
    //
    // **Why the gate lives inside the runtime rather than in front of it.** The
    // artifact that has to be simulated is the built transaction, and it only
    // ever exists here: `solana-dispatch.ts` holds a quote, and
    // `buildJupiterSwap` is called from this function, after the idempotency
    // guards. Simulating from dispatch would mean either building the swap twice
    // (two paid Jupiter `/swap` calls producing two different transactions, so
    // the one simulated is not the one submitted) or hoisting the build above the
    // resolved/pending checks, which is exactly the ordering that must not change
    // — a redelivered job would then build and simulate a swap for an order that
    // is already terminal.
    //
    // It runs *before* the tip floor is fetched and before anything is signed, so
    // a refused route costs one RPC round trip and nothing else. A skip here is
    // `rejected`, never `submission_unknown`: no bundle was transmitted, so there
    // is no venue-side state to reconcile.
    if (options.simulation) {
      const decision = await options.simulation.evaluate({
        transactionBase64: built.swapTransaction,
        clientOrderId: input.clientOrderId
      });
      if (decision.kind === 'skip') {
        return {
          status: 'rejected',
          clientOrderId: input.clientOrderId,
          reason: `${decision.code}: ${decision.reason}`,
          code: decision.code
        };
      }
    }

    const floor = await getJitoTipFloor(options.jito);
    const tipLamports = selectJitoTip({
      floor,
      percentile: options.tipPercentile ?? 'p75',
      maxTipLamports: options.maxTipLamports,
      fallbackTipLamports: options.fallbackTipLamports
    });
    // Resolved at runtime, TTL-cached, and falling back to the hard-coded set
    // (S4-P18). Never empty, so `selectTipAccount` always has something to pick.
    const tipAccounts = await getJitoTipAccounts(options.jito);
    const tipAccount = selectTipAccount(input.clientOrderId, tipAccounts);

    let signedSwap: string;
    let signedTip: string;
    try {
      signedSwap = await options.signTransaction(built.swapTransaction);
      signedTip = await options.signTransaction(
        await options.buildTipTransaction({ tipAccount, lamports: tipLamports })
      );
    } catch (error) {
      // Nothing was transmitted, so this is unambiguously a rejection rather
      // than an unknown submission.
      return {
        status: 'rejected',
        clientOrderId: input.clientOrderId,
        reason: `signing-failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'unknown'}`
      };
    }

    const result = await submitJitoBundle([signedSwap, signedTip], options.jito);

    if (!result.ok) {
      if (result.retryable) {
        // Genuinely ambiguous: the block engine may have received the bundle.
        // Recorded as pending with no bundle id so the sweeper investigates
        // rather than the caller resubmitting blind.
        //
        // It is NOT downgraded to a public RPC broadcast (S3-5). Doing so would
        // silently reintroduce exactly the front-running exposure bundles exist
        // to remove, and the operator would still believe they were protected.
        return {
          status: 'submission_unknown',
          clientOrderId: input.clientOrderId,
          reason: result.reason
        };
      }
      return { status: 'rejected', clientOrderId: input.clientOrderId, reason: result.reason };
    }

    await options.pendingStore.save({
      clientOrderId: input.clientOrderId,
      bundleId: result.bundleId,
      lastValidBlockHeight: built.lastValidBlockHeight,
      expiresAt: new Date(now().getTime() + options.pendingTtlMs),
      // Carried on the pending record because reconciliation happens in a later
      // process tick — often a later process — and the block engine's status
      // response does not report what the bundle tipped. Recomputing it at
      // reconcile time would re-read a tip floor that has since moved and book a
      // number the chain never saw.
      tipLamports
    });

    return {
      status: 'submitted',
      clientOrderId: input.clientOrderId,
      bundleId: result.bundleId,
      lastValidBlockHeight: built.lastValidBlockHeight
    };
  }

  /**
   * Prices a landed bundle's tip in USD, for `persistTrade`'s `feeUsd`.
   *
   * Only ever called once a bundle is known to have landed — see `reconcile`.
   *
   * Returns `null` on every path where the number would be a guess: a pending
   * record from before S4-P18 that carries no tip, a nonsensical tip, or an
   * unavailable SOL price. `fetchTokenPriceUsd` answers `null` when every one of
   * its upstreams fails, and that must not collapse into a zero fee — zero is a
   * claim that the trade cost nothing, which is a different and false statement.
   */
  async function priceLandedTip(
    tipLamports: number | null | undefined
  ): Promise<number | null> {
    if (typeof tipLamports !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(tipLamports) || tipLamports <= 0) {
      return null;
    }
    const solPriceUsd = await fetchTokenPriceUsd(WRAPPED_SOL_MINT).catch(() => null);
    return lamportsToUsd(tipLamports, solPriceUsd);
  }

  /**
   * Resolves one pending bundle (checklist S3-4).
   *
   * Returns `null` when the outcome still cannot be observed — deliberately
   * distinct from a `failed` resolution. Treating an unreachable block engine as
   * failure would let the executor conclude a live bundle died and re-enter the
   * position, double-spending it.
   */
  async function reconcile(
    pending: PendingJupiterJitoSubmission,
    currentBlockHeight?: number
  ): Promise<JupiterJitoResolution | null> {
    const status = await getJitoBundleStatus(pending.bundleId, options.jito);
    if (!status) return null;

    if (status.status === 'Landed') {
      const signature = status.transactions[0];
      if (!signature) {
        // Landed without an observable signature is not a fill we can quantify.
        // Never fabricate one — the position ledger would be permanently wrong.
        return {
          status: 'ambiguous',
          clientOrderId: pending.clientOrderId,
          reason: 'landed-without-signature'
        };
      }
      // The one branch that books a cost. Everything below either never paid a
      // tip (atomic bundle, never landed) or cannot be observed to have paid one.
      const tipLamports = pending.tipLamports ?? null;
      return {
        status: 'filled',
        clientOrderId: pending.clientOrderId,
        signature,
        slot: status.slot,
        tipLamports,
        feeUsd: await priceLandedTip(tipLamports)
      };
    }

    if (status.status === 'Failed') {
      return { status: 'failed', clientOrderId: pending.clientOrderId, reason: 'bundle-failed' };
    }

    // `Invalid` means the block engine has never seen this id. Combined with an
    // expired blockhash that is a definitive miss; on its own it may just be
    // propagation lag, so it is not resolved here.
    if (
      typeof currentBlockHeight === 'number' &&
      currentBlockHeight > pending.lastValidBlockHeight
    ) {
      // Past `lastValidBlockHeight` the transaction can never land. This is the
      // only safe point to declare a miss, and it is why resubmission requires a
      // FRESH quote and build — the expired blockhash makes the old transaction
      // permanently unusable, so a blind retry would submit something that
      // cannot execute.
      return {
        status: 'failed',
        clientOrderId: pending.clientOrderId,
        reason: 'blockhash-expired'
      };
    }

    if (now() >= pending.expiresAt) {
      return {
        status: 'ambiguous',
        clientOrderId: pending.clientOrderId,
        reason: 'confirmation-timeout'
      };
    }

    return null;
  }

  async function sweep(currentBlockHeight?: number): Promise<JupiterJitoResolution[]> {
    const pendings = await options.pendingStore.listPending();
    const resolutions: JupiterJitoResolution[] = [];
    for (const pending of pendings) {
      const resolution = await reconcile(pending, currentBlockHeight);
      if (resolution) {
        await options.pendingStore.resolve(pending.clientOrderId, resolution);
        resolutions.push(resolution);
      }
    }
    return resolutions;
  }

  return { submit, reconcile, sweep };
}

export type JupiterJitoRuntime = ReturnType<typeof createJupiterJitoRuntime>;

import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { Keypair } from '@solana/web3.js';
import bs58 from 'bs58';

/**
 * S4-M15 — that the simulation gate is actually handed to the runtime.
 *
 * `solana-simulation.test.ts` proves the gate classifies correctly, and
 * `jupiter-jito-runtime.test.ts` proves `submit()` honours one when present. Both
 * pass whether or not anything ever constructs a gate — and for a while nothing
 * did, which made the whole feature inert on a live box while every test stayed
 * green. This file closes that gap by capturing the options the runtime factory is
 * called with.
 *
 * A separate file because it has to mock `./jupiter-jito-runtime.js`, and
 * `jupiter-jito-config.test.ts` exercises the real one.
 */
const runtimeMock = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  createJupiterJitoRuntime: vi.fn(() => ({ submit: vi.fn(), reconcile: vi.fn(), sweep: vi.fn() }))
}));

// Partial mock: the config module also imports `createRedisJupiterJitoStore` from
// here, and replacing the whole module would strip it.
vi.mock('./jupiter-jito-runtime.js', async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<typeof import('./jupiter-jito-runtime.js')>()),
  createJupiterJitoRuntime: runtimeMock.createJupiterJitoRuntime
}));

const { createJupiterJitoRuntimeFromEnvironment, resetJupiterJitoRuntimeForTests } =
  await import('./jupiter-jito-config.js');

function memoryRedis() {
  const store = new Map<string, Map<string, string>>();
  return {
    async hget(key: string, field: string) { return store.get(key)?.get(field) ?? null; },
    async hgetall(key: string) { return Object.fromEntries(store.get(key) ?? new Map()); },
    async hset(key: string, field: string, value: string) {
      if (!store.has(key)) store.set(key, new Map());
      store.get(key)!.set(field, value);
      return 1;
    }
  };
}

const saved: Record<string, string | undefined> = {};
const KEYS = [
  'SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY', 'SOLANA_RPC_URL', 'JITO_BLOCK_ENGINE_URL',
  'SOLANA_SIMULATION_ENABLED', 'SOLANA_SIMULATION_ON_UNAVAILABLE'
] as const;

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  for (const k of KEYS) saved[k] = process.env[k];
  process.env.SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY = bs58.encode(Keypair.generate().secretKey);
  process.env.SOLANA_RPC_URL = 'https://rpc.invalid';
  process.env.JITO_BLOCK_ENGINE_URL = 'https://jito.invalid';
  delete process.env.SOLANA_SIMULATION_ENABLED;
  delete process.env.SOLANA_SIMULATION_ON_UNAVAILABLE;
  resetJupiterJitoRuntimeForTests();
});

afterEach(() => {
  for (const k of KEYS) {
    if (saved[k] === undefined) delete process.env[k];
    else process.env[k] = saved[k];
  }
  resetJupiterJitoRuntimeForTests();
});

function optionsPassedToRuntime(): { simulation?: unknown } {
  expect(runtimeMock.createJupiterJitoRuntime).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  // `vi.fn()` with no declared signature types `mock.calls` as an empty tuple, so
  // indexing it is a type error and the direct `as` is an unrelated-types
  // conversion. Widening through `unknown` first is what the compiler asks for.
  // Invisible under vitest, which does not typecheck — it only surfaced when this
  // package was checked against `packages/db/src` rather than its stale `dist`.
  const calls = runtimeMock.createJupiterJitoRuntime.mock.calls as unknown as Array<
    [{ simulation?: unknown }]
  >;
  const first = calls[0];
  if (!first) throw new Error('createJupiterJitoRuntime was not called');
  return first[0];
}

describe('Solana simulation gate reaches the Jito runtime (S4-M15)', () => {
  it('passes a gate when simulation is enabled', () => {
    // Simulation is opt-out, so the default path is the one that matters most.
    const created = createJupiterJitoRuntimeFromEnvironment(memoryRedis());
    expect(created).not.toBeNull();
    expect(optionsPassedToRuntime().simulation).toBeDefined();
  });

  it('passes no gate when simulation is explicitly disabled', () => {
    // An operator turning it off must actually turn it off — not get a gate that
    // silently evaluates anyway.
    process.env.SOLANA_SIMULATION_ENABLED = 'false';
    createJupiterJitoRuntimeFromEnvironment(memoryRedis());
    expect(optionsPassedToRuntime().simulation).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('passes undefined rather than null, which is what submit() guards on', () => {
    // `submit()` branches on `options.simulation` being present. A `null` would be
    // falsy and work by accident, but the option is typed optional, so null would
    // be a type error waiting for someone to widen it.
    createJupiterJitoRuntimeFromEnvironment(memoryRedis());
    const simulation = optionsPassedToRuntime().simulation;
    expect(simulation).not.toBeNull();
  });
});

/**
 * `S4-M45` — manual exit as the third entrant, and the per-chain catalogue that
 * says which entrants a chain has at all.
 *
 * Pure throughout: no database, no venue, no clock. The Polymarket race decisions
 * are asserted in `polymarket-exit-race.test.ts` — what is asserted here is that
 * this module *delegates* to that race rather than deciding anything itself, and

describe('decideManualExit — Polymarket, delegating to the one race', () => {
  it('enters the race and exits by the manual trigger on an open book', () => {
    expect(decideManualExit(polygonInput())).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'exit',
      trigger: 'manual',
      mechanism: 'polymarket-clob-sell-into-book',
      claimLedger: 'polymarket_position_exits',
      code: 'manual-exit-by-venue-sell'
    });
  });

  it('a manual exit racing a master sell resolves to exactly one exit', () => {
    // The decided design, at this layer: one call, one decision, one trigger. The
    // claim-level half of the same assertion is in `polymarket-exit-race.test.ts`.
    const decision = decideManualExit(polygonInput({
      observation: polygonObservation({ masterHoldsPosition: false })
    }));
    expect(decision).toMatchObject({ kind: 'exit', trigger: 'manual' });
  });

  it('stands down when another entrant already holds the claim', () => {
    const decision = decideManualExit(polygonInput({
      existingClaim: { trigger: 'redemption', status: 'claimed' }
    }));
    expect(decision).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'refuse',
      code: 'manual-exit-position-already-exiting'
    });
    // The forwarded reason is the race's own, not a second sentence written here.
    expect((decision as { reason: string }).reason).toMatch(/one winner per position/);
  });

  it('honours a manual request on a resolved market by redeeming, not selling', () => {
    const decision = decideManualExit(polygonInput({
      observation: polygonObservation({ marketResolved: true })
    }));
    expect(decision).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'exit',
      trigger: 'redemption',
      mechanism: 'polymarket-ctf-redeem-positions',
      code: 'manual-exit-by-redemption'
    });
  });

  it('refuses a request for a position we hold nothing of', () => {
    expect(decideManualExit(polygonInput({ heldShares: 0 }))).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'refuse',
      code: 'manual-exit-nothing-held'
    });
  });

  it('separates an unread held quantity from a zero one', () => {
    // Unknown is not zero. A refusal says the position is fine and the request was
    // rejected; `unavailable` says the machinery could not answer, and sending an
    // operator to the wrong one of those is the cost of collapsing them.
    expect(decideManualExit(polygonInput({ heldShares: null }))).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'unavailable',
      code: 'manual-exit-held-shares-unread'
    });
  });

  it('refuses when no manual exit was actually requested', () => {
    expect(decideManualExit(polygonInput({
      observation: polygonObservation({ manualExitRequested: false })
    }))).toMatchObject({ kind: 'refuse', code: 'manual-exit-not-requested' });
  });

  it('refuses a position key that is not the key the outcome token hashes to', () => {
    // The `S4-M20` collapse, caught before a claim is taken: a condition id where an
    // outcome token belongs would exit the wrong side of the market.
    expect(decideManualExit(polygonInput({ positionKey: `polygon:${CONDITION}` }))).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'refuse',
      code: 'manual-exit-position-key-mismatch'
    });
  });

  it('reports the missing outcome position rather than guessing one', () => {
    expect(decideManualExit(polygonInput({ polymarketPosition: undefined }))).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'unavailable',
      code: 'manual-exit-polymarket-position-missing'
    });
  });

  it('does not need the master cross-reference to be readable', () => {
    expect(decideManualExit(polygonInput({
      observation: polygonObservation({ masterHoldsPosition: null })
    }))).toMatchObject({ kind: 'exit', trigger: 'manual' });
  });

  it('forwards a race hold rather than overriding it', () => {
    // There is no reachable hold with a manual request live today — rung 0 is
    // caught above as `manual-exit-nothing-held` — so this pins the contract: if
    // the race ever declines, its reason is forwarded and not reinterpreted here.
    const decision = decideManualExit(polygonInput({ heldShares: Number.NaN }));
    expect(decision.kind).toBe('refuse');
  });
});
