export interface PolymarketCollateralReadinessOptions {
  funderAddress: string;
  signerAddress: string;
  accountWalletType: 'EOA' | 'POLY_PROXY' | 'POLY_GNOSIS_SAFE' | 'POLY_1271';
  directWalletWritesAllowed: boolean;
  minimumPusdUnits: bigint;
  allowanceCapUnits: bigint;
  autoOnramp: boolean;
  autoApprove: boolean;
}

export interface PolymarketCollateralReadiness {
  pUsdBalanceUnits: bigint;
  allowanceCapUnits: bigint;
  actions: Array<{ type: string; transactionHash: string }>;
}

function assertNonNegative(value: bigint, name: string): void {
  if (value < 0n) throw new Error(`${name} cannot be negative`);
}

async function approveExact(
  current: bigint,
  required: bigint,
  read: () => Promise<bigint>,
  approve: (amount: bigint) => Promise<string>,
  actionType: string,
  actions: Array<{ type: string; transactionHash: string }>
): Promise<void> {
  if (current === required) return;
  if (current > 0n) {
    actions.push({ type: `${actionType}-reset`, transactionHash: await approve(0n) });
    const resetAllowance = await read();
    if (resetAllowance !== 0n) {
      throw new Error(`${actionType} allowance did not reset to zero`);
    }
  }
  actions.push({ type: actionType, transactionHash: await approve(required) });
  const confirmedAllowance = await read();
  if (confirmedAllowance !== required) {
    throw new Error(`${actionType} allowance did not confirm at the configured exact cap`);
  }
}

function normalizeAddress(address: string, label: string): string {
  try {
    return ethers.utils.getAddress(address);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`${label} must be a valid EVM address`);
  }
}

function manualWalletInstruction(
  options: PolymarketCollateralReadinessOptions,
  action: string
): string {
  return (
    `${options.accountWalletType} account wallet ${options.funderAddress} requires ${action}; ` +
    `complete it through that account wallet rather than signer ${options.signerAddress}`
  );
}

function assertWalletWritePath(options: PolymarketCollateralReadinessOptions): void {
  const signer = normalizeAddress(options.signerAddress, 'signerAddress');
  const funder = normalizeAddress(options.funderAddress, 'funderAddress');
  const isEoa = options.accountWalletType === 'EOA';

  if (options.directWalletWritesAllowed !== isEoa) {
    throw new Error('direct wallet writes are permitted only for an EOA account wallet');
  }
  if (isEoa && signer !== funder) {
    throw new Error('EOA collateral setup requires signerAddress and funderAddress to match');
  }
  if (!isEoa && (options.autoOnramp || options.autoApprove)) {
    throw new Error(
      manualWalletInstruction(
        options,
        'manual collateral and approval setup because automatic setup is EOA-only'
      )
    );
  }
}

function assertSixDecimalCollateral(pUsdDecimals: number, usdcEDecimals: number): void {
  if (pUsdDecimals !== 6) {
    throw new Error(`pUSD decimals mismatch: expected 6, got ${pUsdDecimals}`);
  }
  if (usdcEDecimals !== 6) {
    throw new Error(`USDC.e decimals mismatch: expected 6, got ${usdcEDecimals}`);
  }
}

export async function ensurePolymarketCollateralReadiness(
  gateway: PolymarketCollateralGateway,
  options: PolymarketCollateralReadinessOptions
): Promise<PolymarketCollateralReadiness> {
  assertWalletWritePath(options);
  assertNonNegative(options.minimumPusdUnits, 'minimumPusdUnits');
  assertNonNegative(options.allowanceCapUnits, 'allowanceCapUnits');
  if (options.minimumPusdUnits === 0n) {
    throw new Error('minimumPusdUnits must be greater than zero for live execution');
  }
  if (options.allowanceCapUnits === 0n) {
    throw new Error('allowanceCapUnits must be greater than zero for live execution');
  }
  if (options.minimumPusdUnits > options.allowanceCapUnits) {
    throw new Error('minimumPusdUnits cannot exceed the bounded allowanceCapUnits');
  }

  const [pUsdDecimals, usdcEDecimals] = await Promise.all([
    gateway.getPusdDecimals(),
    gateway.getUsdcEDecimals()
  ]);
  assertSixDecimalCollateral(pUsdDecimals, usdcEDecimals);

  const actions: Array<{ type: string; transactionHash: string }> = [];
  let pUsdBalance = await gateway.getPusdBalance(options.funderAddress);
  assertNonNegative(pUsdBalance, 'pUSD balance');

  if (pUsdBalance < options.minimumPusdUnits) {
    if (!options.autoOnramp) {
      if (!options.directWalletWritesAllowed) {
        throw new Error(
          manualWalletInstruction(options, 'manual pUSD funding to reach the configured live minimum')
        );
      }
      throw new Error(
        'pUSD balance is below the configured live minimum; fund it manually or explicitly enable POLYMARKET_AUTO_ONRAMP=true'
      );
    }

    const amount = options.minimumPusdUnits - pUsdBalance;
    const usdcEBalance = await gateway.getUsdcEBalance(options.signerAddress);
    assertNonNegative(usdcEBalance, 'USDC.e balance');
    if (usdcEBalance < amount) {
      throw new Error('USDC.e balance cannot cover the exact pUSD onramp amount');
    }

    const usdcEAllowance = await gateway.getUsdcEAllowance(
      options.signerAddress,
      POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.collateralOnramp
    );
    await approveExact(
      usdcEAllowance,
      amount,
      () => gateway.getUsdcEAllowance(
        options.signerAddress,
        POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.collateralOnramp
      ),
      (value) => gateway.approveUsdcE(POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.collateralOnramp, value),
      'approve-usdce-onramp',
      actions
    );
    actions.push({
      type: 'wrap-usdce-to-pusd',
      transactionHash: await gateway.wrapUsdcE(options.funderAddress, amount)
    });

    pUsdBalance = await gateway.getPusdBalance(options.funderAddress);
    assertNonNegative(pUsdBalance, 'pUSD balance');
    if (pUsdBalance < options.minimumPusdUnits) {
      throw new Error('pUSD balance remained below the live minimum after onramp confirmation');
    }
  }

  for (const exchange of [POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.ctfExchange, POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.negRiskCtfExchange]) {
    const allowance = await gateway.getPusdAllowance(options.funderAddress, exchange);
    assertNonNegative(allowance, `pUSD allowance for ${exchange}`);
    if (allowance !== options.allowanceCapUnits) {
      if (!options.autoApprove) {
        const relation = allowance < options.allowanceCapUnits ? 'below' : 'above';
        if (!options.directWalletWritesAllowed) {
          throw new Error(
            manualWalletInstruction(
              options,
              `an exact pUSD allowance of ${options.allowanceCapUnits} units for exchange ${exchange}; current allowance is ${relation} the cap`
            )
          );
        }
        throw new Error(
          `pUSD allowance is ${relation} the configured exact cap for exchange ${exchange}; ` +
          'set it manually or explicitly enable POLYMARKET_AUTO_APPROVE=true'
        );
      }
      await approveExact(
        allowance,
        options.allowanceCapUnits,
        () => gateway.getPusdAllowance(options.funderAddress, exchange),
        (value) => gateway.approvePusd(exchange, value),
        'approve-pusd-exchange',
        actions
      );
    }

    const conditionalApproved = await gateway.isConditionalTokenApproved(options.funderAddress, exchange);
    if (!conditionalApproved) {
      if (!options.autoApprove) {
        if (!options.directWalletWritesAllowed) {
          throw new Error(
            manualWalletInstruction(
              options,
              `manual Conditional Tokens operator approval for exchange ${exchange}`
            )
          );
        }
        throw new Error(
          `conditional-token sell approval is missing for exchange ${exchange}; ` +
          'set it manually or explicitly enable POLYMARKET_AUTO_APPROVE=true'
        );
      }
      actions.push({
        type: 'approve-conditional-token-exchange',
        transactionHash: await gateway.approveConditionalTokenOperator(exchange)
      });
      if (!await gateway.isConditionalTokenApproved(options.funderAddress, exchange)) {
        throw new Error(`conditional-token approval did not confirm for exchange ${exchange}`);
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    pUsdBalanceUnits: pUsdBalance,
    allowanceCapUnits: options.allowanceCapUnits,
    actions
  };
}

function asBigInt(value: ethers.BigNumber): bigint {
  return BigInt(value.toString());
}

async function waitForSuccess(transaction: ethers.ContractTransaction): Promise<string> {
  const receipt = await transaction.wait(1);
  if (receipt.status !== 1) {
    throw new Error(`Polymarket collateral transaction failed: ${transaction.hash}`);
  }
  return transaction.hash;
}

export class EthersPolymarketCollateralGateway implements PolymarketCollateralGateway {
  private readonly pUsdRead: ethers.Contract;
  private readonly usdcERead: ethers.Contract;
  private readonly conditionalTokensRead: ethers.Contract;
  private readonly pUsdWrite: ethers.Contract | null;
  private readonly usdcEWrite: ethers.Contract | null;
  private readonly conditionalTokensWrite: ethers.Contract | null;
  private readonly onrampWrite: ethers.Contract | null;

  constructor(provider: ethers.providers.Provider, signer: ethers.Signer | null) {
    this.pUsdRead = new ethers.Contract(POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.pUsd, ERC20_ABI, provider);
    this.usdcERead = new ethers.Contract(POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.usdcE, ERC20_ABI, provider);
    this.conditionalTokensRead = new ethers.Contract(
      POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.conditionalTokens,
      CONDITIONAL_TOKENS_ABI,
      provider
    );
    this.pUsdWrite = signer ? this.pUsdRead.connect(signer) : null;
    this.usdcEWrite = signer ? this.usdcERead.connect(signer) : null;
    this.conditionalTokensWrite = signer ? this.conditionalTokensRead.connect(signer) : null;
    this.onrampWrite = signer
      ? new ethers.Contract(POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.collateralOnramp, ONRAMP_ABI, signer)
      : null;
  }

  async getPusdDecimals(): Promise<number> {
    return Number(await this.pUsdRead.decimals());
  }

  async getUsdcEDecimals(): Promise<number> {
    return Number(await this.usdcERead.decimals());
  }

  async getPusdBalance(account: string): Promise<bigint> {
    return asBigInt(await this.pUsdRead.balanceOf(account));
  }

  async getUsdcEBalance(account: string): Promise<bigint> {
    return asBigInt(await this.usdcERead.balanceOf(account));
  }

  async getUsdcEAllowance(account: string, spender: string): Promise<bigint> {
    return asBigInt(await this.usdcERead.allowance(account, spender));
  }

  async approveUsdcE(spender: string, amount: bigint): Promise<string> {
    if (!this.usdcEWrite) throw new Error('No signer is configured for USDC.e approval');
    return waitForSuccess(await this.usdcEWrite.approve(spender, amount.toString()));
  }

  async wrapUsdcE(to: string, amount: bigint): Promise<string> {
    if (!this.onrampWrite) throw new Error('No signer is configured for the USDC.e onramp');
    return waitForSuccess(
      await this.onrampWrite.wrap(POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.usdcE, to, amount.toString())
    );
  }

  async getPusdAllowance(account: string, spender: string): Promise<bigint> {
    return asBigInt(await this.pUsdRead.allowance(account, spender));
  }

  async approvePusd(spender: string, amount: bigint): Promise<string> {
    if (!this.pUsdWrite) throw new Error('No signer is configured for pUSD approval');
    return waitForSuccess(await this.pUsdWrite.approve(spender, amount.toString()));
  }

  async isConditionalTokenApproved(account: string, operator: string): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.conditionalTokensRead.isApprovedForAll(account, operator);
  }

  async approveConditionalTokenOperator(operator: string): Promise<string> {
    if (!this.conditionalTokensWrite) {
      throw new Error('No signer is configured for conditional-token approval');
    }
    return waitForSuccess(await this.conditionalTokensWrite.setApprovalForAll(operator, true));
  }
}

type Harness = {
  submitted: PolymarketExitLimitRung[];
  alerts: PolymarketExitAlert[];
  redemptions: PolymarketExitRedeem[];
  submitRung: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
  ports: any;
};

function harness(options: {
  candidates?: PolymarketExitEscalationCandidate[];
  fillPerRung?: number;
  sellableShares?: number;
  market?: typeof OPEN_MARKET;
  bids?: { price: string; size: string }[];
} = {}): Harness {
  const submitted: PolymarketExitLimitRung[] = [];
  const alerts: PolymarketExitAlert[] = [];
  const redemptions: PolymarketExitRedeem[] = [];
  const submitRung = vi.fn(async (rung: PolymarketExitLimitRung) => {
    submitted.push(rung);
    return { filledShares: options.fillPerRung ?? 0 };
  });
  return {
    submitted,
    alerts,
    redemptions,
    submitRung,
    ports: {
      loadCandidates: vi.fn(async () => options.candidates ?? [candidate()]),
      fetchBook: vi.fn(async () => book({ bids: options.bids })),
      fetchSellableShares: vi.fn(async () => options.sellableShares ?? 40),
      fetchMarketState: vi.fn(async () => options.market ?? OPEN_MARKET),
      submitRungFor: vi.fn(() => submitRung),
      emitAlert: vi.fn(async (alert: PolymarketExitAlert) => { alerts.push(alert); }),
      requestRedemption: vi.fn(async (redeem: PolymarketExitRedeem) => { redemptions.push(redeem); }),
      now: () => NOW,
      log: () => {}
    }
  };
}

describe('runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep — the call site of the ladder', () => {
  it('advances a rung for an unfilled sell and terminates in an alert, not in more rungs', async () => {
    const h = harness();

    const result = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);

    // Rung advanced: one rung per ladder step, each strictly cheaper than the
    // last, on the 0.01 tick grid, measured down from the 0.59 reference.
    expect(h.submitted.map((rung) => rung.price)).toEqual([0.58, 0.56, 0.53]);
    expect(h.submitted.map((rung) => rung.attempt)).toEqual([0, 1, 2]);
    expect(h.submitted.map((rung) => rung.rungBps)).toEqual([...POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS]);

    // And it stopped. The ladder alerted once instead of escalating forever.
    expect(h.submitRung).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS.length);
    expect(h.alerts).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(h.alerts[0]!.code).toBe('exit-escalation-exhausted');
    expect(h.alerts[0]!.severity).toBe('critical');
    expect(h.alerts[0]!.remainingShares).toBe(40);
    expect(h.ports.emitAlert).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(h.ports.emitAlert.mock.calls[0]![1].id).toBe('trade-1');

    expect(result).toMatchObject({
      scanned: 1, escalated: 1, alerted: 1, redeemed: 0, failed: 0, skipped: 0
    });
    expect(result.outcomes[0]!.outcome.terminal).toBe('alert');
    expect(result.outcomes[0]!.outcome.rungsSubmitted).toBe(3);
  });

  it('re-observes between rungs, so a rung that fills the position ends the ladder', async () => {
    // The sweep observes once to build the ladder's input, then the driver
    // re-observes after each rung: 40 held, rung fills it, 0 left.
    const shares = [40, 0];
    const h = harness({ fillPerRung: 40 });
    h.ports.fetchSellableShares = vi.fn(async () => shares.shift() ?? 0);

    const result = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);

    expect(h.submitted).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(h.alerts).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ escalated: 1, completed: 1, alerted: 0 });
    expect(result.outcomes[0]!.outcome.terminal).toBe('complete');
    expect(result.outcomes[0]!.outcome.filledShares).toBe(40);
  });

  it('does not walk the same exit twice, so a later pass cannot re-alert it', async () => {
    const h = harness();

    const first = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);
    const second = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);

    expect(first.alerted).toBe(1);
    expect(second).toMatchObject({ scanned: 1, escalated: 0, alerted: 0, skipped: 1 });
    expect(second.skips[0]!.reason).toContain('already walked a ladder');
    // Still three rungs total across both passes, not six.
    expect(h.submitRung).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
    expect(h.alerts).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('routes a market that stopped accepting orders to redemption instead of a rung', async () => {
    const h = harness({
      market: { ...OPEN_MARKET, acceptingOrders: false, closed: true, resolutionStatus: 'resolved' }
    });

    const result = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);

    expect(h.submitted).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(h.alerts).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(h.redemptions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(h.redemptions[0]!.conditionId).toBe(CONDITION_ID);
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ escalated: 0, redeemed: 1, alerted: 0 });
  });

  it('alerts rather than escalating when there is no bid to escalate into', async () => {
    const h = harness({ bids: [] });

    const result = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);

    expect(h.submitted).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(h.alerts[0]!.code).toBe('no-bid-liquidity');
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ escalated: 0, alerted: 1 });

    setPolymarketLiveReadiness(false, 'uncertified in this environment');
    const h = harness();

    const result = await runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep(h.ports);

    expect(h.ports.loadCandidates).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(h.submitRung).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ scanned: 0, escalated: 0, alerted: 0 });
  });

      candidates: [candidate(), candidate({ id: 'trade-2', venue_order_id: 'order-fak-2' })]

    const h = harness({ candidates: [candidate({ status: 'cancelled', price_usd: null })] });

    expect(h.submitRung).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    expect(result.skips[0]!.reason).toContain('no confirmed fill');
    expect(result.skips[0]!.reason).toContain('signed mirror bound');
  });

    expect(resolvePolymarketExitReferencePrice({ id: 't', status: 'partial', price_usd: '0.59' }))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'reference', referencePrice: 0.59 });
  });

    expect(resolvePolymarketExitReferencePrice({ id: 't', status: 'partial', price_usd: '1.4' }))
      .toMatchObject({ kind: 'unavailable' });
    expect(resolvePolymarketExitReferencePrice({ id: 't', status: 'partial', price_usd: '0' }))
      .toMatchObject({ kind: 'unavailable' });
  });

  it('bounds how far back a failed exit stays escalatable', () => {
    expect(POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_MAX_AGE_MS).toBe(60 * 60 * 1000);
  });
});

describe('C1 — the sweep runs inside the existing guarded pass', () => {
  const source = readFileSync(new URL('./index.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8');

    expect(source.match(/setInterval\(/g)).toHaveLength(2);

    const guardStart = source.indexOf('const reconcilePending = async () => {');
    const guardEnd = source.indexOf('reconciliationRunning = false;', guardStart);
    expect(guardStart).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    expect(guardEnd).toBeGreaterThan(guardStart);
    const call = source.indexOf('runPolymarketExitEscalationSweep({');
    expect(call).toBeGreaterThan(guardStart);
    expect(call).toBeLessThan(guardEnd);
    // After the canonical coordinator, so a resting rung cannot delay the fast
    // per-venue sweeps.
    expect(call).toBeGreaterThan(source.indexOf('runReconciliationCoordinator({'));
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import {
  POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS,
  POLYMARKET_EXIT_RUNG_EFFECTIVE_MS,
  POLYMARKET_GTD_SECURITY_THRESHOLD_MS,
  escalatePolymarketExit,
  planPolymarketExitEscalation,
  polymarketGtdExpiration,
  type PolymarketExitAlert,
  type PolymarketExitLimitRung,
  type PolymarketExitRedeem
} from './polymarket-exit-escalation.js';

/**
 * `S4-M17` — an unfilled exit escalates, then alerts.
 *
 * The cases below are the branches that decide whether a user keeps holding a
 * position their master has left: each ladder bound, each terminal, and the
 * driver's guarantee that it alerts exactly once and never past a bound.
 */

const NOW = 1_700_000_000_000;

const OPEN_MARKET = {
  conditionId: `0x${'1'.repeat(64)}`,
  acceptingOrders: true,
  closed: false,
  resolutionStatus: 'unresolved'
};

const BASE = {
  attempt: 0,
  remainingShares: 50,
  minimumShares: 5,
  tickSize: 0.01,
  referencePrice: 0.59,
  bestBid: 0.58,
  minimumExitPrice: 0.01,
  market: OPEN_MARKET,
  now: NOW
};

function rung(step: ReturnType<typeof planPolymarketExitEscalation>): PolymarketExitLimitRung {
  expect(step.kind).toBe('limit');
  return step as PolymarketExitLimitRung;
}

describe('polymarket exit escalation ladder', () => {
  it('prices the first rung strictly below the bound that just failed', () => {
    // The reference is the bound of the failed FAK, not the master's raw fill, so
    // rung zero is a real concession rather than a re-offer of the same price.
    const step = rung(planPolymarketExitEscalation(BASE));
    expect(step.rungBps).toBe(POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS[0]);
    expect(step.price).toBe(0.58); // floor(0.59 × 0.985 = 0.58115)
    expect(step.price).toBeLessThan(BASE.referencePrice);
    expect(step.shares).toBe(50);
  });

  it('deepens each rung and never rises', () => {
    const prices = POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS.map(
      (_, attempt) => rung(planPolymarketExitEscalation({ ...BASE, attempt })).price
    );
    expect(prices).toEqual([0.58, 0.56, 0.53]);
    for (let index = 1; index < prices.length; index += 1) {
      expect(prices[index]!).toBeLessThan(prices[index - 1]!);
    }
  });

  it('floors each rung to the tick grid so the price is submittable', () => {
    for (const tickSize of [0.1, 0.01, 0.005, 0.0025, 0.001, 0.0001]) {
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS.length; attempt += 1) {
        const step = planPolymarketExitEscalation({ ...BASE, tickSize, attempt });
        if (step.kind !== 'limit') continue;
        const ticks = step.price / tickSize;
        expect(Math.abs(ticks - Math.round(ticks)), `tick ${tickSize} rung ${attempt}`)
          .toBeLessThan(1e-6);
        // Floored, so a rung never asks for more than the sanctioned concession.
        expect(step.price).toBeLessThanOrEqual(
          BASE.referencePrice * (1 - POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS[attempt]! / 10_000) + 1e-9
        );
      }
    }
  });

  it('sets a GTD expiration using the documented now + 60 + N formula', () => {
    const step = rung(planPolymarketExitEscalation(BASE));
    expect(step.effectiveLifetimeMs).toBe(POLYMARKET_EXIT_RUNG_EFFECTIVE_MS);
    expect(step.expiration).toBe(
      Math.floor((NOW + POLYMARKET_EXIT_RUNG_EFFECTIVE_MS + POLYMARKET_GTD_SECURITY_THRESHOLD_MS) / 1000)
    );
    // Documented venue floor: at least 3 minutes ahead, or the order is rejected.
    expect(step.expiration - NOW / 1000).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(180);
  });

  it('refuses a rung lifetime the venue would reject outright', () => {
    // Two minutes is the documented minimum effective lifetime. Silently raising a
    // shorter one would hide a misconfiguration behind a longer-resting order.
    expect(() => polymarketGtdExpiration(NOW, 119_000)).toThrow(/at least 3 minutes/);
    expect(polymarketGtdExpiration(NOW, 120_000)).toBe(Math.floor((NOW + 180_000) / 1000));
  });

  it('reports whether a rung should fill on arrival or rest', () => {
    expect(rung(planPolymarketExitEscalation({ ...BASE, bestBid: 0.58 })).crossesBook).toBe(true);
    expect(rung(planPolymarketExitEscalation({ ...BASE, bestBid: 0.5 })).crossesBook).toBe(false);
  });

  it('alerts rather than pricing below the operator exit floor', () => {
    // The floor is the line between "a stuck position" and "a realised loss we
    // chose for the user". Crossing it is a human's decision.
    const step = planPolymarketExitEscalation({
      ...BASE,
      referencePrice: 0.05,
      minimumExitPrice: 0.05,
      attempt: 0
    });
    expect(step).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'alert',
      code: 'exit-price-floor-reached',
      severity: 'critical'
    });
  });

  it('alerts when every rung has been tried and none filled', () => {
    const step = planPolymarketExitEscalation({
      ...BASE,
      attempt: POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS.length
    });
    expect(step).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'alert',
      code: 'exit-escalation-exhausted',
      severity: 'critical',
      remainingShares: 50
    });
  });

  it('routes a market that stopped accepting orders to redemption, not to a rung', () => {
    // No price fills once orders are refused, so escalating is pure latency, and
    // redemption has no deadline.
    for (const market of [
      { ...OPEN_MARKET, acceptingOrders: false },
      { ...OPEN_MARKET, closed: true },
      { ...OPEN_MARKET, resolutionStatus: 'proposed' }
    ]) {
      expect(planPolymarketExitEscalation({ ...BASE, market })).toMatchObject({
        kind: 'redeem',
        conditionId: OPEN_MARKET.conditionId
      });
    }
  });

  it('checks the redemption path before the ladder is exhausted', () => {
    // Ordering matters: a resolved market on the last rung must redeem rather than
    // page a human about an order that cannot exist.
    expect(planPolymarketExitEscalation({
      ...BASE,
      attempt: POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS.length,
      market: { ...OPEN_MARKET, closed: true }
    }).kind).toBe('redeem');
  });

  it('warns rather than pages on a residual the venue will not accept', () => {
    const step = planPolymarketExitEscalation({ ...BASE, remainingShares: 4.5 });
    expect(step).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'alert',
      code: 'residual-below-venue-minimum',
      severity: 'warning'
    });
  });

  it('pages when there is no bid to escalate into', () => {
    expect(planPolymarketExitEscalation({ ...BASE, bestBid: null })).toMatchObject({
      kind: 'alert',
      code: 'no-bid-liquidity',
      severity: 'critical'
    });
  });

  it('reports a fully exited position as complete', () => {
    expect(planPolymarketExitEscalation({ ...BASE, remainingShares: 0 }).kind).toBe('complete');
  });

  it('rejects a ladder that does not deepen', () => {
    expect(() => planPolymarketExitEscalation({ ...BASE, escalationBps: [150, 150] }))
      .toThrow(/increase strictly/);
    expect(() => planPolymarketExitEscalation({ ...BASE, escalationBps: [400, 150] }))
      .toThrow(/increase strictly/);
    expect(() => planPolymarketExitEscalation({ ...BASE, escalationBps: [0] }))
      .toThrow(/from 1 to 10000/);
  });
});

function ports(overrides: {
  fills?: number[];
  observations?: Array<Partial<Awaited<ReturnType<
    Parameters<typeof escalatePolymarketExit>[1]['observe']
  >>>>;
}) {
  const fills = overrides.fills ?? [];
  const submitted: PolymarketExitLimitRung[] = [];
  const alerts: PolymarketExitAlert[] = [];
  const redemptions: PolymarketExitRedeem[] = [];
  let observationIndex = 0;
  let remainingShares = 50;

  return {
    submitted,
    alerts,
    redemptions,
    ports: {
      submitRung: vi.fn(async (step: PolymarketExitLimitRung) => {
        submitted.push(step);
        const filledShares = fills[submitted.length - 1] ?? 0;
        remainingShares = Math.max(0, remainingShares - filledShares);
        return { filledShares };
      }),
      observe: vi.fn(async () => {
        const override = overrides.observations?.[observationIndex] ?? {};
        observationIndex += 1;
        return {
          remainingShares,
          bestBid: 0.58,
          minimumShares: 5,
          tickSize: 0.01,
          market: OPEN_MARKET,
          ...override
        };
      }),
      emitAlert: vi.fn(async (alert: PolymarketExitAlert) => { alerts.push(alert); }),
      requestRedemption: vi.fn(async (redeem: PolymarketExitRedeem) => { redemptions.push(redeem); }),
      now: () => NOW
    }
  };
}

const DRIVER_INPUT = {
  remainingShares: 50,
  minimumShares: 5,
  tickSize: 0.01,
  referencePrice: 0.59,
  bestBid: 0.58 as number | null,
  minimumExitPrice: 0.01,
  market: OPEN_MARKET
};

describe('polymarket exit escalation driver', () => {
  it('stops at the first rung that clears the position and raises no alert', () => {
    const harness = ports({ fills: [50] });
    return escalatePolymarketExit(DRIVER_INPUT, harness.ports).then((outcome) => {
      expect(outcome).toMatchObject({
        rungsSubmitted: 1,
        filledShares: 50,
        terminal: 'complete',
        alert: null
      });
      expect(harness.ports.emitAlert).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  it('walks every rung and alerts exactly once when none fill', async () => {
    const harness = ports({ fills: [0, 0, 0] });
    const outcome = await escalatePolymarketExit(DRIVER_INPUT, harness.ports);

    expect(outcome.rungsSubmitted).toBe(POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS.length);
    expect(outcome.terminal).toBe('alert');
    expect(outcome.alert?.code).toBe('exit-escalation-exhausted');
    // Once. An alert per rung would train an operator to ignore the channel.
    expect(harness.alerts).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(harness.submitted.map((step) => step.price)).toEqual([0.58, 0.56, 0.53]);
  });

  it('continues escalating after a partial fill and reports the total', async () => {
    const harness = ports({ fills: [20, 30] });
    const outcome = await escalatePolymarketExit(DRIVER_INPUT, harness.ports);

    expect(outcome.filledShares).toBe(50);
    expect(outcome.rungsSubmitted).toBe(2);
    expect(outcome.terminal).toBe('complete');
  });

  it('redeems instead of escalating when the market resolves mid-ladder', async () => {
    // A rung rests for two minutes, which is long enough for a market to stop
    // accepting orders. Escalating against the stale reading would price into a
    // market that no longer exists.
    const harness = ports({

    });

    expect(outcome.terminal).toBe('redeem');
    expect(outcome.rungsSubmitted).toBe(1);
    expect(harness.redemptions).toHaveLength(1);

  });

  it('advances rather than re-offering a price a coarse grid repeats', async () => {

    // would spend six minutes re-offering a price that already failed.
    const harness = ports({ fills: [0, 0, 0], observations: [{ tickSize: 0.1 }, { tickSize: 0.1 }] });

    expect(outcome.terminal).toBe('alert');
    expect(outcome.alert?.code).toBe('exit-escalation-exhausted');

  it('alerts without submitting anything when there is no bid', async () => {

      harness.ports
    );

==> apps/trade-executor/src/polymarket-exit-escalation.ts <==
import { UnrecoverableError } from 'bullmq';
import { floorToPolymarketTick } from './polymarket-mirror-bound.js';
import type { PolymarketMarketState } from './polymarket-market-state.js';

/**
 * Escalation ladder for a Polymarket exit that did not fill (checklist `S4-M17`).
 *
 * **Why exits get an escalation and entries do not.** A missed entry costs the
 * user an opportunity. A missed *exit* leaves them holding a position their
 * master has already left — long exposure nobody chose, on an outcome that is
 * about to become worth 1 or 0. So the FAK-only rule from `S4-M16` is an *entry*
 * rule. An exit that must complete is allowed to rest, and this module is the
 * bounded way it does so.
 *
 * **The ladder.** Rung zero is the original FAK submitted by `triggerPolymarket`.
 * Each escalation rung after that is a **GTD limit** priced progressively further
 * below the reference — the price the master exited at — so each attempt gives up
 * a little more to get out. Verified against `trading/place-orders`:
 *
 *   * A limit order "can rest on the book until it fills, expires, or you cancel
 *     it", and GTD "remains active until the expiration time you specify".
 *   * "GTD orders expire one minute before their stated expiration as a security
 *     threshold. To set an effective lifetime of N seconds, use `now + 60 + N`.
 *     In addition, the expiration must be at least **3 minutes** in the future —
 *     orders expiring sooner are rejected — so the minimum effective lifetime is
 *     about two minutes."
 *   * "The price must follow the market's minimum price increment" — so every rung
 *     price is placed on the tick grid.
 *
 * **Which way rungs round, and why it differs from `S4-M16`.** An entry bound
 * rounds so it can only tighten, because there the grid must never re-price what
 * the user was quoted. A rung rounds *down*, because a rung exists to fill and
 * rounding up concedes nothing — on a 0.01 grid a 150 bps rung off 0.59 would
 * round back to 0.59 and re-submit the price that just failed. The overshoot is
 * at most one tick and the whole ladder is floored by `POLYMARKET_MIN_EXIT_PRICE`,
 * so the concession stays bounded by an operator-set number rather than by
 * arithmetic.
 *
 * **What `referencePrice` is.** The price the attempt that just failed was
 * bounded at — the `S4-M16` mirror bound for the first escalation. Not the
 * master's raw fill: rungs measured from a price we never actually offered would
 * spend their first step re-offering it.
 *
 * GTD rather than GTC deliberately: a GTC exit that never fills is the original
 * problem with extra steps, and it would still be resting when the market
 * resolves. Each rung dies on its own.
 *
 * **Why it terminates in an alert rather than in a deeper price.** Two floors
 * bound the ladder, and hitting either is a human's decision, not ours:
 *
 *   * `POLYMARKET_MIN_EXIT_PRICE` — dumping below the operator's configured floor
 *     to "complete" an exit converts a stuck position into a realised loss.
 *   * ladder exhaustion — three rungs that all failed to fill is a liquidity
 *     fact, and the next lever (redeem, hold, or manual unwind) is a judgement.
 *
 * **Why a resolving market short-circuits to redemption.** Once the market stops
 * accepting orders no price fills, so escalating is pure latency. Redemption is
 * the exit (`S4-M19`), and it has no deadline, so routing there is strictly
 * better than alerting a human about an order that cannot exist.
 *
 * Pure planner plus a driver whose every port is injected (Standing Rule 2), so
 * the ladder can be tested without a venue and the signer stays a parameter.
 */

/** Basis points below the reference price for each escalation rung, in order. */
export const POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS: readonly number[] = [150, 400, 900];

/**
 * Effective resting life of each escalation rung.
 *
 * Two minutes is the documented minimum effective lifetime (a 3-minute
 * expiration less the venue's 1-minute security threshold). Chosen as the
 * minimum on purpose: a rung that rests longer than the next rung's price would
 * have been sensible is just a slower ladder.
 */
export const POLYMARKET_EXIT_RUNG_EFFECTIVE_MS = 120_000;

/** The venue's floor on how far ahead a GTD expiration may be set. */
export const POLYMARKET_GTD_MINIMUM_HORIZON_MS = 180_000;
/** The venue expires a GTD order this long before its stated expiration. */
export const POLYMARKET_GTD_SECURITY_THRESHOLD_MS = 60_000;

export type PolymarketExitAlertCode =
  /** Every rung was submitted and none filled. */
  | 'exit-escalation-exhausted'
  /** The next rung would price below the operator's configured exit floor. */
  | 'exit-price-floor-reached'
  /** What is left is too small for the venue to accept, so it cannot be sold. */
  | 'residual-below-venue-minimum'
  /** There is no bid at all; nothing to escalate into. */
  | 'no-bid-liquidity';

export interface PolymarketExitLimitRung {
  readonly kind: 'limit';
  /** Zero-based escalation attempt this rung represents. */
  readonly attempt: number;
  readonly rungBps: number;
  /** On the market's tick grid, floored to it so the rung actually concedes. */
  readonly price: number;
  readonly shares: number;
  /** Unix seconds, already including the venue's 1-minute security threshold. */
  readonly expiration: number;
  /** How long the rung actually rests before the venue kills it. */
  readonly effectiveLifetimeMs: number;
  /** True when the rung is at or below the best bid and should fill on arrival. */
  readonly crossesBook: boolean;
}

export interface PolymarketExitRedeem {
  readonly kind: 'redeem';
  readonly conditionId: string;
  readonly reason: string;
}

export interface PolymarketExitAlert {
  readonly kind: 'alert';
  readonly code: PolymarketExitAlertCode;
  readonly severity: 'warning' | 'critical';
  readonly reason: string;
  readonly remainingShares: number;
}

export interface PolymarketExitComplete {
  readonly kind: 'complete';
}

export type PolymarketExitStep =
  | PolymarketExitLimitRung
  | PolymarketExitRedeem
  | PolymarketExitAlert
  | PolymarketExitComplete;

export interface PolymarketExitEscalationInput {
  /** Escalation attempts already made. 0 means the FAK has failed and nothing else has run. */
  readonly attempt: number;
  readonly remainingShares: number;
  /** `min_order_size` from the order book — a share count, not a notional. */
  readonly minimumShares: number;
  readonly tickSize: number;
  /** Price the last unfilled attempt was bounded at; rungs measure down from it. */
  readonly referencePrice: number;
  /** Current best bid, or null when the bid side is empty. */
  readonly bestBid: number | null;
  /** `POLYMARKET_MIN_EXIT_PRICE`; the ladder never prices below it. */
  readonly minimumExitPrice: number;
  readonly market: Pick<
    PolymarketMarketState,
    'conditionId' | 'acceptingOrders' | 'closed' | 'resolutionStatus'
  >;
  readonly now: number;
  readonly escalationBps?: readonly number[];
  readonly rungEffectiveMs?: number;
}

/**
 * Convert an effective resting lifetime into the `expiration` the venue wants.
 *
 * The documented formula is `now + 60 + N`. Refusing anything under the
 * documented 3-minute horizon rather than silently raising it, because a rejected
 * order on an exit ladder costs a rung.
 */
export function polymarketGtdExpiration(now: number, effectiveMs: number): number {
  const horizonMs = effectiveMs + POLYMARKET_GTD_SECURITY_THRESHOLD_MS;
  if (!Number.isFinite(effectiveMs) || horizonMs < POLYMARKET_GTD_MINIMUM_HORIZON_MS) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(
      'Polymarket GTD expiration must be at least 3 minutes ahead, so the effective lifetime must be at least 120000ms'
    );
  }
  return Math.floor((now + horizonMs) / 1000);
}

export function planPolymarketExitEscalation(
  input: PolymarketExitEscalationInput
): PolymarketExitStep {
  const ladder = input.escalationBps ?? POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS;
  if (!Number.isInteger(input.attempt) || input.attempt < 0) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket exit escalation attempt must be a non-negative integer');
  }
  // A ladder that does not deepen is not an escalation, and a non-integer or
  // out-of-range rung would produce a price nobody chose. Both are operator
  // configuration errors, so they raise rather than skip.
  for (const [index, rungBps] of ladder.entries()) {
    if (!Number.isInteger(rungBps) || rungBps <= 0 || rungBps > 10_000) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError(
        `Polymarket exit escalation rung ${rungBps} must be an integer from 1 to 10000 basis points`
      );
    }
    if (index > 0 && rungBps <= ladder[index - 1]!) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError(
        'Polymarket exit escalation rungs must increase strictly; a flat ladder re-offers a price that already failed'
      );
    }
  }
  if (
    !Number.isFinite(input.referencePrice)
    || input.referencePrice <= 0
    || input.referencePrice >= 1
  ) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(
      `Polymarket exit reference price ${input.referencePrice} is not a valid outcome price`
    );
  }
  if (
    !Number.isFinite(input.minimumExitPrice)
    || input.minimumExitPrice <= 0
    || input.minimumExitPrice >= 1
  ) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('POLYMARKET_MIN_EXIT_PRICE must be between 0 and 1 exclusive');
  }

  if (!Number.isFinite(input.remainingShares) || input.remainingShares <= 1e-9) {
    return { kind: 'complete' };
  }

  // Checked before anything price-shaped: once the market stops taking orders no
  // rung can fill, and redemption has no deadline, so this is the exit.
  if (input.market.closed
    || !input.market.acceptingOrders
    || input.market.resolutionStatus !== 'unresolved') {
    return {
      kind: 'redeem',
      conditionId: input.market.conditionId,
      reason: `market ${input.market.conditionId} is no longer accepting orders (closed=${input.market.closed}, resolution=${input.market.resolutionStatus}); the remaining ${input.remainingShares} shares exit by redemption`
    };
  }

  if (input.remainingShares + 1e-9 < input.minimumShares) {
    return {
      kind: 'alert',
      code: 'residual-below-venue-minimum',
      // Not critical: the position is dust the venue will not accept in either
      // direction, and it redeems for its true value at resolution anyway.
      severity: 'warning',
      reason: `${input.remainingShares} shares remain, below the venue's ${input.minimumShares}-share minimum, so the residual cannot be sold and will settle at resolution`,
      remainingShares: input.remainingShares
    };
  }

  if (input.bestBid === null) {
    return {
      kind: 'alert',
      code: 'no-bid-liquidity',
      severity: 'critical',
      reason: `no bids exist for this outcome, so ${input.remainingShares} shares cannot be exited at any price`,
      remainingShares: input.remainingShares
    };
  }

  if (input.attempt >= ladder.length) {
    return {
      kind: 'alert',
      code: 'exit-escalation-exhausted',
      severity: 'critical',
      reason: `all ${ladder.length} escalation rungs (${ladder.join('/')} bps below ${input.referencePrice}) failed to fill; ${input.remainingShares} shares are still held`,
      remainingShares: input.remainingShares
    };
  }

  const rungBps = ladder[input.attempt]!;
  const price = floorToPolymarketTick(
    input.referencePrice * (1 - rungBps / 10_000),
    input.tickSize
  );

  if (price <= 0 || price < input.minimumExitPrice - 1e-9) {
    return {
      kind: 'alert',
      code: 'exit-price-floor-reached',
      severity: 'critical',
      reason: `the next escalation rung would price at ${price}, below the ${input.minimumExitPrice} exit floor; selling under the floor to force a fill is not a decision this executor makes`,
      remainingShares: input.remainingShares
    };
  }

  const rungEffectiveMs = input.rungEffectiveMs ?? POLYMARKET_EXIT_RUNG_EFFECTIVE_MS;
  return {
    kind: 'limit',
    attempt: input.attempt,
    rungBps,
    price,
    shares: input.remainingShares,
    expiration: polymarketGtdExpiration(input.now, rungEffectiveMs),
    effectiveLifetimeMs: rungEffectiveMs,
    crossesBook: price <= input.bestBid + 1e-9
  };
}

export interface PolymarketExitEscalationPorts {
  /** Submit one GTD limit rung and report how many shares it filled. */
  readonly submitRung: (rung: PolymarketExitLimitRung) => Promise<{ filledShares: number }>;
  /** Re-read the live inputs between rungs; the book and the market both move. */
  readonly observe: () => Promise<{
    remainingShares: number;
    bestBid: number | null;
    minimumShares: number;
    tickSize: number;
    market: PolymarketExitEscalationInput['market'];
  }>;
  readonly emitAlert: (alert: PolymarketExitAlert) => Promise<void>;
  /** Hand a resolved market to the redemption sweep instead of escalating. */
  readonly requestRedemption: (redeem: PolymarketExitRedeem) => Promise<void>;
  readonly now?: () => number;
  readonly log?: (message: string) => void;
}

export interface PolymarketExitEscalationOutcome {
  readonly rungsSubmitted: number;
  readonly filledShares: number;
  readonly remainingShares: number;
  readonly terminal: 'complete' | 'redeem' | 'alert';
  readonly alert: PolymarketExitAlert | null;
  readonly redeem: PolymarketExitRedeem | null;
}

/**
 * Walk the ladder until the position is out, the market resolves, or a bound is
 * hit.
 *
 * The loop re-observes between rungs rather than trusting the snapshot it started
 * with: a two-minute rung is long enough for the book to empty or the market to
 * stop accepting orders, and escalating against a stale reading is how an exit
 * ends up priced into a market that no longer exists.
 */
export async function escalatePolymarketExit(
  input: Omit<PolymarketExitEscalationInput, 'attempt' | 'now'>,
  ports: PolymarketExitEscalationPorts
): Promise<PolymarketExitEscalationOutcome> {
  const now = ports.now ?? Date.now;
  const log = ports.log ?? (() => {});
  const ladderLength = (input.escalationBps ?? POLYMARKET_EXIT_ESCALATION_BPS).length;

  let observed = {
    remainingShares: input.remainingShares,
    bestBid: input.bestBid,
    minimumShares: input.minimumShares,
    tickSize: input.tickSize,
    market: input.market
  };
  let filledShares = 0;
  let rungsSubmitted = 0;
  let lastRungPrice: number | null = null;

  // Bounded by the ladder length plus one, so the terminal step is always
  // reached from a decision rather than from running out of iterations.
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= ladderLength; attempt += 1) {
    const step = planPolymarketExitEscalation({
      ...input,
      ...observed,
      attempt,
      now: now()
    });

    if (step.kind === 'complete') {
      return {
        rungsSubmitted,
        filledShares,
        remainingShares: observed.remainingShares,
        terminal: 'complete',
        alert: null,
        redeem: null
      };
    }
    if (step.kind === 'redeem') {
      await ports.requestRedemption(step);
      log(`[polymarket-exit] ${step.reason}`);
      return {
        rungsSubmitted,
        filledShares,
        remainingShares: observed.remainingShares,
        terminal: 'redeem',
        alert: null,
        redeem: step
      };
    }
    if (step.kind === 'alert') {
      await ports.emitAlert(step);
      log(`[polymarket-exit] ${step.code}: ${step.reason}`);
      return {
        rungsSubmitted,
        filledShares,
        remainingShares: observed.remainingShares,
        terminal: 'alert',
        alert: step,
        redeem: null
      };
    }

    // A coarse tick grid can collapse two rungs onto the same price. Re-offering
    // a price that already failed to fill would burn a rung and two minutes for
    // nothing, so the ladder advances instead of submitting it again.
    if (lastRungPrice !== null && step.price >= lastRungPrice - 1e-9) {
      log(
        `[polymarket-exit] rung ${step.attempt} at ${step.price} repeats the previous rung `
        + `on a ${observed.tickSize} tick grid; advancing`
      );
      continue;
    }

    const { filledShares: rungFill } = await ports.submitRung(step);
    lastRungPrice = step.price;
    rungsSubmitted += 1;
    filledShares += Math.max(0, rungFill);
    log(
      `[polymarket-exit] rung ${step.attempt} at ${step.price} (${step.rungBps} bps) `
      + `filled ${rungFill} of ${step.shares}`
    );
    observed = await ports.observe();
  }

  // Unreachable: the loop runs `ladderLength + 1` times and the final pass always
  // exhausts the ladder into an alert. Present so the contract is total rather
  // than relying on a reader to verify the bound.
  throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket exit escalation ended without a terminal decision');
}

==> apps/trade-executor/src/polymarket-exit-race.test.ts <==
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import {
  aggregatePolymarketExposure,
  claimPolymarketExit,
  claimPolymarketManualExit,
  claimPolymarketMirroredSellExit,
  decidePolymarketExit,
  mapPolymarketRedemptionToPositions,
  type PolymarketExposureLeg
} from './polymarket-exit-race.js';
import {
  assertPolymarketPositionsDistinct,
  type PolymarketOutcomePosition
} from './polymarket-representation.js';

/**
 * `S4-M19` — redemption as a first-class exit, raced against the mirrored sell.
 *
 * The decision functions here are pure. The claim-with-a-database tests are in
 * the sweep test (`polymarket-redemption.test.ts`) and the db test
 * (`polymarket-exit-queries.test.ts`), because this module owns the *decision* —
 * which trigger fires, and what the fan-out must not collapse — not the I/O.
 */

const CONDITION = `0x${'a'.repeat(64)}`;

function position(
  overrides: Partial<PolymarketOutcomePosition> = {}
): PolymarketOutcomePosition {
  return {
    conditionId: CONDITION,
    tokenId: '1001',
    outcomeIndex: 0,
    outcome: 'Yes',
    negRisk: false,
    ...overrides
  };
}

describe('decidePolymarketExit', () => {
  const base = {
    position: position(),
    heldShares: 40,
    masterHoldsPosition: true,
    marketResolved: false,
    acceptingOrders: true,
    // Added when `S4-M45` made manual exit the third entrant. Required rather
    // than optional on `PolymarketExitRaceInput`, so every existing case has to
    // state that no manual exit was requested -- which is what keeps the
    // two-entrant behaviour below asserted as *itself* rather than as a default.
    manualExitRequested: false,
    existingClaim: null
  } as const;

  it('holds when neither trigger has fired', () => {
    expect(decidePolymarketExit(base).kind).toBe('hold');
  });

  it('holds on zero held shares, whatever the trigger state', () => {
    expect(decidePolymarketExit({ ...base, heldShares: 0 }).kind).toBe('hold');
    expect(decidePolymarketExit({ ...base, heldShares: 0, marketResolved: true }).kind).toBe('hold');
  });

  it('exits by redemption once the market resolves', () => {
    const decision = decidePolymarketExit({ ...base, marketResolved: true });
    expect(decision).toMatchObject({ kind: 'exit', trigger: 'redemption' });
  });

  it('exits by redemption when the market stops accepting orders', () => {
    const decision = decidePolymarketExit({ ...base, acceptingOrders: false });
    expect(decision).toMatchObject({ kind: 'exit', trigger: 'redemption' });
  });

  it('resolution outranks a mirrored sell when both look true', () => {
    // A resolved market stops accepting orders, so a sell into it cannot fill at
    // any price. Redemption is then the only exit.
    const decision = decidePolymarketExit({
      ...base,
      marketResolved: true,
      masterHoldsPosition: false
    });
    expect(decision).toMatchObject({ kind: 'exit', trigger: 'redemption' });
  });

  it('exits by mirrored sell when the master has closed and the market is open', () => {
    const decision = decidePolymarketExit({ ...base, masterHoldsPosition: false });
    expect(decision).toMatchObject({ kind: 'exit', trigger: 'mirrored-sell' });
  });

  it('does not treat an unread master cross-reference as a close', () => {
    // Ignorance is not a trigger. `null` means we have not read the master's
    // holdings; treating that as "they closed" would exit on missing data.
    const decision = decidePolymarketExit({ ...base, masterHoldsPosition: null });
    expect(decision.kind).toBe('hold');
  });

  it('the single-shot guard makes the second trigger stand down', () => {
    const decision = decidePolymarketExit({
      ...base,
      marketResolved: true,
      existingClaim: { trigger: 'mirrored-sell', status: 'claimed' }
    });
    expect(decision).toMatchObject({ kind: 'already-exiting', trigger: 'mirrored-sell' });
  });

  it('a failed claim is NOT a winner — the race must be retryable', () => {
    // A failed claim must not hold the position hostage: redemption has no
    // deadline, so a market that failed today is still exitable tomorrow. The
    // trigger still has to be live, though — a failed claim is the *absence* of a
    // winner, not a trigger of its own, which is why the market is resolved here.
    const decision = decidePolymarketExit({
      ...base,
      marketResolved: true,
      existingClaim: { trigger: 'redemption', status: 'failed' }
    });
    expect(decision).toMatchObject({ kind: 'exit', trigger: 'redemption' });
  });

  it('a failed claim does not by itself become a trigger', () => {
    // The other half of the previous test, and the one that would go unnoticed:
    // clearing the claim must not exit a position whose market is open and whose
    // master still holds it. Retryable is not the same as due.
    const decision = decidePolymarketExit({
      ...base,
      existingClaim: { trigger: 'redemption', status: 'failed' }
    });
    expect(decision.kind).toBe('hold');
  });

  it('two outcomes of one condition are two positions, not one', () => {
    const yes = decidePolymarketExit({ ...base, position: position({ tokenId: '1001', outcome: 'Yes' }), marketResolved: true });
    const no = decidePolymarketExit({ ...base, position: position({ tokenId: '1002', outcome: 'No' }), marketResolved: true });
    // Each gets its own exit; neither is suppressed by the other's claim. Asserted
    // through the discriminant rather than by reading `.trigger` off the union: a
    // 'hold' has no trigger, so `decision.trigger` does not typecheck and would
    // read `undefined === 'redemption'` if it did.
    expect(yes).toMatchObject({ kind: 'exit', trigger: 'redemption' });
    expect(no).toMatchObject({ kind: 'exit', trigger: 'redemption' });
  });
});

describe('mapPolymarketRedemptionToPositions', () => {
  it('parses each outcome row and returns one position per outcome token', () => {
    const mapped = mapPolymarketRedemptionToPositions(CONDITION, [
      { conditionId: CONDITION, tokenId: '1001', outcome: 'Yes', outcomeIndex: 0 },
      { conditionId: CONDITION, tokenId: '1002', outcome: 'No', outcomeIndex: 1 }
    ]);
    expect(mapped.map((m) => m.positionKey)).toEqual(['polygon:1001', 'polygon:1002']);
  });

  it('refuses an empty fan-out — a redemption with no position cannot be attributed', () => {
    expect(() => mapPolymarketRedemptionToPositions(CONDITION, [])).toThrow(/maps to no held position/);
  });

  it('refuses a position from a different condition', () => {
    expect(() => mapPolymarketRedemptionToPositions(CONDITION, [
      { conditionId: `0x${'b'.repeat(64)}`, tokenId: '1001', outcome: 'Yes', outcomeIndex: 0 }
    ])).toThrow(/handed a position on condition/);
  });

  it('holding both outcomes of one condition is legitimate and fans out to two', () => {
    // The distinction `S4-M20` turns on, and the one that makes the guard easy to
    // misuse: a condition-scoped redemption legitimately covers YES *and* NO, so
    // the fan-out must not throw on that set. What it must not do is return one
    // row for it.
    const mapped = mapPolymarketRedemptionToPositions(CONDITION, [
      { conditionId: CONDITION, tokenId: '1001', outcome: 'Yes', outcomeIndex: 0 },
      { conditionId: CONDITION, tokenId: '1002', outcome: 'No', outcomeIndex: 1 }
    ]);
    expect(mapped).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(mapped.map((m) => m.position.outcome)).toEqual(['Yes', 'No']);
  });

  it('the guard itself refuses the collapsed set the fan-out must never build', () => {
    // The previous test proves the ordinary case is allowed through; this one
    // proves the guard is not decoration. `mapPolymarketRedemptionToPositions`
    // applies it to each group that is about to become *one* position, so the only
    // way YES and NO reach it together is a position key re-derived from the
    // condition id — the mistake the item names. Asserted against the guard
    // directly, because inside `map` that group cannot be constructed without
    // changing `polymarketPositionKey`, and a test that only calls `map` would
    // therefore pass with the guard deleted. Verified by mutation the other way
    // round: keying `polymarketPositionKey` on `conditionId` makes the fan-out
    // throw this message instead of silently returning one row.
    //
    // The guard's reach, stated so it is not over-read: `isSamePolymarketPosition`
    // compares token ids only, so two rows carrying the *same* token id with
    // different outcome labels read as one position seen twice and pass. That is
    // its documented contract — contradictory labels for one token id are an
    // upstream data fault, not the condition-level collapse this refuses.
    expect(() => assertPolymarketPositionsDistinct([
      { conditionId: CONDITION, tokenId: '1001', outcomeIndex: 0, outcome: 'Yes', negRisk: false },
      { conditionId: CONDITION, tokenId: '1002', outcomeIndex: 1, outcome: 'No', negRisk: false }
    ])).toThrow(/distinct outcomes are distinct positions/);
  });
});

describe('aggregatePolymarketExposure', () => {
  const leg = (tokenId: string, shares: number, outcome: string): PolymarketExposureLeg => ({
    position: position({ tokenId, outcome }),
    positionKey: `polygon:${tokenId}`,
    shares
  });

  it('keeps YES and NO of one condition as separate legs', () => {
    const aggregate = aggregatePolymarketExposure([
      leg('1001', 10, 'Yes'),
      leg('1002', 10, 'No')
    ]);
    expect(aggregate.legs.map((l) => l.positionKey)).toEqual(['polygon:1001', 'polygon:1002']);
    expect(aggregate.totalShares).toBe(20);
  });

  it('never nets a YES against a NO', () => {
    // Netting them would report 0 exposure. It is not 0: reaching collateral
    // from the pair needs mergePositions, an on-chain call this executor makes
    // never. Nothing is subtracted.
    const aggregate = aggregatePolymarketExposure([
      leg('1001', 10, 'Yes'),
      leg('1002', 10, 'No')
    ]);
    expect(aggregate.totalShares).toBe(20);
  });

  it('sums duplicate views of the same outcome token', () => {
    const aggregate = aggregatePolymarketExposure([
      leg('1001', 10, 'Yes'),
      leg('1001', 5, 'Yes')
    ]);
    expect(aggregate.legs).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(aggregate.totalShares).toBe(15);
  });

  it('refuses a negative share count', () => {
    expect(() => aggregatePolymarketExposure([leg('1001', -1, 'Yes')])).toThrow();
  });
});

    const result = await claimPolymarketMirroredSellExit(

      { claimPositionExit }
    );
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ kind: 'lost' });
  });
