export function parseBooleanEnvironment(
  value: string | undefined,
  name: string,
  fallback = false
): boolean {
  if (value === undefined || value.trim() === '') return fallback;
  if (value === 'true') return true;
  if (value === 'false') return false;
  throw new Error(`${name} must be exactly true or false`);
}

export function parseUsdUnits(value: string | undefined, name: string, fallback: string): bigint {
  const raw = value?.trim() || fallback;
  let units: ethers.BigNumber;
  try {
    units = ethers.utils.parseUnits(raw, 6);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be a non-negative decimal with at most 6 places`);
  }
  if (units.lt(0)) throw new Error(`${name} cannot be negative`);
  return BigInt(units.toString());
}

export function parseFeeBufferBps(value: string | undefined): bigint {
  const parsed = Number(value?.trim() || '300');
  if (!Number.isInteger(parsed) || parsed < 0 || parsed > 5000) {
    throw new Error('POLYMARKET_FEE_BUFFER_BPS must be an integer between 0 and 5000');
  }
  return BigInt(parsed);
}

function parseOfficialOrigin(value: unknown, label: string): URL {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') {
    throw new Error(`${label} is missing from the pinned Polymarket SDK production environment`);
  }

  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(value);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`${label} is not a valid URL`);
  }
  if (
    url.protocol !== 'https:' ||
    url.hostname !== 'clob.polymarket.com' ||
    url.port !== '' ||
    url.username !== '' ||
    url.password !== '' ||
    url.pathname !== '/' ||
    url.search !== '' ||
    url.hash !== ''
  ) {
    throw new Error(`${label} is not the official production CLOB origin`);
  }
  return url;
}

function assertMatchingAddress(name: string, sdkAddress: unknown, expectedAddress: string): void {
  let actual: string;
  let expected: string;
  try {
    if (typeof sdkAddress !== 'string') throw new Error('missing');
    actual = ethers.utils.getAddress(sdkAddress);
    expected = ethers.utils.getAddress(expectedAddress);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`${name} has an invalid or missing address in the SDK production inventory`);
  }
  if (actual !== expected) {
    throw new Error(`${name} does not match the pinned SDK production address`);
  }
}

export function assertOfficialPolymarketContractConfig(
  sdkEnvironment: unknown = production,
  clobHost = POLYMARKET_CLOB_HOST
): void {
  if (typeof sdkEnvironment !== 'object' || sdkEnvironment === null) {
    throw new Error('Pinned Polymarket SDK production environment is unavailable');
  }
  const sdk = sdkEnvironment as Partial<SdkProductionRuntime>;
  if (sdk.name !== 'production' || sdk.chainId !== POLYGON_CHAIN_ID) {
    throw new Error('Pinned Polymarket SDK production environment is not Polygon 137');
  }

  parseOfficialOrigin(sdk.clob?.rest, 'SDK production CLOB endpoint');
  parseOfficialOrigin(clobHost, 'Executor CLOB endpoint');

  assertMatchingAddress(
    'CTF Exchange V2',
    sdk.contracts?.standardExchange,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.ctfExchange
  );
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Neg Risk CTF Exchange V2',
    sdk.contracts?.negRiskExchange,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.negRiskCtfExchange
  );
  assertMatchingAddress('pUSD', sdk.contracts?.collateralToken, POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.pUsd);
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Conditional Tokens',
    sdk.contracts?.conditionalTokens,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.conditionalTokens
  );
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Polymarket Proxy Factory',
    sdk.walletDerivation?.proxyFactory,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.proxyFactory
  );
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Polymarket Proxy implementation',
    sdk.walletDerivation?.proxyImplementation,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.proxyImplementation
  );
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Gnosis Safe Factory',
    sdk.walletDerivation?.safeFactory,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.safeFactory
  );
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Deposit Wallet Factory',
    sdk.walletDerivation?.depositWalletFactory,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.depositWalletFactory
  );
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Deposit Wallet Beacon',
    sdk.walletDerivation?.depositWalletBeacon,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.depositWalletBeacon
  );
  assertMatchingAddress(
    'Deposit Wallet implementation',
    sdk.walletDerivation?.depositWalletImplementation,
    POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.depositWalletImplementation
  );

  const normalizedAddresses = new Set<string>();
  for (const [name, address] of Object.entries(POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS)) {
    let normalized: string;
    try {
      normalized = ethers.utils.getAddress(address).toLowerCase();
    } catch {
      throw new Error(`${name} has an invalid address in the official contract inventory`);
    }
    if (normalizedAddresses.has(normalized)) {
      throw new Error(`${name} duplicates another address in the official contract inventory`);
    }
    normalizedAddresses.add(normalized);
  }
}

export function assertPolymarketContractBytecode(
  name: string,
  address: string,
  code: string
): void {
  const validHex = /^0x(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{2})+$/.test(code);
  const hasExecutableBytes = validHex && !/^0x(?:00)+$/i.test(code);
  if (!hasExecutableBytes) {
    throw new Error(`${name} has no deployed bytecode at ${address}`);
  }
}

async function attestDeployedContract(
  getCode: (address: string) => Promise<string>,
  name: string,
  address: string
): Promise<void> {
  const code = await getCode(address);
  assertPolymarketContractBytecode(name, address, code);
}

function accountWalletPathContracts(
  signatureTypeName: PolymarketClientInitialization['signatureTypeName']
): ReadonlyArray<readonly [string, string]> {
  switch (signatureTypeName) {
    case 'EOA':
      return [];
    case 'POLY_PROXY':
      return [
        ['Polymarket Proxy Factory', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.proxyFactory],
        ['Polymarket Proxy implementation', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.proxyImplementation]
      ];
    case 'POLY_GNOSIS_SAFE':
      return [['Gnosis Safe Factory', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.safeFactory]];
    case 'POLY_1271':
      return [
        ['Deposit Wallet Factory', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.depositWalletFactory],
        ['Deposit Wallet Beacon', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.depositWalletBeacon],
        ['Deposit Wallet implementation', POLYMARKET_CONTRACTS.depositWalletImplementation]
      ];
  }
}

async function attestAccountWalletPath(
  getCode: (address: string) => Promise<string>,
  identity: PolymarketClientInitialization
): Promise<void> {
  const signer = ethers.utils.getAddress(identity.signerAddress);
  const funder = ethers.utils.getAddress(identity.funderAddress);
  const funderCode = await getCode(funder);
  const funderHasCode = /^0x(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{2})+$/.test(funderCode) && !/^0x(?:00)+$/i.test(funderCode);

  if (identity.signatureTypeName === 'EOA') {
    if (!identity.directWalletWritesAllowed || signer !== funder) {
      throw new Error('EOA account wallet path does not resolve directly to the authenticated signer');
    }
    if (funderHasCode) {
      throw new Error('EOA signature mode resolved to a contract account wallet');
    }
    return;
  }

  if (identity.directWalletWritesAllowed) {
    throw new Error(`${identity.signatureTypeName} account wallet path cannot permit signer EOA writes`);
  }
  assertPolymarketContractBytecode('authenticated account wallet', funder, funderCode);
  await Promise.all(
    accountWalletPathContracts(identity.signatureTypeName).map(([name, address]) =>
      attestDeployedContract(getCode, name, address)
    )
  );
}

export function assertAuthenticatedCollateralBalance(
  authenticatedBalanceUsd: number,
  pUsdBalanceUnits: bigint,
  minimumPusdUnits: bigint
): void {
  if (!Number.isFinite(authenticatedBalanceUsd) || authenticatedBalanceUsd < 0) {
    throw new Error('Authenticated CLOB returned an invalid collateral balance');
  }
  const onchainBalanceUsd = Number(ethers.utils.formatUnits(pUsdBalanceUnits.toString(), 6));
  const minimumBalanceUsd = Number(ethers.utils.formatUnits(minimumPusdUnits.toString(), 6));
  if (!Number.isFinite(onchainBalanceUsd) || !Number.isFinite(minimumBalanceUsd)) {
    throw new Error('pUSD balance exceeds the supported startup attestation range');
  }
  if (authenticatedBalanceUsd + 0.0000001 < minimumBalanceUsd) {
    throw new Error('Authenticated CLOB collateral balance is below the configured live minimum');
  }
  if (authenticatedBalanceUsd > onchainBalanceUsd + 0.0000001) {
    throw new Error('Authenticated CLOB collateral balance exceeds the attested onchain pUSD balance');
  }
}

function defaultStartupDependencies(): PolymarketStartupDependencies {
  return {
    resolveMode: () => resolveChainMode('polygon'),
    getNetwork: () => polygonProvider.getNetwork(),
    getCode: (address) => polygonProvider.getCode(address),
    initializeClient: () => initializePolymarketClient(),
    createCollateralGateway: (directWalletWritesAllowed) =>
      new EthersPolymarketCollateralGateway(
        polygonProvider,
        directWalletWritesAllowed ? polymarketSigner : null
      ),
    getAuthenticatedCollateralBalance: () => getPolymarketAvailableBalance('', 'buy'),
    setLiveReadiness: setPolymarketLiveReadiness,
    sdkProduction: production,
    clobHost: POLYMARKET_CLOB_HOST,
    env: process.env
  };
}

export async function verifyPolymarketEnvironment(
  overrides: Partial<PolymarketStartupDependencies> = {}
): Promise<boolean> {
  const dependencies = { ...defaultStartupDependencies(), ...overrides };
  dependencies.setLiveReadiness(false, 'Polymarket startup verification is in progress');
  console.log('[trade-executor] Verifying Polymarket CLOB V2 environment...');

  try {
    const mode = await dependencies.resolveMode();
    if (mode.effectiveMode !== 'live' && mode.effectiveMode !== 'live+shadow') {
      dependencies.setLiveReadiness(
        false,
        mode.reason ?? 'Polygon is not configured for live execution'
      );
      return false;
    }

    const network = await dependencies.getNetwork();
    if (network.chainId !== POLYGON_CHAIN_ID) {
      throw new Error(`Expected Polygon chain ID ${POLYGON_CHAIN_ID}, got ${network.chainId}`);
    }
    assertOfficialPolymarketContractConfig(dependencies.sdkProduction, dependencies.clobHost);
    await Promise.all(
      CORE_ATTESTED_CONTRACTS.map(([name, address]) =>
        attestDeployedContract(dependencies.getCode, name, address)
      )
    );

    const identity = await dependencies.initializeClient();
    await attestAccountWalletPath(dependencies.getCode, identity);

    const minimumPusdUnits = parseUsdUnits(
      dependencies.env.POLYMARKET_MIN_PUSD_BALANCE_USD,
      'POLYMARKET_MIN_PUSD_BALANCE_USD',
      '1'
    );
    const baseAllowanceUnits = parseUsdUnits(
      dependencies.env.POLYMARKET_ALLOWANCE_CAP_USD ?? dependencies.env.MAX_POSITION_USDC,
      'POLYMARKET_ALLOWANCE_CAP_USD',
      '500'
    );
    const feeBufferBps = parseFeeBufferBps(dependencies.env.POLYMARKET_FEE_BUFFER_BPS);
    const allowanceCapUnits =
      (baseAllowanceUnits * (10_000n + feeBufferBps) + 9_999n) / 10_000n;

    const gateway = dependencies.createCollateralGateway(identity.directWalletWritesAllowed);
    const collateral = await ensurePolymarketCollateralReadiness(gateway, {
      funderAddress: identity.funderAddress,
      signerAddress: identity.signerAddress,
      accountWalletType: identity.signatureTypeName,
      directWalletWritesAllowed: identity.directWalletWritesAllowed,
      minimumPusdUnits,
      allowanceCapUnits,
      autoOnramp: parseBooleanEnvironment(
        dependencies.env.POLYMARKET_AUTO_ONRAMP,
        'POLYMARKET_AUTO_ONRAMP'
      ),
      autoApprove: parseBooleanEnvironment(
        dependencies.env.POLYMARKET_AUTO_APPROVE,
        'POLYMARKET_AUTO_APPROVE'
      )
    });

    const authenticatedBalanceUsd = await dependencies.getAuthenticatedCollateralBalance();
    assertAuthenticatedCollateralBalance(
      authenticatedBalanceUsd,
      collateral.pUsdBalanceUnits,
      minimumPusdUnits
    );

    for (const action of collateral.actions) {
      console.log(
        `[trade-executor] Polymarket collateral action confirmed: ${action.type} | ${action.transactionHash}`
      );
    }

    dependencies.setLiveReadiness(true);
    console.log(
      `[trade-executor] Polymarket CLOB V2 verified | chain=137 | sdk=${POLYMARKET_SDK_VERSION} | ` +
      `signer=${identity.signerAddress} | funder=${identity.funderAddress} | ` +
      `signatureType=${identity.signatureTypeName} | credentials=${identity.credentialSource} | ` +
      `builderAuth=${identity.builderAuthentication} | ` +
      `builderFees=${identity.builderMakerFeeBps}/${identity.builderTakerFeeBps}bps | ` +
      `builderAttribution=enabled`
    );
    return true;
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    dependencies.setLiveReadiness(false, message);
    console.error(
      `[trade-executor] CRITICAL: Polymarket verification failed: ${message}. Polygon is clamped to paper.`
    );
    throw new Error(`Polymarket verification failed: ${message}`);
  }
}

      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(orderBook({

      marketStateMocks.assertPolymarketMarketOpenForSubmission.mockRejectedValue(

      // expect.objectContaining, because `triggerPolymarket` also passes an injected
      // `now` so the tradability gate and the S4-M18 staleness budget read one
      // clock. Pinning the exact argument object made this assertion fail on a
      // change that added a field without altering what it claims to check.
      expect(marketStateMocks.assertPolymarketMarketOpenForSubmission).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({ conditionId: `0x${'1'.repeat(64)}` })
      );
      // Nothing may reach the venue once the gate refuses.
      expect(client.createMarketOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(client.postOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('checks market state only after the book passes its own bounds', async () => {
      // No point asking Gamma about a market whose book already failed.
      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(orderBook({
        tokenId: 'token-thin-gate',
        asks: [{ price: '0.50', size: '0.1' }]
      }));

      await expect(triggerPolymarket({
        signalId: 'sig-thin-gate',
        tokenID: 'token-thin-gate',
        spendAmountUsd: 500,
        direction: 'buy'
      })).rejects.toThrow();

      expect(marketStateMocks.assertPolymarketMarketOpenForSubmission).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  describe('simulatePolymarketBookFill', () => {
    // The simulator reads the same slippage bound the live path reads, so the
    // fixtures below have to stay inside it — that coupling is the point.
    beforeEach(() => {
      process.env.POLYMARKET_SLIPPAGE_BPS = '500';
    });

    // Scoped, not global: leaving it set would silently widen the bound for
    // every later describe in this file.
    afterEach(() => {
      delete process.env.POLYMARKET_SLIPPAGE_BPS;
    });

    it('prices a paper buy off walked depth, not the best level', async () => {
      // 10 shares at 0.50 then 10 at 0.52. $7.60 cannot clear at the best
      // level; taking 0.50 for the whole order would invent liquidity that is
      // not on the book and make paper look better than live ever could.
      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(orderBook({
        tokenId: 'token-paper-depth',
        asks: [
          { price: '0.52', size: '10' },
          { price: '0.50', size: '10' }
        ]
      }));

      const plan = await simulatePolymarketBookFill({
        tokenID: 'token-paper-depth',
        direction: 'buy',
        requestedAmount: 7.6
      });

      expect(plan.bestPrice).toBe(0.5);
      expect(plan.estimatedShares).toBe(15);
      expect(plan.estimatedNotionalUsd).toBeCloseTo(7.6);
      // 7.6 / 15 shares — strictly worse than the 0.50 best price.
      expect(plan.averagePrice).toBeCloseTo(0.50667, 5);
      expect(plan.averagePrice).toBeGreaterThan(plan.bestPrice);
    });

    it('agrees exactly with the live path for the same book and size', async () => {
      // Paper and live must not drift: both go through planPolymarketBookOrder.
      const book = orderBook({
        tokenId: 'token-parity',
        asks: [
          { price: '0.50', size: '4' },
          { price: '0.51', size: '30' }
        ]
      });
      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(book);

      const simulated = await simulatePolymarketBookFill({
        tokenID: 'token-parity',
        direction: 'buy',
        requestedAmount: 10
      });
      const live = planPolymarketBookOrder(book, 'buy', 10, 500);

      expect(simulated).toEqual(live);
    });

    it('refuses a book too thin for the requested paper size', async () => {
      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(orderBook({
        tokenId: 'token-paper-thin',
        asks: [{ price: '0.50', size: '1' }]
      }));

      await expect(simulatePolymarketBookFill({
        tokenID: 'token-paper-thin',
        direction: 'buy',
        requestedAmount: 50
      })).rejects.toThrow('too thin');
    });

    it('prices a paper sell from bid depth for the requested shares', async () => {
      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(orderBook({
        tokenId: 'token-paper-sell',
        bids: [
          { price: '0.40', size: '5' },
          { price: '0.38', size: '20' }
        ]
      }));

      const plan = await simulatePolymarketBookFill({
        tokenID: 'token-paper-sell',
        direction: 'sell',
        requestedAmount: 10
      });

      expect(plan.bestPrice).toBe(0.4);
      // 5 @ 0.40 + 5 @ 0.38 = 3.90 over 10 shares.
      expect(plan.estimatedNotionalUsd).toBeCloseTo(3.9);
      expect(plan.averagePrice).toBeCloseTo(0.39);
      expect(plan.averagePrice).toBeLessThan(plan.bestPrice);
    });
  });

  describe('triggerPolymarket', () => {
    it('refuses order submission when daily relayer capacity is exhausted (S4-P15)', async () => {
      const { globalPolymarketRelayerBudget } = await import('./polymarket-relayer-budget.js');
      polymarketActionMocks.fetchBalanceAllowance.mockResolvedValue({
        balance: '5000000',
        allowances: {}
      });
      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(orderBook({
        tokenId: 'token-relayer-test',
        asks: [{ price: '0.50', size: '100' }]
      }));

      globalPolymarketRelayerBudget.setUsedForTest(10_000);
      try {
        await expect(triggerPolymarket({
          signalId: 'sig-relayer-cap',
          tokenID: 'token-relayer-test',
          spendAmountUsd: 10,
          direction: 'buy'
        })).rejects.toThrow(/Polymarket daily relayer capacity exhausted/);
      } finally {
        globalPolymarketRelayerBudget.reset();
      }
    });

    it('refuses order submission when geo-eligibility is stale or unverified (S4-P16)', async () => {
      const eightDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 8 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
      await expect(triggerPolymarket({
        signalId: 'sig-geo-stale',
        tokenID: 'token-geo-test',
        spendAmountUsd: 10,
        direction: 'buy',
        geoVerifiedAt: eightDaysAgo
      })).rejects.toThrow(/polymarket-geo-eligibility-stale/);

      await expect(triggerPolymarket({
        signalId: 'sig-geo-null',
        tokenID: 'token-geo-test',
        spendAmountUsd: 10,
        direction: 'buy',
        geoVerifiedAt: null
      })).rejects.toThrow(/polymarket-geo-unverified/);
    });

    it('throws on honeypot bounds', async () => {
      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(orderBook({
        tokenId: 'token-999',
        asks: [{ price: '0.98', size: '1000' }]
      }));
      await expect(triggerPolymarket({
        signalId: 'sig-1',
        tokenID: 'token-999',
        spendAmountUsd: 100,
        direction: 'buy'
      })).rejects.toThrow('outside safe bounds');
    });

    it('reserves the fee buffer when sizing to available collateral', async () => {
      polymarketActionMocks.fetchBalanceAllowance.mockResolvedValue({
        balance: '5000000',
        allowances: {}
      });
      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(orderBook({
        tokenId: 'token-888',
        asks: [{ price: '0.50', size: '100' }]
      }));
      configureConfirmedFill({
        client,
        tokenId: 'token-888',
        price: '0.50',
        size: '9.70'
      });

      const result = await triggerPolymarket({
        signalId: 'sig-3',
        tokenID: 'token-888',
        spendAmountUsd: 100,
        direction: 'buy'
      });

      expect(client.createMarketOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
        amount: 4.854368,
        maxSpend: 4.854368,
        maxPrice: 0.5
      }));
      expect(result.requestedSpendAmountUsd).toBe(4.854368);
      expect(result.spendAmountUsd).toBe(4.85);
      expect(result.shares).toBe(9.7);
      expect(result.executionStatus).toBe('filled');
    });

    it('blocks a duplicate order for the same token', async () => {
      client.listOpenOrders.mockReturnValue(paginator([{ id: 'existing-order' }]));
      await expect(triggerPolymarket({
        signalId: 'sig-4',
        tokenID: 'token-777',
        spendAmountUsd: 50,
        direction: 'buy'
      })).rejects.toThrow('Open orders already exist');
    });

    it('uses the stable signal ID to block a previously persisted execution', async () => {
      const db = await import('@swat/db');
      vi.mocked(db.query).mockResolvedValueOnce([{
        venue_order_id: 'persisted-order',
        status: 'pending_confirmation'
      }] as never);

      await expect(triggerPolymarket({
        signalId: 'sig-retry',
        tokenID: 'token-retry',
        spendAmountUsd: 50,
        direction: 'buy'
      })).rejects.toThrow('already has an active execution');
      expect(client.listOpenOrders).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(client.postOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('attaches the builder code to the protected FAK order', async () => {
      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(orderBook({
        tokenId: 'token-555',
        asks: [{ price: '0.33', size: '1000' }]
      }));
      configureConfirmedFill({
        client,
        tokenId: 'token-555',
        orderId: 'poly-order-123',
        price: '0.33',
        size: '151.51'
      });

      const result = await triggerPolymarket({
        signalId: 'sig-2',
        tokenID: 'token-555',
        spendAmountUsd: 50,
        direction: 'buy'
      });

      expect(client.createMarketOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        tokenId: 'token-555',
        side: OrderSide.BUY,
        amount: 50,
        maxSpend: 50,
        maxPrice: 0.33,
        orderType: OrderType.FAK,
        builderCode: `0x${'a'.repeat(64)}`
      });
      expect(client.postOrder).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
      expect(result.orderId).toBe('poly-order-123');
      expect(result.settlementTransactionHashes).toEqual([`0x${'2'.repeat(64)}`]);
      expect(result.executionStatus).toBe('filled');
    });

    it('fails closed if the SDK omits the builder code from the signed order', async () => {
      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(orderBook({
        tokenId: 'token-builder',
        asks: [{ price: '0.50', size: '100' }]
      }));
      client.createMarketOrder.mockResolvedValue({ builder: `0x${'0'.repeat(64)}` });

      await expect(triggerPolymarket({
        signalId: 'sig-builder',
        tokenID: 'token-builder',
        spendAmountUsd: 10,
        direction: 'buy'
      })).rejects.toThrow('omitted the configured builder code');
      expect(client.postOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('caps sells to available outcome shares', async () => {
      polymarketActionMocks.fetchBalanceAllowance.mockResolvedValue({
        balance: '3250000',
        allowances: {}
      });
      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(orderBook({
        tokenId: 'token-sell',
        bids: [{ price: '0.50', size: '100' }]
      }));
      configureConfirmedFill({
        client,
        tokenId: 'token-sell',
        price: '0.50',
        size: '3.25'
      });

      const result = await triggerPolymarket({
        signalId: 'sig-sell',
        tokenID: 'token-sell',
        spendAmountUsd: 10,
        direction: 'sell',
        sellShares: 8
      });

      expect(polymarketActionMocks.fetchBalanceAllowance).toHaveBeenCalledWith(client, {
        assetType: AssetType.CONDITIONAL,
        tokenId: 'token-sell'
      });
      expect(client.createMarketOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
        shares: 3.25,
        minPrice: 0.5
      }));
      expect(result.shares).toBe(3.25);
    });

    it('returns pending confirmation without fabricating a fill for delayed orders', async () => {
      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(orderBook({
        tokenId: 'token-delayed',
        asks: [{ price: '0.50', size: '100' }]
      }));
      client.postOrder.mockResolvedValue({
        ok: true,
        orderId: 'delayed-order',
        status: 'delayed',
        makingAmount: '0',
        takingAmount: '0',
        transactionsHashes: [],
        tradeIds: []
      });

      const result = await triggerPolymarket({
        signalId: 'sig-delayed',
        tokenID: 'token-delayed',
        spendAmountUsd: 10,
        direction: 'buy'
      });

      expect(result.executionStatus).toBe('pending_confirmation');
      expect(result.spendAmountUsd).toBe(0);
      expect(result.shares).toBe(0);
    });

    it('persists confirmed partial quantities and fill-derived fees honestly', async () => {
      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(orderBook({
        tokenId: 'token-partial',
        asks: [{ price: '0.50', size: '100' }]
      }));
      configureConfirmedFill({
        client,
        tokenId: 'token-partial',
        price: '0.50',
        size: '10',
        feeRateBps: '1000'
      });

      const result = await triggerPolymarket({
        signalId: 'sig-partial',
        tokenID: 'token-partial',
        spendAmountUsd: 10,
        direction: 'buy'
      });

      expect(result.executionStatus).toBe('partial');
      expect(result.shares).toBe(10);
      expect(result.spendAmountUsd).toBe(5);
      expect(result.averagePrice).toBe(0.5);
      expect(result.feesUsd).toBeCloseTo(0.25);
    });

    it('keeps an accepted order pending when settlement lookup times out', async () => {
      client.fetchOrderBook.mockResolvedValue(orderBook({
        tokenId: 'token-timeout',
        asks: [{ price: '0.50', size: '100' }]
      }));
      client.postOrder.mockResolvedValue({
        ok: true,
        orderId: 'timeout-order',
        status: 'matched',
        makingAmount: '5',
        takingAmount: '10',
        transactionsHashes: [],
        tradeIds: ['timeout-trade']
      });
      client.waitForOrderFillSettlement.mockRejectedValue(new Error('timed out'));

      const result = await triggerPolymarket({
        signalId: 'sig-timeout',
        tokenID: 'token-timeout',
        spendAmountUsd: 5,
        direction: 'buy'
      });

      expect(result.executionStatus).toBe('pending_confirmation');
      expect(result.orderId).toBe('timeout-order');
      expect(result.shares).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  describe('delayed FAK reconciliation', () => {
    it('persists only confirmed partial fill evidence and terminalizes the FAK remainder', async () => {
      const db = await import('@swat/db');
      const row = pendingPolymarketTrade({
        tokenId: 'token-delayed-partial',
        orderId: 'delayed-partial',
        copyExecutionId: 'copy-delayed-partial'
      });
      vi.mocked(db.query)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([row] as never)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([{ id: row.id }] as never);
      client.fetchOrder.mockResolvedValue(fetchedOrder({
        tokenId: 'token-delayed-partial',
        orderId: 'delayed-partial',
        status: 'MATCHED',
        originalSize: '20',
        sizeMatched: '10',
        associateTrades: ['venue-trade-partial']
      }));
      client.listAccountTrades.mockReturnValue(paginator([confirmedAccountTrade({
        tokenId: 'token-delayed-partial',
        orderId: 'delayed-partial',
        tradeId: 'venue-trade-partial',
        price: '0.45',
        size: '10',
        feeRateBps: '100'
      })]));

      const outcomes = await pollPolymarketOrders();

      expect(client.fetchOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ orderId: 'delayed-partial' });
      expect(client.listAccountTrades).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ id: 'venue-trade-partial' });
      expect(client.listOpenOrders).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(outcomes).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({
        status: 'partial',
        shares: 10,
        amountUsd: 4.5,
        averagePrice: 0.45,
        venueTradeIds: ['venue-trade-partial'],
        settlementTransactionHashes: [`0x${'2'.repeat(64)}`]
      })]);
      expect(outcomes[0].feesUsd).toBeCloseTo(0.02475);
      expect(db.recordCopyExecutionEvidence).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
        executionId: 'copy-delayed-partial',
        evidenceType: 'venue_fill',
        evidenceId: 'order:delayed-partial',
        baseQuantity: '10',
        // S4-M35: the amount now carries its unit. Polymarket settles in USDC, so
        // the currency is asserted here rather than left for a chain lookup.
        quoteLeg: { amount: '4.5', currency: 'USD' },
        priceUsd: '0.45',
        confirmationState: 'confirmed',
        completesExecution: true
      }));
      const fillUpdate = vi.mocked(db.query).mock.calls.find(([sql]) =>
        String(sql).includes('amount_usd = $3')
      );
      expect(fillUpdate?.[1]).toEqual([
        row.id,
        'partial',
        4.5,
        10,
        0.45,
        expect.closeTo(0.02475),
        `0x${'2'.repeat(64)}`,
        'MATCHED',
        JSON.stringify(['venue-trade-partial']),
        JSON.stringify([`0x${'2'.repeat(64)}`])
      ]);
    });

    it('persists a delayed full fill once and makes a repeated poll idempotent', async () => {
      const db = await import('@swat/db');
      const row = pendingPolymarketTrade({
        tokenId: 'token-delayed-full',
        orderId: 'delayed-full'
      });
      let pendingReads = 0;
      vi.mocked(db.query).mockImplementation(async (sql) => {
        const statement = String(sql);
        if (statement.includes("executor = 'polymarket-clob'")) {
          pendingReads += 1;
          return (pendingReads === 1 ? [row] : []) as never;
        }
        if (statement.includes('WITH reconciled AS')) return [{ id: row.id }] as never;
        return [] as never;
      });
      client.fetchOrder.mockResolvedValue(fetchedOrder({
        tokenId: 'token-delayed-full',
        orderId: 'delayed-full',
        status: 'MATCHED',
        originalSize: '8',
        sizeMatched: '8',
        associateTrades: ['venue-trade-full']
      }));
      client.listAccountTrades.mockReturnValue(paginator([confirmedAccountTrade({
        tokenId: 'token-delayed-full',
        orderId: 'delayed-full',
        tradeId: 'venue-trade-full',
        price: '0.625',
        size: '8',
        transactionHash: `0x${'3'.repeat(64)}`
      })]));

      await expect(pollPolymarketOrders()).resolves.toEqual([
        expect.objectContaining({ status: 'filled', shares: 8, amountUsd: 5 })
      ]);
      await expect(pollPolymarketOrders()).resolves.toEqual([]);

      expect(client.fetchOrder).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(client.listAccountTrades).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(vi.mocked(db.query).mock.calls.filter(([sql]) =>
        String(sql).includes('WITH reconciled AS')
      )).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(client.postOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it('terminalizes a venue-cancelled delayed order without fabricating quantities', async () => {
      const db = await import('@swat/db');
      const row = pendingPolymarketTrade({
        tokenId: 'token-delayed-cancelled',
        orderId: 'delayed-cancelled',
        copyExecutionId: 'copy-delayed-cancelled'
      });
      vi.mocked(db.query)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([row] as never)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([{ id: row.id }] as never);
      client.fetchOrder.mockResolvedValue(fetchedOrder({
        tokenId: 'token-delayed-cancelled',
        orderId: 'delayed-cancelled',
        status: 'CANCELLED',
        originalSize: '12',
        sizeMatched: '0'
      }));

      const outcomes = await pollPolymarketOrders();

      expect(outcomes).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({
        status: 'cancelled',
        reason: expect.stringContaining('without a confirmed fill')
      })]);
      expect(client.listAccountTrades).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(db.transitionCopyExecution).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        executionId: 'copy-delayed-cancelled',
        nextState: 'cancelled',
        reason: 'Polymarket order delayed-cancelled was cancelled without a confirmed fill'
      });
      const terminalUpdate = vi.mocked(db.query).mock.calls.find(([sql]) =>
        String(sql).includes("venue_trade_ids = '[]'::jsonb")
      );
      expect(terminalUpdate?.[1]).toEqual([
        row.id,
        'cancelled',
        'CANCELLED',
        'Polymarket order delayed-cancelled was cancelled without a confirmed fill'
      ]);
    });

    it('distinguishes failed and ambiguous terminal evidence without creating fills', async () => {
      const db = await import('@swat/db');
      const failedRow = pendingPolymarketTrade({
        tokenId: 'token-delayed-failed',
        orderId: 'delayed-failed'
      });
      const ambiguousRow = pendingPolymarketTrade({
        tokenId: 'token-delayed-ambiguous',
        orderId: 'delayed-ambiguous'
      });
      vi.mocked(db.query)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([failedRow, ambiguousRow] as never)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([{ id: failedRow.id }] as never)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([] as never);
      client.fetchOrder
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(fetchedOrder({
          tokenId: 'token-delayed-failed',
          orderId: 'delayed-failed',
          status: 'FAILED',
          originalSize: '5',
          sizeMatched: '0'
        }))
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(fetchedOrder({
          tokenId: 'token-delayed-ambiguous',
          orderId: 'delayed-ambiguous',
          status: 'MYSTERY',
          originalSize: '5',
          sizeMatched: '0'
        }));

      const outcomes = await pollPolymarketOrders();

      expect(outcomes.map((outcome: { status: string }) => outcome.status)).toEqual([
        'failed',
        'ambiguous'
      ]);
      expect(vi.mocked(db.query).mock.calls.some(([sql]) =>
        String(sql).includes('amount_usd = $3')
      )).toBe(false);
      const ambiguousUpdate = vi.mocked(db.query).mock.calls.find(([, params]) =>
        Array.isArray(params) && params[0] === ambiguousRow.id
      );
      expect(ambiguousUpdate?.[1]).toEqual([
        ambiguousRow.id,
        'ambiguous',
        'Polymarket order delayed-ambiguous returned unknown status MYSTERY',
        // An ambiguous ORDER status carries no settlement state: the order never
        // got far enough for its trades to have one.
        null
      ]);
    });

    it('cancels a stale persisted order only after the venue confirms cancellation', async () => {
      const db = await import('@swat/db');
      const row = pendingPolymarketTrade({
        tokenId: 'token-stale',
        orderId: 'stale-order',
        submittedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 601_000)
      });
      vi.mocked(db.query)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([row] as never)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([{ id: row.id }] as never);
      client.fetchOrder.mockResolvedValue(fetchedOrder({
        tokenId: 'token-stale',
        orderId: 'stale-order',
        status: 'LIVE',
        originalSize: '10',
        sizeMatched: '0',
        createdAt: new Date(Date.now() - 601_000).toISOString()
      }));
      client.cancelOrder.mockResolvedValue({
        canceled: ['stale-order'],
        notCanceled: {}
      });

      await expect(pollPolymarketOrders()).resolves.toEqual([
        expect.objectContaining({ status: 'cancelled' })
      ]);

      expect(client.cancelOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ orderId: 'stale-order' });
      expect(client.listOpenOrders).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  it('fails closed on malformed balance-allowance payloads', async () => {
    polymarketActionMocks.fetchBalanceAllowance.mockResolvedValue({
      balance: '1.5',
      allowances: {}
    });

    await expect(getPolymarketAvailableBalance('token-invalid', 'buy')).rejects.toThrow(
      'invalid buy balance'
    );
  });

  describe('authenticated client initialization', () => {
    it('rejects partial credentials, malformed builder codes, and unsupported runtimes', () => {
      expect(() => loadPolymarketApiCredentials({
        POLYMARKET_API_KEY: 'key-only'
      })).toThrow('must be configured together');
      expect(() => loadPolymarketBuilderCredentials({
        POLYMARKET_BUILDER_API_KEY: 'key-only'
      })).toThrow('must be configured together');
      expect(() => parsePolymarketBuilderCode('builder-name')).toThrow('bytes32');
      expect(() => assertSupportedPolymarketRuntime('22.22.2')).toThrow('requires Node.js 24');
      expect(() => assertSupportedPolymarketRuntime('24.0.0')).not.toThrow();
    });

    it('derives credentials and validates wallet, account, and builder fees', async () => {
      const factory = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(client);
      const initialized = await initializePolymarketClient({
        POLYMARKET_SIGNATURE_TYPE: 'EOA',
        POLYMARKET_BUILDER_CODE: `0x${'b'.repeat(64)}`
      }, factory, '24.0.0');

      expect(initialized.credentialSource).toBe('derived');
      expect(initialized.builderCode).toBe(`0x${'b'.repeat(64)}`);
      expect(initialized.builderMakerFeeBps).toBe(25);
      expect(initialized.builderTakerFeeBps).toBe(50);
      expect(factory).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({
        environment: production
      }));
      expect(client.fetchClosedOnlyMode).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();

        'incomplete L2 API credentials'
      );
      expect(getPolymarketLiveReadiness().ready).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe('settlement state persistence', () => {
    // The venue advances a trade MATCHED -> MINED -> CONFIRMED independently of
    // the order status, with RETRYING when an onchain attempt failed. Collapsing
    // those into one "pending" bucket hides which of three very different
    // positions is actually being held.
    function settlingTrade(params: {
      tokenId: string;
      orderId: string;
      tradeId: string;
      status: string;
    }) {
      return {
        ...confirmedAccountTrade({
          tokenId: params.tokenId,
          orderId: params.orderId,
          tradeId: params.tradeId,
          price: '0.40',
          size: '5'
        }),
        status: params.status
      };
    }

    async function reconcileWith(orderId: string, tradeStatuses: string[]) {
      const db = await import('@swat/db');
      const tokenId = `token-${orderId}`;
      const tradeIds = tradeStatuses.map((_, index) => `${orderId}-trade-${index}`);
      const row = pendingPolymarketTrade({ tokenId, orderId });
      vi.mocked(db.query)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce([row] as never)
        .mockResolvedValue([] as never);
      client.fetchOrder.mockResolvedValue(fetchedOrder({
        tokenId,
        orderId,
        status: 'MATCHED',
        originalSize: '5',
        sizeMatched: '5',
        associateTrades: tradeIds
      }));
      client.listAccountTrades.mockImplementation(({ id }: { id: string }) => {
        const index = tradeIds.indexOf(id);
        return paginator([settlingTrade({
          tokenId,
          orderId,
          tradeId: id,
          status: tradeStatuses[index]!
        })]);
      });

      const outcomes = await pollPolymarketOrders();
      const update = vi.mocked(db.query).mock.calls.find(([sql]) =>
        String(sql).includes('venue_settlement_status = $4')
      );
      return { outcomes, update, rowId: row.id };
    }

    it.each([
      ['TRADE_STATUS_MATCHED', 'matched'],
      ['TRADE_STATUS_MATCHED_NOT_BROADCASTED', 'matched'],
      ['TRADE_STATUS_MINED', 'mined'],
      ['TRADE_STATUS_RETRYING', 'retrying']
    ])('persists %s distinctly as %s without creating a fill', async (venueStatus, expected) => {
      const { outcomes, update, rowId } = await reconcileWith(`settle-${expected}-${venueStatus}`, [venueStatus]);

      expect(outcomes).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ status: 'pending_confirmation' })]);
      expect(outcomes[0].shares).toBeUndefined();
      expect(update?.[1]).toEqual([rowId, 'MATCHED', expect.stringContaining(`settlement ${expected}`), expected]);
    });

    it('reports the weakest settlement state across several trades', async () => {
      // One leg mined and another retrying is a RETRYING position: the order is
      // only as settled as its least-settled trade.
      const { outcomes, update } = await reconcileWith('settle-mixed', [
        'TRADE_STATUS_MINED',
        'TRADE_STATUS_RETRYING'
      ]);

      expect(outcomes[0].status).toBe('pending_confirmation');
      expect(update?.[1]?.[3]).toBe('retrying');
    });

    it('fails closed on a settlement status outside the documented set', async () => {
      // Parking an unrecognised state as "pending" is how a position ends up
      // sitting forever in a state nobody is watching.
      const { outcomes } = await reconcileWith('settle-unknown', ['TRADE_STATUS_TELEPORTED']);

      expect(outcomes).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({
        status: 'ambiguous',
        reason: expect.stringContaining('unrecognised settlement status')
      })]);
    });
  });
});

export interface PolymarketIdentity {
  signerAddress: string;
  funderAddress: string;
  signatureType: SignatureType;
  signatureTypeName: keyof typeof SignatureType;
  builderCode: BuilderCode;
  directWalletWritesAllowed: boolean;
}

export interface PolymarketClientInitialization extends PolymarketIdentity {
  credentialSource: 'environment' | 'derived';
  builderAuthentication: 'none' | 'local';
  builderMakerFeeBps: number;
  builderTakerFeeBps: number;
}

function requiredTrimmed(value: string | undefined, name: string): string {
  const trimmed = value?.trim();
  if (!trimmed) throw new Error(`${name} is required for Polymarket live execution`);
  return trimmed;
}

export function parsePolymarketSignatureType(value: string | undefined): {
  value: SignatureType;
  name: keyof typeof SignatureType;
} {
  const name = requiredTrimmed(value, 'POLYMARKET_SIGNATURE_TYPE').toUpperCase();
  switch (name) {
    case 'EOA':
      return { value: SignatureType.EOA, name: 'EOA' };
    case 'POLY_PROXY':
      return { value: SignatureType.POLY_PROXY, name: 'POLY_PROXY' };
    case 'POLY_GNOSIS_SAFE':
      return { value: SignatureType.POLY_GNOSIS_SAFE, name: 'POLY_GNOSIS_SAFE' };
    case 'POLY_1271':
      return { value: SignatureType.POLY_1271, name: 'POLY_1271' };
    default:
      throw new Error(`Unsupported POLYMARKET_SIGNATURE_TYPE: ${name}`);
  }
}

export function parsePolymarketBuilderCode(value: string | undefined): BuilderCode {
  const builderCode = requiredTrimmed(value, 'POLYMARKET_BUILDER_CODE');
  if (!/^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(builderCode)) {
    throw new Error('POLYMARKET_BUILDER_CODE must be a bytes32 value (0x plus 64 hex characters)');
  }
  return BuilderCodeSchema.parse(builderCode.toLowerCase());
}

export function loadPolymarketApiCredentials(
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env
): ApiKeyCreds | null {
  const values = [
    env.POLYMARKET_API_KEY?.trim(),
    env.POLYMARKET_API_SECRET?.trim(),
    env.POLYMARKET_API_PASSPHRASE?.trim()
  ];
  const present = values.filter(Boolean).length;
  if (present === 0) return null;
  if (present !== values.length) {
    throw new Error(
      'POLYMARKET_API_KEY, POLYMARKET_API_SECRET, and POLYMARKET_API_PASSPHRASE must be configured together'
    );
  }
  return ApiKeyCredsSchema.parse({
    apiKey: values[0],
    secret: values[1],
    passphrase: values[2]
  });
}

export function loadPolymarketBuilderCredentials(
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env
): BuilderApiKeyCreds | null {
  const values = [
    env.POLYMARKET_BUILDER_API_KEY?.trim(),
    env.POLYMARKET_BUILDER_API_SECRET?.trim(),
    env.POLYMARKET_BUILDER_API_PASSPHRASE?.trim()
  ];
  const present = values.filter(Boolean).length;
  if (present === 0) return null;
  if (present !== values.length) {
    throw new Error(
      'POLYMARKET_BUILDER_API_KEY, POLYMARKET_BUILDER_API_SECRET, and ' +
      'POLYMARKET_BUILDER_API_PASSPHRASE must be configured together'
    );
  }
  return BuilderApiKeyCredsSchema.parse({
    key: values[0],
    secret: values[1],
    passphrase: values[2]
  });
}

export function resolvePolymarketIdentity(
  signerAddress: string,
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env
): PolymarketIdentity {
  const normalizedSigner = ethers.utils.getAddress(signerAddress);
  const signatureType = parsePolymarketSignatureType(env.POLYMARKET_SIGNATURE_TYPE);
  const configuredFunder = env.POLYMARKET_FUNDER_ADDRESS?.trim();
  const funderAddress = configuredFunder
    ? ethers.utils.getAddress(configuredFunder)
    : normalizedSigner;

  if (signatureType.value === SignatureType.EOA && funderAddress !== normalizedSigner) {
    throw new Error('EOA signature mode requires POLYMARKET_FUNDER_ADDRESS to equal the signer');
  }
  if (signatureType.value !== SignatureType.EOA && !configuredFunder) {
    throw new Error('POLYMARKET_FUNDER_ADDRESS is required for proxy, Safe, or EIP-1271 signing');
  }

  return {
    signerAddress: normalizedSigner,
    funderAddress,
    signatureType: signatureType.value,
    signatureTypeName: signatureType.name,
    builderCode: parsePolymarketBuilderCode(env.POLYMARKET_BUILDER_CODE),
    directWalletWritesAllowed:
      signatureType.value === SignatureType.EOA && funderAddress === normalizedSigner
  };
}

function assertCredentials(credentials: unknown): asserts credentials is ApiKeyCreds {
  if (
    typeof credentials !== 'object' ||
    credentials === null ||
    !('key' in credentials) ||
    !('secret' in credentials) ||
    !('passphrase' in credentials) ||
    !ApiKeySchema.safeParse(credentials.key).success ||
    typeof credentials.secret !== 'string' ||
    credentials.secret.trim() === '' ||
    typeof credentials.passphrase !== 'string' ||
    credentials.passphrase.trim() === ''
  ) {
    throw new Error('Polymarket returned incomplete L2 API credentials');
  }
}

export function assertSupportedPolymarketRuntime(nodeVersion = process.versions.node): void {
  const major = Number(nodeVersion.split('.')[0]);
  if (!Number.isInteger(major) || major < 24) {
    throw new Error(
      `@polymarket/client ${POLYMARKET_SDK_VERSION} requires Node.js 24 or newer; found ${nodeVersion}`
    );
  }
}

function expectedWalletType(signatureType: SignatureType): WalletType {
  switch (signatureType) {
    case SignatureType.EOA:
      return WalletType.EOA;
    case SignatureType.POLY_PROXY:
      return WalletType.POLY_PROXY;
    case SignatureType.POLY_GNOSIS_SAFE:
      return WalletType.GNOSIS_SAFE;
    case SignatureType.POLY_1271:
      return WalletType.DEPOSIT_WALLET;
  }
}

function requireSecureClobClient(): PolymarketSecureClient {
  if (!secureClobClient) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket authenticated client is not initialized');
  }
  return secureClobClient;
}

export function setPolymarketClientForTesting(client: PolymarketSecureClient | null): void {
  secureClobClient = client;
}

/**
 * The authenticated client, or null when Polymarket is not configured.
 *
 * Nullable counterpart to `requireSecureClobClient`, for callers that must
 * degrade rather than fail — the redemption sweep runs on a timer and an absent
 * client is the normal paper-mode posture, not an error worth throwing on every
 * tick.
 */
export function getPolymarketClientIfReady(): PolymarketSecureClient | null {
  return secureClobClient;
}

export async function initializePolymarketClient(
  env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env,
  clientFactory: PolymarketClientFactory = createSecureClient,
  nodeVersion = process.versions.node
): Promise<PolymarketClientInitialization> {
  secureClobClient = null;
  setPolymarketLiveReadiness(
    false,
    'Polymarket authenticated client initialization is in progress'
  );
  assertSupportedPolymarketRuntime(nodeVersion);
  if (!polymarketSigner) {
    throw new Error('EVM_PRIVATE_KEY is required for Polymarket live execution');
  }

  const identity = resolvePolymarketIdentity(polymarketSigner.address, env);
  const credentials = loadPolymarketApiCredentials(env);
  const builderCredentials = loadPolymarketBuilderCredentials(env);
  const credentialSource = credentials ? 'environment' : 'derived';
  const options: SecureClientOptions = {
    environment: production,
    signer: signerFrom(polymarketSigner),
    wallet: identity.funderAddress,
    ...(credentials ? { credentials } : {}),
    ...(builderCredentials ? { apiKey: builderApiKey(builderCredentials) } : {})
  };
  const authenticatedClient = await clientFactory(options);
  assertCredentials(authenticatedClient.credentials);
  if (authenticatedClient.account.signer.toLowerCase() !== identity.signerAddress.toLowerCase()) {
    throw new Error('Authenticated CLOB signer does not match EVM_PRIVATE_KEY');
  }
  if (authenticatedClient.account.wallet.toLowerCase() !== identity.funderAddress.toLowerCase()) {
    throw new Error('Authenticated CLOB wallet does not match POLYMARKET_FUNDER_ADDRESS');
  }
  const requiredWalletType = expectedWalletType(identity.signatureType);
  if (authenticatedClient.account.walletType !== requiredWalletType) {
    throw new Error(
      `POLYMARKET_SIGNATURE_TYPE ${identity.signatureTypeName} does not match the SDK-classified wallet`
    );
  }

  const [closedOnly, openOrdersPage, builderFeeRates] = await Promise.all([
    authenticatedClient.fetchClosedOnlyMode(),
    authenticatedClient.listOpenOrders().firstPage(),
    fetchBuilderFeeRates(authenticatedClient, { builderCode: identity.builderCode })
  ]);
  if (closedOnly) {
    throw new Error('Polymarket account is in closed-only mode');
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(openOrdersPage.items)) {
    throw new Error('Authenticated CLOB open-order round trip returned an invalid page');
  }
  const builderMakerFeeBps = boundedBuilderFeeBps(builderFeeRates.maker, 'maker', 50);
  const builderTakerFeeBps = boundedBuilderFeeBps(builderFeeRates.taker, 'taker', 100);

  secureClobClient = authenticatedClient;
  return {
    ...identity,
    credentialSource,
    builderAuthentication: builderCredentials ? 'local' : 'none',
    builderMakerFeeBps,
    builderTakerFeeBps
  };
}

function boundedBuilderFeeBps(rate: number, label: string, maximumBps: number): number {
  const scaled = rate * 10_000;
  const basisPoints = Math.round(scaled);
  if (
    !Number.isFinite(rate) ||
    rate < 0 ||
    Math.abs(scaled - basisPoints) > 1e-9 ||
    basisPoints > maximumBps
  ) {
    throw new Error(`Polymarket returned ${label} builder fees outside the supported limits`);
  }
  return basisPoints;
}

export function setPolymarketLiveReadiness(ready: boolean, reason?: string): void {
  liveReadiness = {
    ready,
    reason: reason ?? (ready ? 'verified' : 'Polymarket live readiness was revoked')
  };
}

export function getPolymarketLiveReadiness(): Readonly<typeof liveReadiness> {
  return liveReadiness;
}

export function parsePolymarketFixed6(value: string, label: string): number {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^[0-9]+$/.test(value)) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(`Polymarket returned an invalid ${label}`);
  }
  const units = BigInt(value);
  const whole = units / 1_000_000n;
  const fraction = units % 1_000_000n;
  const result = Number(whole) + Number(fraction) / 1_000_000;
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(Number(whole)) || !Number.isFinite(result)) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(`Polymarket ${label} exceeds the supported numeric range`);
  }
  return result;
}

export async function getPolymarketAvailableBalance(
  tokenID: string,
  direction: 'buy' | 'sell'
): Promise<number> {
  const params = direction === 'buy'
    ? { assetType: AssetType.COLLATERAL }
    : { assetType: AssetType.CONDITIONAL, tokenId: tokenID };
  const client = requireSecureClobClient();
  const result = await fetchBalanceAllowance(client, params);
  return parsePolymarketFixed6(result.balance, `${direction} balance`);
}

export async function getPolymarketAskPrice(
  tokenID: string,
  side: OrderSide = OrderSide.BUY
): Promise<number> {
  const book = await (secureClobClient ?? publicClobClient).fetchOrderBook({ tokenId: tokenID });
  const levels = side === OrderSide.BUY ? book.asks : book.bids;
  if (!levels || levels.length === 0) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(
      `No ${side === OrderSide.BUY ? 'asks' : 'bids'} available for token ${tokenID}`
    );
  }

  const prices = levels.map((level) => Number(level.price));
  if (prices.some((price) => !Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0 || price >= 1)) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(`Polymarket returned an invalid order-book price for ${tokenID}`);
  }
  return side === OrderSide.BUY ? Math.min(...prices) : Math.max(...prices);
}

export interface PolymarketBookPlan {
  bestPrice: number;
  limitPrice: number;
  averagePrice: number;
  estimatedShares: number;
  estimatedNotionalUsd: number;
  slippageBps: number;
}

function parsePositiveDecimal(value: string, label: string): number {
  if (!/^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\.[0-9]+)?$/.test(value)) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(`Polymarket returned an invalid ${label}`);
  }
  const parsed = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed <= 0) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(`Polymarket returned an invalid ${label}`);
  }
  return parsed;
}

function floorDecimal(value: number, decimals: number): number {
  const scale = 10 ** decimals;
  return Math.floor((value + Number.EPSILON) * scale) / scale;
}

function validateBookTimestamp(book: OrderBook, now = Date.now()): void {
  if (book.timestamp === undefined || book.timestamp === null) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket order book is missing its observation timestamp');
  }
  const timestamp = Number(book.timestamp);
  const maxAgeMs = Number(process.env.POLYMARKET_MAX_BOOK_AGE_MS ?? '15000');
  if (!Number.isInteger(maxAgeMs) || maxAgeMs < 1_000 || maxAgeMs > 120_000) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(
      'POLYMARKET_MAX_BOOK_AGE_MS must be an integer between 1000 and 120000'
    );
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(timestamp) || timestamp > now + 5_000 || now - timestamp > maxAgeMs) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket order book observation is stale or invalid');
  }
}

export function planPolymarketBookOrder(
  book: OrderBook,
  direction: 'buy' | 'sell',
  requestedAmount: number,
  maxSlippageBps: number,
  now = Date.now()
): PolymarketBookPlan {
  if (!Number.isFinite(requestedAmount) || requestedAmount <= 0) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket order amount must be positive');
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(maxSlippageBps) || maxSlippageBps < 0 || maxSlippageBps > 5_000) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('POLYMARKET_SLIPPAGE_BPS must be an integer from 0 to 5000');
  }
  validateBookTimestamp(book, now);

  const tickSize = parsePositiveDecimal(String(book.tickSize), 'tick size');
  const minimumShares = parsePositiveDecimal(String(book.minOrderSize), 'minimum order size');
  const rawLevels = direction === 'buy' ? book.asks : book.bids;
  if (rawLevels.length === 0) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(
      `No ${direction === 'buy' ? 'asks' : 'bids'} available for token ${book.tokenId}`
    );
  }

  const levels = rawLevels
    .map((level) => ({
      price: parsePositiveDecimal(String(level.price), 'order-book price'),
      size: parsePositiveDecimal(String(level.size), 'order-book size')
    }))
    .sort((left, right) => direction === 'buy'
      ? left.price - right.price
      : right.price - left.price);

  for (const level of levels) {
    if (level.price >= 1) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError(`Polymarket returned an invalid order-book price for ${book.tokenId}`);
    }
    const tickRatio = level.price / tickSize;
    if (Math.abs(tickRatio - Math.round(tickRatio)) > 1e-8) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError(
        'Polymarket Protection: order-book price is off the current tick-size grid'
      );
    }
  }

  let remaining = requestedAmount;
  let shares = 0;
  let notional = 0;
  let limitPrice = levels[0]!.price;
  for (const level of levels) {
    if (remaining <= 1e-9) break;
    if (direction === 'buy') {
      const levelNotional = level.size * level.price;
      const consumedNotional = Math.min(remaining, levelNotional);
      shares += consumedNotional / level.price;
      notional += consumedNotional;
      remaining -= consumedNotional;
    } else {
      const consumedShares = Math.min(remaining, level.size);
      shares += consumedShares;
      notional += consumedShares * level.price;
      remaining -= consumedShares;
    }
    limitPrice = level.price;
  }

  if (remaining > 1e-8) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket Protection: order book is too thin for the requested size');
  }

  shares = floorDecimal(shares, POLYMARKET_SHARE_DECIMALS);
  if (shares < minimumShares) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(
      `Polymarket Protection: order is below the ${minimumShares}-share minimum after venue rounding`
    );
  }
  const bestPrice = levels[0]!.price;
  const slippageBps = direction === 'buy'
    ? ((limitPrice / bestPrice) - 1) * 10_000
    : (1 - (limitPrice / bestPrice)) * 10_000;
  if (slippageBps > maxSlippageBps + 1e-8) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(
      `Polymarket Protection: required depth exceeds ${maxSlippageBps} bps slippage`
    );
  }

  return {
    bestPrice,
    limitPrice,
    averagePrice: notional / (direction === 'buy' ? shares : requestedAmount),
    estimatedShares: shares,
    estimatedNotionalUsd: notional,
    slippageBps
  };
}

/**
 * Price a paper fill the way the live path prices a real one: walk the book for
 * the requested size instead of assuming the whole order clears at the best
 * level.
 *
 * Taking the best price for any size makes paper systematically optimistic
 * against live - the thinner the book, the wider the gap - which is precisely
 * the error a shadow/paper benchmark exists to avoid. This shares
 * `planPolymarketBookOrder` with the live path so the two cannot drift, and it
 * inherits the same staleness, tick-grid, thin-book, and slippage rejections.
 *
 * `requestedAmount` is USD notional for a buy and shares for a sell, matching
 * the live contract.
 */
export async function simulatePolymarketBookFill(params: {
  tokenID: string;
  direction: 'buy' | 'sell';
  requestedAmount: number;
  now?: number;
}): Promise<PolymarketBookPlan> {
  const client = secureClobClient ?? publicClobClient;
  if (!client) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket order-book client is not initialized');
  }
  const book = await client.fetchOrderBook({ tokenId: params.tokenID });
  const maxSlippageBps = Number(process.env.POLYMARKET_SLIPPAGE_BPS ?? '200');
  return planPolymarketBookOrder(
    book,
    params.direction,
    params.requestedAmount,
    maxSlippageBps,
    params.now
  );
}

function collateralAvailableForPrincipal(available: number): number {
  const feeBufferBps = Number(process.env.POLYMARKET_FEE_BUFFER_BPS ?? '300');
  if (!Number.isInteger(feeBufferBps) || feeBufferBps < 0 || feeBufferBps > 5000) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(
      'POLYMARKET_FEE_BUFFER_BPS must be an integer between 0 and 5000'
    );
  }
  return available * 10_000 / (10_000 + feeBufferBps);
}

/**
 * The master-fill reference a mirrored order is bounded against (`S4-M16`).
 *
 * Supplied only on the mirroring path. A manual or stop-loss order has no master
 * and legitimately carries none, which is why this is optional rather than
 * defaulted — but when it *is* supplied and `masterFillPriceUsd` is absent, the
 * mirror fails closed with a skip instead of falling back to a book-derived
 * bound that nobody sanctioned.
 */
export interface PolymarketMirrorContext {
  /** The canonical source event being mirrored. Present iff this is a copy. */
  readonly sourceTradeId: string;
  /** The tracked wallet's realized price for that event, in USD per share. */
  readonly masterFillPriceUsd: number | null;
  /** Per-user override; falls back to POLYMARKET_MIRROR_TOLERANCE_BPS. */
  readonly toleranceBps?: number;
}

export async function triggerPolymarket(params: {
  signalId: string;
  tokenID: string;
  spendAmountUsd: number;
  direction: 'buy' | 'sell';
  sellShares?: number;
  mirror?: PolymarketMirrorContext;
  /**
   * When the source event this order copies actually happened (`S4-M18`).
   *
   * Optional for the same reason `mirror` is: only a copy has a source event. A
   * manual execute or a stop-loss exit has none, and gating those on a timestamp
   * that does not exist would refuse every one of them. Present-but-unusable
   * still fails closed — the staleness rule below refuses rather than falling
   * back to the flat ceiling.
   */
  sourceEventAt?: Date;
  /** Per-user override; falls back to the POLYMARKET_STALENESS_* environment. */
  stalenessPolicy?: Partial<PolymarketStalenessPolicy>;
  /** Timestamp when user's geo-eligibility was verified via interactive session (S4-P16). */
  geoVerifiedAt?: Date | null;
  /** Injected clock, so the staleness boundary is testable without faking time. */
  now?: () => number;
}) {
  if (!liveReadiness.ready) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(`Polymarket live execution is not ready: ${liveReadiness.reason}`);
  }
  if (!polymarketSigner) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket signer is not initialized');
  }

  if (params.geoVerifiedAt !== undefined) {
    const geo = checkPolymarketGeoEligibility({
      geoVerifiedAt: params.geoVerifiedAt,
      now: params.now ? new Date(params.now()) : undefined
    });
    if (!geo.eligible) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError(`Polymarket Protection: [${geo.code}] ${geo.reason}`);
    }
  }

  try {
    const identity = resolvePolymarketIdentity(polymarketSigner.address);
    const client = requireSecureClobClient();
    const existingExecutions = await query<{ venue_order_id: string | null; status: string }>(
      `SELECT trade.venue_order_id, trade.status
         FROM trades trade
         LEFT JOIN copy_executions execution ON execution.id = trade.copy_execution_id
        WHERE (trade.signal_id::text = $1 OR execution.client_order_id = $1)
          AND trade.chain = 'polygon'
          AND trade.execution_mode = 'live'
          AND trade.executor = 'polymarket-clob'
          AND trade.status NOT IN ('failed', 'skipped', 'cancelled', 'rejected')
        ORDER BY trade.executed_at DESC
        LIMIT 1`,
      [params.signalId]
    );
    if (existingExecutions.length > 0) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError(
        `Polymarket Protection: signal ${params.signalId} already has an active execution`
      );
    }
    const openOrders = await client.listOpenOrders({ tokenId: params.tokenID }).firstPage();
    if (openOrders.items.length > 0) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError(
        `Polymarket Protection: Open orders already exist for ${params.tokenID}. Aborting to prevent double-spend.`
      );
    }

    const availableBalance = await getPolymarketAvailableBalance(params.tokenID, params.direction);
    let spendAmountUsd = params.spendAmountUsd;
    let requestedShares = params.sellShares ?? 0;
    if (params.direction === 'buy') {
      spendAmountUsd = capPositionToAvailableBalance({
        requested: params.spendAmountUsd,
        available: collateralAvailableForPrincipal(availableBalance),
        maximum: params.spendAmountUsd,
        precision: POLYMARKET_DECIMALS
      });
    } else if (params.sellShares === undefined) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket sells require an exact requested share quantity');
    }

    if (params.direction === 'sell') {
      requestedShares = capPositionToAvailableBalance({
        requested: requestedShares,
        available: availableBalance,
        maximum: requestedShares,
        precision: POLYMARKET_SHARE_DECIMALS
      });
    }
    if (
      (params.direction === 'buy' && spendAmountUsd <= 0)
      || (params.direction === 'sell' && requestedShares <= 0)
    ) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError(
        `Polymarket ${params.direction} balance is insufficient for the minimum order size`
      );
    }

    const book = await client.fetchOrderBook({ tokenId: params.tokenID });
    const maxSlippageBps = Number(process.env.POLYMARKET_SLIPPAGE_BPS ?? '200');
    const plan = planPolymarketBookOrder(
      book,
      params.direction,
      params.direction === 'buy' ? spendAmountUsd : requestedShares,
      maxSlippageBps
    );

    // The protective bound we actually sign. On the mirroring path it comes from
    // the master's fill (`S4-M16`); a manual or stop-loss order keeps the
    // book-walk level, which is all the reference such an order has.
    let mirrorDecision: PolymarketMirrorBoundDecision | null = null;
    let boundPrice = plan.limitPrice;
    if (params.mirror) {
      mirrorDecision = planPolymarketMirrorBound({
        direction: params.direction,
        masterFillPrice: params.mirror.masterFillPriceUsd,
        bookLimitPrice: plan.limitPrice,
        tickSize: Number(book.tickSize),
        shares: params.direction === 'buy' ? plan.estimatedShares : requestedShares,
        minimumShares: Number(book.minOrderSize),
        toleranceBps: params.mirror.toleranceBps ?? resolvePolymarketMirrorToleranceBps()
      });
      if (mirrorDecision.kind === 'skip') {
        // "Polymarket Protection" is the marker the job handler matches to record
        // a skipped trade with its reason rather than a failed one.
        throw new UnrecoverableError(
          `Polymarket Protection: ${mirrorDecision.reason} [${mirrorDecision.code}]`
        );
      }
      boundPrice = mirrorDecision.boundPrice;
    }

    const maximumEntryPrice = Number(process.env.POLYMARKET_MAX_ENTRY_PRICE ?? '0.97');
    const minimumExitPrice = Number(process.env.POLYMARKET_MIN_EXIT_PRICE ?? '0.01');
    if (
      !Number.isFinite(maximumEntryPrice) || maximumEntryPrice <= 0 || maximumEntryPrice >= 1 ||
      !Number.isFinite(minimumExitPrice) || minimumExitPrice <= 0 || minimumExitPrice >= 1
    ) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket entry/exit price bounds are invalid');
    }
    // Applied to the bound we are about to sign, not to the book level, so a
    // mirror tolerance can never widen the operator's configured safe range.
    if (
      (params.direction === 'buy' && boundPrice > maximumEntryPrice) ||
      (params.direction === 'sell' && boundPrice < minimumExitPrice)
    ) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError(
        `Polymarket Protection: Price ${boundPrice} outside safe bounds configured for this executor`
      );
    }

    // Last gate before the order exists. The book proves liquidity; this proves
    // the market will still accept an order at all. Deliberately placed after
    // the depth walk and price bounds so the state read is as close to the
    // submission as the code allows.
    const nowMs = (params.now ?? Date.now)();
    const marketState = await assertPolymarketMarketOpenForSubmission({
      conditionId: String(book.conditionId),
      now: nowMs
    });

    // `S4-M18`: a copy's signal age is measured against the market's remaining
    // time-to-resolution, not against a flat ceiling. Evaluated here, after the
    // live market-state read, because `endDate` and `secondsDelay` are what that
    // read returns and both are inputs to the budget — a second Gamma call to get
    // them would be a second, later view of the same market.
    //
    // Only a copy carries `sourceEventAt`. A manual execute or a stop-loss exit
    // has no source event and keeps today's behaviour, exactly as it keeps the
    // book-derived bound when `mirror` is absent.
    //
    // **A copy with no readable event time is refused, not waved through.** Both
    // `mirror` and `sourceEventAt` come from the one `getCanonicalSourceTradeById`
    // read in `index.ts`, so when that row is missing the price half fails closed
    // (a null master price skips) while the timing half would fail *open* — the
    // `if` below simply would not run, and the copy would be indistinguishable
    // from a manual order that never had a source event. That asymmetry is the
    // wrong way round for a safety control: a signal whose age we cannot even
    // establish is exactly the one this budget exists to refuse. `mirror` is the
    // discriminator because it is present iff `payload.sourceTradeId` was.
    if (params.mirror && !params.sourceEventAt) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError(
        'Polymarket Protection: this copy has no readable source event time, so its '
        + 'age against the market\'s remaining time-to-resolution cannot be checked '
        + '[source-event-time-unavailable]'
      );
    }
    if (params.sourceEventAt) {
      const staleness = evaluatePolymarketSignalStaleness({
        signalAt: params.sourceEventAt,
        resolutionAt: marketState.endDate,
        now: nowMs,
        matchingDelaySeconds: marketState.secondsDelay,
        policy: params.stalenessPolicy ?? defaultStalenessPolicy()
      });
      if (staleness.kind === 'stale') {
        // Same marker as the mirror skip: the job handler matches
        // "Polymarket Protection" to record a skipped trade carrying this reason
        // rather than a failed job that would retry into an even older signal.
        throw new UnrecoverableError(
          `Polymarket Protection: ${staleness.reason} [${staleness.code}]`
        );
      }
    }

    const tradeSide = params.direction === 'buy' ? OrderSide.BUY : OrderSide.SELL;
    const order = await client.createMarketOrder(params.direction === 'buy'
      ? {
          tokenId: params.tokenID,
          side: OrderSide.BUY,
          amount: spendAmountUsd,
          maxSpend: spendAmountUsd,
          maxPrice: boundPrice,
          orderType: OrderType.FAK,
          builderCode: identity.builderCode
        }
      : {
          tokenId: params.tokenID,
          side: OrderSide.SELL,
          shares: requestedShares,
          minPrice: boundPrice,
          orderType: OrderType.FAK,
          builderCode: identity.builderCode
        });
    if (
      typeof order.builder !== 'string' ||
      order.builder.toLowerCase() !== identity.builderCode
    ) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket signed order omitted the configured builder code');
    }

    const relayerBudget = globalPolymarketRelayerBudget.checkBudget();
    if (!relayerBudget.allowed) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError(relayerBudget.reason!);
    }

    const startTime = Date.now();
    const response = await client.postOrder(order);
    globalPolymarketRelayerBudget.recordExecution();
    const latencyMs = Date.now() - startTime;
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new UnrecoverableError(`Polymarket order rejected: ${response.code}: ${response.message}`);
    }

    const pendingResult = (reason: string) => ({
      orderId: response.orderId,
      status: response.status,
      executionStatus: 'pending_confirmation' as const,
      reason,
      settlementTransactionHashes: response.transactionsHashes ?? [],
      tradeIds: response.tradeIds ?? [],
      latencyMs,
      spendAmountUsd: 0,
      shares: 0,
      averagePrice: null,
      feesUsd: null,
      requestedSpendAmountUsd: params.direction === 'buy' ? spendAmountUsd : plan.estimatedNotionalUsd,
      requestedShares: params.direction === 'buy' ? plan.estimatedShares : requestedShares,
      slippageBps: plan.slippageBps,
      mirrorBoundPrice: boundPrice,
      mirrorTrackingBps: mirrorDecision?.kind === 'submit' ? mirrorDecision.trackingBps : null
    });
    if (response.tradeIds.length === 0) {
      return pendingResult(`Polymarket order was accepted with venue status ${response.status}`);
    }

    let settlementTransactionHashes: string[];
    try {
      const timeoutMs = Number(process.env.POLYMARKET_SETTLEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS ?? '30000');
      if (!Number.isInteger(timeoutMs) || timeoutMs < 1_000 || timeoutMs > 120_000) {
        throw new Error(
          'POLYMARKET_SETTLEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS must be an integer between 1000 and 120000'
        );
      }
      settlementTransactionHashes = await client.waitForOrderFillSettlement(response, { timeoutMs });
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      return pendingResult(`Polymarket fill settlement is unresolved: ${message}`);
    }

    const fills: ClobTrade[] = [];
    try {
      for (const tradeId of response.tradeIds) {
        const page = await client.listAccountTrades({ id: tradeId }).firstPage();
        const fill = page.items.find((item) => item.id === tradeId);
        if (!fill || fill.tokenId !== params.tokenID || fill.takerOrderId !== response.orderId) {
          return pendingResult(`Polymarket fill ${tradeId} could not be attributed to the submitted order`);
        }
        fills.push(fill);
      }
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      return pendingResult(`Polymarket fill details are unresolved: ${message}`);
    }

    const confirmedFills = fills.filter((fill) => fill.status.toUpperCase() === 'CONFIRMED');
    if (confirmedFills.length !== fills.length || confirmedFills.length === 0) {
      return pendingResult('Polymarket fills have not all reached confirmed terminal state');
    }
    let actualShares = 0;
    let actualNotionalUsd = 0;
    let feesUsd = 0;
    for (const fill of confirmedFills) {
      const size = parsePositiveDecimal(String(fill.size), 'confirmed fill size');
      const price = parsePositiveDecimal(String(fill.price), 'confirmed fill price');
      const feeRateBps = Number(fill.feeRateBps);
      if (!Number.isFinite(feeRateBps) || feeRateBps < 0) {
        return pendingResult(`Polymarket fill ${fill.id} has an invalid fee rate`);
      }
      actualShares += size;
      actualNotionalUsd += size * price;
      if (fill.traderSide === 'TAKER') {
        feesUsd += size * (feeRateBps / 10_000) * price * (1 - price);
      }
    }
    const requested = params.direction === 'buy' ? plan.estimatedShares : requestedShares;
    const executionStatus = params.direction === 'buy'
      ? actualNotionalUsd + feesUsd + 0.01 < spendAmountUsd ? 'partial' : 'filled'
      : actualShares + 1e-8 < requestedShares ? 'partial' : 'filled';
    const hashes = Array.from(new Set([
      ...settlementTransactionHashes,
      ...confirmedFills.map((fill) => fill.transactionHash).filter(Boolean)
    ]));
    if (hashes.length === 0) {
      return pendingResult('Polymarket confirmed fills did not include settlement identity');
    }

    return {
      orderId: response.orderId,
      status: response.status,
      executionStatus,
      settlementTransactionHashes: hashes,
      tradeIds: response.tradeIds,
      latencyMs,
      spendAmountUsd: actualNotionalUsd,
      shares: actualShares,
      averagePrice: actualNotionalUsd / actualShares,
      feesUsd,
      requestedSpendAmountUsd: params.direction === 'buy' ? spendAmountUsd : plan.estimatedNotionalUsd,
      requestedShares: requested,
      slippageBps: plan.slippageBps,
      mirrorBoundPrice: boundPrice,
      mirrorTrackingBps: mirrorDecision?.kind === 'submit' ? mirrorDecision.trackingBps : null
    };
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    if (error instanceof UnrecoverableError) throw error;
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    throw new UnrecoverableError(`Polymarket execution failed: ${message}`);
  }
}

/**
 * How many times a rung's cancellation is attempted before the ladder stops.
 *
 * Three, because the two states worth retrying are both short-lived: the venue's
 * matching-delay window, and a read of the order that briefly trails the cancel
 * we just sent. Anything still resting after three attempts is a fact about the
 * book rather than a race, and the answer to that is a human.
 */
export const POLYMARKET_RUNG_CANCEL_ATTEMPTS = 3;

/**
 * Pause between cancellation attempts.
 *
 * Two seconds is chosen against the documented 250 ms taker delay with headroom,
 * not against the configurable sports `secondsDelay` — a long game delay is not
 * something to spin on, and the `blocked` branch is the correct answer there.
 */
export const POLYMARKET_RUNG_CANCEL_RETRY_MS = 2_000;

/**
 * Submit one exit-escalation rung as a GTD limit order (`S4-M17`).
 *
 * Separate from `triggerPolymarket` because the two order shapes answer different
 * questions. `triggerPolymarket` mirrors a master's trade and must not rest;
 * this recovers an exit that already failed to fill and is allowed to rest for a
 * bounded window.
 *
 * The `expiration` arrives pre-computed by `planPolymarketExitEscalation`, which
 * owns the documented `now + 60 + N` formula and the 3-minute venue floor. It is
 * re-checked here only for the case where a rung was planned and then sat in a
 * queue long enough to go stale — submitting an already-expired expiration is a
 * guaranteed rejection that would consume a rung.
 */
export async function submitPolymarketExitRung(params: {
  tokenID: string;
  rung: PolymarketExitLimitRung;
  now?: number;
}): Promise<{ orderId: string; status: string; expiration: number }> {
  if (!liveReadiness.ready) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(`Polymarket live execution is not ready: ${liveReadiness.reason}`);
  }
  if (!polymarketSigner) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket signer is not initialized');
  }
  const now = params.now ?? Date.now();
  const horizonMs = params.rung.expiration * 1000 - now;
  if (horizonMs < POLYMARKET_GTD_MINIMUM_HORIZON_MS) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(
      `Polymarket exit rung expiration is only ${horizonMs}ms ahead; the venue rejects anything under 3 minutes`
    );
  }

  const identity = resolvePolymarketIdentity(polymarketSigner.address);
  const client = requireSecureClobClient();
  const order = await client.createLimitOrder({
    tokenId: params.tokenID,
    side: OrderSide.SELL,
    price: params.rung.price,
    size: params.rung.shares,
    expiration: params.rung.expiration,
    builderCode: identity.builderCode
  });
  if (
    typeof order.builder !== 'string'
    || order.builder.toLowerCase() !== identity.builderCode
  ) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError('Polymarket signed exit rung omitted the configured builder code');
  }

  const relayerBudget = globalPolymarketRelayerBudget.checkBudget();
  if (!relayerBudget.allowed) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(relayerBudget.reason!);
  }

  const response = await client.postOrder(order);
  globalPolymarketRelayerBudget.recordExecution();
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new UnrecoverableError(
      `Polymarket exit rung rejected: ${response.code}: ${response.message}`
    );
  }
  return {
    orderId: response.orderId,
    status: response.status,
    expiration: params.rung.expiration
  };
}

/**
 * Build the `submitRung` port the escalation driver needs.
 *
 * The port's contract is "submit this rung, let it live out its window, then
 * report what it filled", so the waiting lives here rather than in the driver —
